chapters.title: Chapter 4780: Leaders and Kings IV
paragraphs: Noah looked at all of these prompts as he turned his gaze back to Glossikos.
"Nothing is ever meaningless."
His voice came heavy with conviction.
"I may not have the Depth of an Absolute, but I can do things that only Absolutes can. And I can even do things that no Absolutes can."
His eyes blazed with the fire of someone who refused to accept limitations imposed by others.
"You, nor THE Creature, nor any others can design new letters of The First Tongue, and yet I did."
His words were heavy!
Glossikos looked at him and smiled.
Then she laughed with genuine amusement.
"You wouldn’t be able to understand or do anything about anything before Absolute. Simple as that."
Her voice carried the certainty of someone stating fundamental truth.
"You can hate me for this just as I hate what THE Four stand for. When you get to that point, you actually won’t even need for me or anyone else to tell you anything."
Her obsidian-blue eyes held his without flinching.
"You will know yourself."
Noah frowned at these words.
Cryptic nonsense or genuine wisdom?
He couldn’t tell.
But he didn’t have time to dwell on it.
He rose up out of the Pool of Lethe.

The obsidian-gold waters cascaded off his form as he emerged, steam rising from skin that had been fundamentally transformed by the Cycles of Katharsis. His muscular figure gleamed with vitality that exceeded what it had held mere moments before. His toga wrapped around him with renewed elegance, the fabric seeming to recognize that its wearer had become something grander.
Glossikos looked at him from where she remained floating in the pool.
"Oh, what I can do is bypass all the other requirements for you to grasp the Lochagos ranking and attain the Polemarch ranking."
Her smile became something sharper.
"You have been saying you wanted to kill THE Weavers that arrived in here, right?"
She laughed.
"Haha, a tall fucking order, but good luck. The most I can do is make Paradoxos not interfere."
She waved her hand casually.
"But I can at least allow you to be a Polemarch to try it."
She finally said something good!
And she acted on it immediately!
HUUM!
The glorious change that unfolded was visible to the naked eye!
Noah’s toga shifted and transformed!

The simple garments of a Hoplite dissolved into light, replaced by the more elaborate attire of a Lochagos, multiple layers of inscribed fabric, Phonemes burning brighter across the surface. But even that didn’t last.
The toga transformed again!
The adornments of a Polemarch materialized around his form!

Rich blue-gold fabric that seemed woven from crystallized authority itself. Inscriptions that didn’t just display Phonemes but actively channeled their power. A laurel wreath that burned with the light of compressed linguistic mastery. Upon his chest, a golden pin depicted a shield, spear, and laurel wreath intertwined...the symbol of a War Leader of Wisdom.
|RANK ADVANCEMENT CONFIRMED|
|Previous Rank: Hoplite (Citizen-Soldier)|
|New Rank: POLEMARCH (War Leader of Wisdom)|
|Advancement Method: Direct elevation by Strategos Glossikos the Articulate|
|Requirements bypassed: Lochagos promotion, Trial demonstrations|
|POLEMARCH RIGHTS ACTIVATED|
|Depth Limitation: THE Fundamental Depth|
|Your suppressed power has been restored.|
|You may now express authority up to Fundamental Depth within THE Agora of Primordial Judgment.|
|Additional Rights:|
|- Full access to all libraries and sacred spaces|
|- May participate in governance with voting rights|
|- May judge formal debates and assign Merit|
|- May assign tasks to lower ranks|
|- May access the Path of Departure (requires Strategos approval for actual departure)|
|Note: As a Polemarch, you may now formally challenge other Polemarchs and even Strategoi to debates or Arena combat.|
|THE Weavers, despite being Absolutes externally, are currently classified as Hoplites within this domain(Well, maybe? We haven’t really checked).|
|You outrank them(Maybe? Likely.).|
|Use this advantage wisely.|
Noah looked over the prompts calmly.
And then he felt it.
The immensity of his Way fully returned to its fullest state!

The suppression that had compressed his power to Surface Depth levels shattered like glass struck by a hammer! His Formless Depth surged through his existence, filling every corner that had been emptied by the domain’s restrictions!
Blue-gold flames billowed around him as if unleashed from a prison!

His figure became bathed in plasmic fire that spoke of Mana and The First Tongue intertwined! The flames didn’t burn the Thermae around him...they simply existed, declaring his authority through their very presence!
And when he breathed, his nose and mouth released flaming Logos and Philologies!
Or really, what stood for his definition of Philology.

His Genesis Principles had been transformed into Archai, fundamental statements of reality that went beyond mere linguistic constructs. And now those Archai spilled from him with every exhalation, declarations of existence that made the artificial sky above pulse in response.
When Glossikos looked at him now, she laughed with something that sounded almost like delight.
"Haha, well, now you look a lot more like THE Creature. That guy always had multicolored flames raging around him."
As she said such words, Noah looked at her with eyes that now burned with restored authority.
"Thanks for the advancements in status."
The words were simple but sincere.
As he spoke, he floated over to the next pool in this place.
He was about to enter it when Glossikos spoke again.
"Hold on a second."
Her voice carried casual command.
"Let me make it even easier for you as another favor."
She rose slightly from the Pool of Lethe, her Dryad form glowing with the authority of an Absolute preparing to exert her power.
"Oh, and these are favors that I will call upon sooner or later."
Her smile held promise of future debt.
"The pools in this place are nice, but you don’t have to go through them one by one. If the power of an Absolute exerts itself truly here..."
She raised her hand.
BOOM!
The entire Thermae of Cyclic Refinement transformed!

All the pools covered by mist in this vast domain began to move! The floor changed and altered seamlessly, ancient stone rearranging itself as if it were liquid rather than solid! Channels opened. Barriers dissolved. Currents formed where none had existed.
The pools converged!

chapters.title: Chapter 4781: Leaders and Kings V
paragraphs: The Pool of Mnemosyne flowed toward the center, its waters that helped one remember and integrate all knowledge they had ever encountered merging with the streams from other sources!
And multiple other pools followed!
One massive swirling sea formed where six separate pools had been!

The waters churned with colors that shifted and merged, obsidian and gold and silver and crimson and white-hot flame and the deep blue of existential depths! Steam rose in patterns that wrote Phonemes in the air! The artificial sky above blazed brighter as if recognizing the magnitude of what had been created!
|The following pools of THE Thermae of Cyclic Refinement have been temporarily combined by Strategos authority:|
|The Pool of Mnemosyne (Memory): Helps one remember and integrate all knowledge they have ever encountered.|
|The Pool of Styx (Invulnerability): Hardens foundations against external corruption during refinement.|
|The Pool of Acheron (Sorrow): Allows one to process and incorporate painful experiences into strength.|
|The Pool of Cocytus (Lamentation): Releases trapped potential that grief has locked away.|
|The Pool of Phlegethon (Fire): Burns away weaknesses with purifying flame.|
|The Pool of Oceanus (The Existence-River): Connects one’s foundation to the fundamental flow of Existence itself.|
|COMBINED EFFECT:|
|Stepping into the sea combining all pools will grant exponentially greater effect to Katharsis.|
|Multiple cycles may be completed simultaneously.|
|Warning: The intensity of this combined refinement may exceed normal parameters.|
|Recommendation: Proceed. Your fat foundations can handle it.|
With shining eyes, Noah looked at the nonchalant Glossikos who remained in The Pool of Lethe.
"Thanks."
The word was simple.
But it carried genuine gratitude.
Then his body delved into the vibrant sea.

The multicolored waters surged around him the moment he entered! They penetrated into every layer of his existence! Memory and invulnerability and processed sorrow and released potential and purifying flame and Existential connection all merged into a single overwhelming experience.
The waters bubbled and churned!
Then they surged into his existence with force that would have destroyed anything less than what he had become.
As such a process began, Noah found himself in a very nostalgic mood.
He felt the immensity of his 27 Seals heading toward an unfathomable level as everything happening here was all connected.
Because as he continued to get stronger here every second...
A battle outside THE Agora of Primordial Judgment, in The Stoa of Dogmata, was being greatly affected by the rising immensity of his brilliance.
In a heavy and disastrous battle, many would only see the flashy impacts and terrifying expressions of power.
They didn’t truly have an idea how those involved in the battle were feeling.
At this moment, in the Stoa of Dogmata, with an Absolute watching calmly in the distance, Noah had his eyes on Gilgamesh.
Every move he made was for the purpose of bringing Ruin against this being.
He really felt like fights were a unique thing. To fight against something, one did not necessarily have to hate it.

When he first fought against apes and wolves in the first few dungeons after he became a Hunter, he didn’t particularly hate them. For him, they were only beasts that served as obstacles. He found them, killed them, and moved on with the loot.
But then, there were a few enemies across his existence where he genuinely hated them.

When he fought against these enemies, he found himself unfathomably focused. Truly and fully weaponizing his hatred in the most efficient manner until the enemy before him had that brilliance in their eyes collapse into nothingness.
So...
BOOM!
Even though Gilgamesh was surrounded by swirling weapons rushing from golden pools endlessly, each one carrying his Depth...
And it was a heavy Depth at that...
Noah threw his Absolute Seal of Infinity forward!
It acted like an unstoppable hammer, crashing and pulverizing the swirling weapons around Gilgamesh before it was eventually knocked back toward him!
But this was seconds ago.
Before he began Katharsis.
As his Weight became grander and grander, the Weavings of Gilgamesh that were already on the defensive... he began to pierce through them while nothing passed through to him.
Because he had the fragment of THE Axiom of Differentiated Tongue floating around him!

Anything that neared was broken down and dissolved into components of The First Tongue! Spears became Phonemes. Swords became scattered Logos. Axes became fragments of meaning that dispersed harmlessly into the air.
He proceeded ahead toward Gilgamesh more and more.
And all this time, his expression still remained bright.
At this moment, Noah took the 27 Seals of Absolute Tongue swirling around him and branded them over his skin!
One by one, they pressed into his flesh like tattoos being seared into existence itself!
Infinity blazed across his right arm!
Quintessence burned over his left!
Tyranny marked his chest!
The remaining Seals spread across his body in patterns that spoke of absolute authority, each one adding its Weight to the whole!
His entire body became shrouded with plasmic blue-gold flames!
"A leader shows the path forward."
His voice came heavy with conviction.
"I will lead you now and take you on your path to a grave of endless darkness."
His eyes locked onto Gilgamesh with the focus of someone about to end an existence.
"I’m getting a bit more serious. Get ready."
BOOM!
The moment he said this, his body erupted outward like an Existential nuclear warhead!

His Weight and Immensity became so terrifying that the very air compressed before him! The Stoa of Dogmata groaned under the pressure! Ancient inscriptions on the surrounding pillars flickered and dimmed.
He smashed across all weapons surrounding Gilgamesh.
Golden spears shattered!
Existential swords broke!
Legendary axes that had conquered civilizations crumbled into fragments!
He appeared right before Gilgamesh in an instant!
Gilgamesh’s eyes opened wildly!
A Declaration instantly erupted from him, golden light blazing with authority that had commanded armies since before most civilizations existed!
But Noah didn’t even care for what such a Declaration was or what it was trying to accomplish!
His fist blazed with the Absolute Seal of Quintessence.
His left hand grabbed the shoulder of Gilgamesh with grip that could crush mountains!
He looked deeply into the stern eyes of this being.
Then his right fist thundered and hammered itself into his chest!
DOONG!
It was like metal meeting metal!

chapters.title: Chapter 4782: Leaders and Kings VI
paragraphs: The impact sent shockwaves rippling through the Stoa of Dogmata! Ancient pillars cracked! The floor beneath them cratered!
Noah held him down with one hand while using another hand filled with the Weight of his Way to heavily impose and hammer everything that Gilgamesh stood for!
How exactly was the Weight of someone that exceeded even the foundation of THE Creature at THE Surface Depth and THE Intermediate Depth by more than 200% each?
At this moment, Noah knew.
It was enough to rock Gilgamesh, who was grander than other THE Fundamental Depth entities, to the extent that his golden pupils developed cracks in them.
BOOM!
His left hand remained on Gilgamesh’s shoulder as he clamped down.
He looked into the eyes of this being calmly.
"With that strike just now, I saw cracks permeating across your Unity."
His voice came measured and analytical.
"An impossible thing for you to fathom, I imagine."
His grip tightened.
"I’m sure that like me, you dreamed of your path and all that you would accomplish after THE Fallout. Was the future you saw brilliant? Filled with your glory?"
As he said such words...
BZZT!
His stomach buzzed with impact!
The tips of two spears grabbed by Gilgamesh smashed onto him! They carried a Declaration of being capable of piercing anything.
The authority behind them would have punched through Fundamental Depth entities without resistance!
And yet 15 Seals were swirling over his front!
They ground down and denied that Declaration completely.
The spears stopped as if they had struck an immovable wall!
Thereafter, Noah looked at this being as he spoke out.
"My fist carried a severing light that is meant to sever Unity above all else."
BOOM!
A heavy Thesis backed by the Weight of a foundation that even THE Creature could not match!
Noah threw his hand out again!
It smashed into Gilgamesh’s chest like a hammer forged from the authority of Existence itself.

The blast and impact caused blue-gold flames to flash and burst around their two figures like a volcanic eruption! Fire and light and concentrated power exploded outward in waves that made the entire Stoa tremble.
The ancient inscriptions on the walls blazed brighter as if trying to contain the devastation!
And after he did it once...
Noah proceeded to do it again.
BOOM!
The second impact cracked something fundamental in Gilgamesh’s chest!
Gilgamesh laid out his own Declaration! Weapons swirled from all around to pierce into Noah! Golden spears and swords and legendary axes descended like rain!
But they were dissolved into Phonemes before they could touch him!
BOOM!
The third impact! The fourth!
Even when weapons neared his body, the Seals covering his skin dissipated them into harmless light!
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!
The fifth! The sixth! The seventh! The eighth!
Each strike carried the severing light meant to destroy Unity! Each impact added to the cracks spreading across Gilgamesh’s existence! Each hammer blow pushed The First Leader closer to collapse.
BOOM!
On the ninth impact, Gilgamesh’s body was filled with cracks!

Crimson-gold blood leaked from fissures that had formed across his golden armor. His flesh, saturated with Paradox and Unity intertwined, showed damage that should have been impossible for something at his level to sustain.
And yet his face remained regal.
That of a leader.
That of a king.
Even broken and bleeding, he did not show weakness. He did not show fear. He showed only the dignity of one who had commanded since before time learned to count.
But...
"Your Unity is tattered, pounded, and broken down."
Noah said such words calmly while his left hand continued to literally hold the Depth and Immensity of Gilgamesh right before him.
And at this time, Gilgamesh held a light of defiance!
He didn’t even acknowledge this assessment!
And because he didn’t acknowledge it, it almost acted like a Declaration!
His Way began to heal itself!
Unity putting itself back together piece by piece!
But...
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!
In a femtosecond, Noah smashed out 18 times!

The combined Weight of his 27 Seals battered against Gilgamesh with force that transcended normal parameters of violence! Each strike was a statement! Each impact was a Thesis! Each hammer blow declared that Unity would break before Noah’s authority.
On the 18th time, his hand cleanly pierced into the chest of Gilgamesh!
It went through golden armor that had withstood the attacks of countless others!
It went through flesh saturated with the authority of one who had led since the earliest ages!
It went through everything that protected what lay within!
And his hand grasped a beating Heart of Unity.
THE Heart of Unity!
The core of Gilgamesh’s Civilization!
The representation of everything he had built, everyone he had led, every accomplishment he had achieved across eons of existence!
With a single pull...
Noah ripped it out!
The sound was horrific!
Flesh tearing! Bone breaking! The wet separation of something that was never meant to be removed from its housing.
Crimson-gold blood sprayed across Noah’s face as the Heart came free!
It continued beating in his grasp, each pulse sending ripples of fading authority through the air.
Multiple Seals flared all around Noah like chains.
They wrapped around the hands of Gilgamesh!
They bound his feet!
They dragged him down to his knees with weight that even The First Leader could not resist.
Then the Seal of Tyranny formed into a purple throne behind Noah!
It materialized from concentrated authority, a seat of power that declared dominion over all who knelt before it!
Noah proceeded to regally sit upon it as he breathed out.
His hand grasped the beating Heart of Unity as he examined it with clinical interest.
It had bright hues of purple and gold, the colors of leadership and glory intertwined. And mixed in here and there, threads of obsidian that spoke of Paradox woven into its very structure.
"Hatred brings with it a sense of brutality."
His voice came heavy with something that might have been regret.
"I don’t need to do this. I truly don’t."
His eyes met Gilgamesh’s defiant gaze.
"But I am only human. I wish to express my hatred. I wish to give back. I wish to answer your curiosity."
The image was one that would burn itself into the memory of any who witnessed it!
The First Leader, Gilgamesh, bound by Seals of terrifying Immensity!
Kneeling before a throne of Tyranny!
The Heart of his Civilization, something that one had to protect against all cost, grasped by another!
And while he grasped it and sat grandly upon his throne, Noah looked at the defiant visage of Gilgamesh.
Then he took the Heart of his Civilization...
And began to take bites out of it.
The first bite tore away a section of beating muscle!
Immense Depth was devoured!
Crimson-gold blood savaged leaked around Noah’s mouth, running down his chin in streams that painted his chest! The taste was iron and authority and the accumulated glory of eons!
His eyes remained locked with Gilgamesh this whole time!
He chewed.
He swallowed.
He took another bite.
It was brutal!
It was savage!
It was the act of a predator consuming the very essence of its prey while that prey watched!
And while he did this, Declarations were shockingly forming around Gilgamesh even now.
Even with his heart torn out!
Even with his body bound!
Even with his Unity shattered!
The First Leader still fought back!
Golden light blazed as he tried to reclaim what was being taken! Authority surged as he attempted to stop the consumption of everything he had built.
But every single Declaration was dissolved or dispersed.
Noah’s presence, his Weight, his authority over The First Tongue itself... it negated everything Gilgamesh tried.
Noah continued eating.
Blood ran down his chin.
His eyes never left Gilgamesh’s.
"I am doing everything I can so that one day, I never sit where you sit. Watching another man devour my Civilization."
He took another bite.
"This is my leadership to you as I show the Way."
Another bite.
"However brilliant you were, this was not something you saw being possible."
Another bite.
"However brilliant I am, I will take this as a lesson."
He swallowed the last piece of the Heart of Unity.
"Keep the defiant light. Remain true to who you are to the very end."
His voice grew softer.
"At the very least, you will not lose your title of a Leader."
Noah said such heavy words as he brutally finished devouring the Civilization of Gilgamesh.
The First Leader knelt before him, bound and broken, his Unity consumed, his Civilization destroyed.
And yet those golden eyes still blazed with defiance that refused to die.
In the distance, THE Secretive Eon looked at this scene with shining eyes.
Moments later, she shockingly licked her lips.
As if she was parched.
As if she felt...a bit hungry herself.

Ancient pillars cracked!
The floor beneath them cratered!
Noah held him down with one hand while using another hand filled with the Weight of his Way to heavily impose and hammer everything that Gilgamesh stood for!
How exactly was the Weight of someone that exceeded even the foundation of THE Creature at THE Surface Depth and THE Intermediate Depth by more than 200% each?
At this moment, Noah knew.
It was enough to rock Gilgamesh, who was grander than other THE Fundamental Depth entities, to the extent that his golden pupils developed cracks in them.
BOOM!
His left hand remained on Gilgamesh’s shoulder as he clamped down.
He looked into the eyes of this being calmly.
"With that strike just now, I saw cracks permeating across your Unity."
His voice came measured and analytical.
"An impossible thing for you to fathom, I imagine."
His grip tightened.
"I’m sure that like me, you dreamed of your path and all that you would accomplish after THE Fallout.
Was the future you saw brilliant?
Filled with your glory?"
As he said such words...
BZZT!
His stomach buzzed with impact!
The tips of two spears grabbed by Gilgamesh smashed onto him!
They carried a Declaration of being capable of piercing anything.
The authority behind them would have punched through Fundamental Depth entities without resistance!
And yet 15 Seals were swirling over his front!
They ground down and denied that Declaration completely.
The spears stopped as if they had struck an immovable wall!
Thereafter, Noah looked at this being as he spoke out.
"My fist carried a severing light that is meant to sever Unity above all else."
BOOM!
A heavy Thesis backed by the Weight of a foundation that even THE Creature could not match!
Noah threw his hand out again!
It smashed into Gilgamesh’s chest like a hammer forged from the authority of Existence itself.
The blast and impact caused blue-gold flames to flash and burst around their two figures like a volcanic eruption!
Fire and light and concentrated power exploded outward in waves that made the entire Stoa tremble.
The ancient inscriptions on the walls blazed brighter as if trying to contain the devastation!
And after he did it once...
Noah proceeded to do it again.
BOOM!
The second impact cracked something fundamental in Gilgamesh’s chest!
Gilgamesh laid out his own Declaration!
Weapons swirled from all around to pierce into Noah!
Golden spears and swords and legendary axes descended like rain!
But they were dissolved into Phonemes before they could touch him!
BOOM!

The fourth!
Even when weapons neared his body, the Seals covering his skin dissipated them into harmless light!

BOOM!
The fifth!
The sixth!
The seventh!
The eighth!
Each strike carried the severing light meant to destroy Unity!
Each impact added to the cracks spreading across Gilgamesh’s existence!
Each hammer blow pushed The First Leader closer to collapse.
BOOM!

Crimson-gold blood leaked from fissures that had formed across his golden armor.
His flesh, saturated with Paradox and Unity intertwined, showed damage that should have been impossible for something at his level to sustain.
And yet his face remained regal.
That of a leader.
That of a king.
Even broken and bleeding, he did not show weakness.
He did not show fear.
He showed only the dignity of one who had commanded since before time learned to count.
But...

Noah said such words calmly while his left hand continued to literally hold the Depth and Immensity of Gilgamesh right before him.

His Way began to heal itself!
Unity putting itself back together piece by piece!
But...

BOOM!
BOOM!

The combined Weight of his 27 Seals battered against Gilgamesh with force that transcended normal parameters of violence!
Each strike was a statement!
Each impact was a Thesis!
Each hammer blow declared that Unity would break before Noah’s authority.

It went through flesh saturated with the authority of one who had led since the earliest ages!
It went through everything that protected what lay within!

The core of Gilgamesh’s Civilization!
The representation of everything he had built, everyone he had led, every accomplishment he had achieved across eons of existence!

Flesh tearing!
Bone breaking!
The wet separation of something that was never meant to be removed from its housing.

They bound his feet!

It had bright hues of purple and gold, the colors of leadership and glory intertwined.

I truly don’t."

I wish to express my hatred.

I wish to answer your curiosity."

chapters.title: Chapter 4783: The Ultimate Failure I
paragraphs: Brutality.
There were different forms of it across Civilizations.
Some said it was not necessary. That violence begat violence. That cruelty only bred more cruelty in an endless cycle that consumed all who participated in it.
But truly, sometimes, brutality was warranted.
And sometimes, it was a must.

When an enemy sought to destroy everything you built, was gentleness the answer? When a predator came for your people, was kindness the response? When someone sent an attack of curiosity across time that nearly collapsed your existence and everyone you cared about...
Was restraint truly the moral high ground?
Noah had long since made peace with this truth. Observable Existence was cruel.
Those who held back when brutality was required found themselves and everyone they loved ground to dust in the endless Weavings of time.
He would not be ground to dust.
And so, he would not hold back.
With every bite of The Heart of Unity he took, his gaze never left Gilgamesh.

The crimson-gold blood ran down his chin. The taste of accumulated authority and ancient glory filled his mouth. The Depth of a Civilization built across eons dissolved into his existence with each swallow.
And through it all, those golden eyes of The First Leader remained defiant.
Even broken. Even bound. Even watching his very heart being consumed.
Defiant.
Noah respected that, barely.
After the final bite, he spoke.
"After a certain point, the necessary brutality has to be brought to an end."
His voice came measured and calm, as if discussing philosophy rather than the destruction he had just wrought.
"I won’t be so cruel as to torture you."
He wiped the blood from his chin with the back of his hand.
"I have collapsed your Way of Unity. I am eating the very Heart of your Civilization. Your Depth and Immensity continues to reduce as you will very soon fall to the level of Pre-THE."
His eyes studied the kneeling figure before him.
"I was planning to devour you completely. But out of curiosity, I will give you a choice."
He leaned forward on his throne of Tyranny.
"You see, THE Four, especially THE Primordial Chaos, like to act all mysteriously and play around with choices. I’ve experienced a few aspects of who they are."
His smile held no warmth.
"Right now, I’ll give you a choice."
He paused.

"I’ve collapsed many beings across my life. Every life I take, however rapid or futile it may seem, I know that it is complete cessation and darkness for the other side. The end of everything they were, everything they could have been, everything they hoped to become."
His voice grew heavier.
"Do you want complete darkness? Or will you submit?"
The words hung in the air.
"If you do, I will send you to an inescapable prison where even THE Living Paradox would never be able to take you away from."
Noah said this calmly as he looked at Gilgamesh!

He was a glorious and distinguished being. After having collapsed the entirety of his Civilization, Noah had already gained immensely from the vibrant Depth of a Fundamental Depth entity like Gilgamesh.
But if he could continue to gain and use such a being...
If he could have them reforge their Way in THE Infinite Desmoterion...
That was an even grander punishment.
He held the prompts at bay as he waited.
And on the face of The First Leader, there was still defiance.
But something else flickered in those golden eyes now.
Something that looked almost like... clarity.
As if the consumption of his Heart had stripped away illusions he had been carrying for eons.
Gilgamesh was silent for a long moment.
Then he laughed.
It was not the laugh of madness or desperation. It was the laugh of someone who had finally understood a joke that had been played on them across the entirety of their existence.
"I seem...to have been under the banner of others for too long."
His voice came heavy with the weight of accumulated regret.
"I thought Existence was mine. I thought I was Gilgamesh, The First Leader, commander of armies, conqueror of civilizations, the one whose name would echo across Existence."
His golden eyes met Noah’s directly.
"But I was never truly leading, was I? I was being led. Guided by threads I couldn’t see. Moved by hands I refused to acknowledge."
He shook his head slowly.
"It seems I failed the moment I agreed to go under the banner of Paradox."
The words landed with weight.

"The moment that choice was made, my fate was sealed. Every battle I fought afterward, every victory I claimed, every civilization I conquered... all of it was in service to another’s design. All of it was building toward this moment."
His laugh came again, bitter and clear.
"What a waste."
BOOM!
The words were heavy!

Noah looked at this being who had just rejected survival in favor of ending. Who had chosen complete darkness over servitude! Who had, in his final moments, found the clarity to see what he had truly been all along.
Not a leader, but as a follower who had convinced himself he was leading.
"So you choose collapse."
Noah’s voice came without judgment.
"I choose to finally make a decision that is truly mine. Not Paradox’s. Not THE Living Paradox’s. Not THE Weavers’. Mine."
His golden eyes blazed with something that transcended defiance.
"If I cannot live as Gilgamesh, I will die as Gilgamesh. The First Leader. The one who knelt to no one at the end."
He straightened his spine despite the Seals binding him. Well, he said all that, but he was technically being forced to kneel right now!
Noah looked at this being for a long moment.
He had expected the practical choice. He had expected Gilgamesh to choose survival, to choose the possibility of future escape, to choose anything over the absolute finality of complete collapse.
But The First Leader had surprised him.
In the end, he had chosen to be what he always tried to be.
A Leader.
Someone who made their own choices, even if that choice was death.
Noah rose from his throne of Tyranny.
"In the end, you made a choice that was yours. And for that, I will grant you a clean collapse. No torture. No drawn-out suffering. Just... ending."
Gilgamesh closed his eyes.
Noah’s hand blazed with the combined authority of his 27 Seals.
Gilgamesh said no more as even at this moment, he looked ridiculously grand.
BOOM!
Noah’s hand descended!

Brilliant blue-gold flames erupted from his palm with force that transcended normal violence! They consumed the bound form of Gilgamesh completely! Not slowly, not painfully, but instantly and absolutely!
The First Leader did not scream as he simply... ended.

His existence, accumulated across eons of conquest and command, collapsed into nothingness in the span of a heartbeat. His Depth, already diminished by the consumption of his Heart, dissolved into Noah’s flames. His Way of Unity, already shattered and devoured, ceased to be entirely.
Gilgamesh, The First Leader, was no more.
The Stoa of Dogmata fell silent.
Where he had knelt, only scorched stone remained.
Not even ash.
Just... absence.
Oh!

chapters.title: Chapter 4784: The Ultimate Failure II
paragraphs: The area became unfathomably quiet as Noah stared at the place where a Leader used to be.
The attack of curiosity all the way from The Earliest Folds ended like this after all this time.
What a wonder existence was.
Noah closed his eyes as before him, prompts began to descend.
|VICTORY|
|Opponent: Gilgamesh, The First Leader|
|Classification: THE Fundamental Depth|
|Affiliation: THE Living Paradox, THE Loom|
|Status: COMPLETELY COLLAPSED|
|You have devoured the Heart of a Civilization that held immense comparative Weight at THE Fundamental Depth.|
|Gilgamesh’s Unity exceeded normal/average Fundamental Depth parameters by estimated 340%.|
|Additional harvest obtained from complete collapse of remaining existence.|
|This harvest has provided sufficient Depth to trigger advancement.|

|Your Civilizations of Mana and Hunger, though they dont necessarily fit into this classification as they are in totality, Formless, can officially be considered to have advanced to THE Fundamental Depth.|
|You may now begin refining and reinforcing your foundation at THE Fundamental Depth.|
|You may elevate its Weight and Immensity through continued harvest and Katharsis.|

|At this current moment, not enough information has been gathered to make a truly accurate statement regarding the comparative Weight you currently hold at THE Fundamental Depth compared to THE Creature and others like him.|
|Preliminary estimates suggest your foundation exceeds normal parameters, but precise measurements require additional data.|
|Recommendation: Continue building. Continue harvesting. The ceiling has still not been found.|
|Gilgamesh, The First Leader, has been completely collapsed.|
|Former Status: Warden of THE Loom|
|Current Status: Non-existent|
|His accumulated knowledge and authority have been absorbed into your foundations.|
|His existence will never return. Complete collapse is absolute.|
|This action will be known to THE Living Paradox soon enough.|
|Similar to how you found the potential collapse of Lumivara and Ul’moreth through your connection to your followers...|
|THE Living Paradox will sense the permanent loss of Gilgamesh through his connection to THE Loom.|
|Prepare for potential retaliation.|
|Prepare for potential escalation.|
|THE Weavers remain at large within THE Agora of Primordial Judgment.|
|Your original objective has not been completed.|
|Gilgamesh was a distraction. A worthy one, but a distraction nonetheless.|
|THE Weavers must still be collapsed.|
Noah smiled at such words as Ruination was having her fun.
|Your advancement to THE Fundamental Depth does not change your Formless classification.|
|You remain unplaceable within conventional Depth categories.|
|Your Fundamental Depth foundation: Assessment pending. Data insufficient.|
Noah opened his eyes to the gaze of THE Secretive Eon looking at him up and down with a slight smile.
She had been watching the entire time and now, she seemed ready to share her thoughts.
"No death or collapse is good."
Her voice came imposing and mysterious, holding the weight of someone who had contemplated these truths across eons.
"I actually consider death to be a failure of Existence. A failure of someone to completely master what Existence has presented them."
Her eyes held depths that seemed to swallow light itself.
"Even the peasant born without any authority always has another chance to continue living. Another path to find. Another way to survive what Existence throws at them."
She tilted her head slightly.
"If they meet death, they simply were not successful. They did not solve the puzzle that their circumstances presented. They did not overcome the obstacles that could have been overcome."
Her smile grew sharper.

"The most fearsome peasant that I know is THE Living Paradox. Look at where he arrived after all of that adversity. Born into nothing. Given nothing. And yet he clawed his way to become one of THE Four. He solved every puzzle. He overcame every obstacle. He refused to accept failure."
She paused.
"Whatever life that Gilgamesh led before his death, whatever glory and accomplishments he had... to me, all of it is worth absolutely nothing."
Her voice grew colder.
"Because in the end, he could not stop his collapse. In the end, he faced the ultimate failure."
THE Secretive Eon shook her head as she said this.
Noah turned to observe her calmly.
He did not reply right away.
He thought more about her words. The cold logic of them. The brutal assessment that reduced an entire existence to a simple binary of success and failure. Live or die. Overcome or be overcome.
There was truth in what she said.
And yet...
In the end, he chose not to reply.
He simply held a moment of silence.

Whether it was for himself or for another, he did not know. Perhaps for Gilgamesh, who had at least chosen his own ending. Perhaps for the countless beings across his journey who had faced the ultimate failure under his hands. Perhaps simply to acknowledge that existence was vast, and not everything could be reduced to equations of success.
After a few seconds of this silence, he turned toward THE Secretive Eon.
"If your Disciple could choose between any of the philosophies of the oldest powers in Existence, which one would she choose?"
He asked such a question simply.
THE Secretive Eon yawned before she replied.
"Existence."
The word came casual and dismissive.
"She was always a fool when it came to Existence. She idolized THE Creature even though I told her... in the end, I would stand above him and collapse him as well."
BOOM!
A fool when it came to Existence and THE Creature!
When Noah thought about this, he couldn’t help but turn his head in a particular direction.
Toward The Early Veiled Shore of THE Creature.
Toward where another body of his currently stood.
The Embodiment that THE Creature had laid out had ended moments ago.
And the results were astonishing to observe.
Noah stood near the figures of THE First Hunger and THE Living Origin as both of them at this moment held radiant Fundamental Depths!
They were power-leveled ridiculously by a single Embodiment of THE Creature!

The Depth of THE Living Origin seemed even more potent, as if she was not that far away from Half-Step Absolute. Her entire existence thrummed with authority that had been compressed and refined by forces beyond normal comprehension.
It made some sense.

THE Living Spirit and THE Living Concept who sided with THE Living Paradox within THE Loom each had power at Half-Step Absolute. They had followed different paths, aligned with different philosophies, served different masters.
But in the end, they achieved the same destination.

|Status: COMPLETELY COLLAPSED|
|You have devoured the Heart of a Civilization that held immense comparative Weight at THE Fundamental Depth.|
|Gilgamesh’s Unity exceeded normal/average Fundamental Depth parameters by estimated 340%.|
|Additional harvest obtained from complete collapse of remaining existence.|
|This harvest has provided sufficient Depth to trigger advancement.|

|Your Civilizations of Mana and Hunger, though they dont necessarily fit into this classification as they are in totality, Formless, can officially be considered to have advanced to THE Fundamental Depth.|
|You may now begin refining and reinforcing your foundation at THE Fundamental Depth.|
|You may elevate its Weight and Immensity through continued harvest and Katharsis.|

|At this current moment, not enough information has been gathered to make a truly accurate statement regarding the comparative Weight you currently hold at THE Fundamental Depth compared to THE Creature and others like him.|
|Preliminary estimates suggest your foundation exceeds normal parameters, but precise measurements require additional data.|
|Recommendation: Continue building.
Continue harvesting.
The ceiling has still not been found.|
|Gilgamesh, The First Leader, has been completely collapsed.|
|Former Status: Warden of THE Loom|
|Current Status: Non-existent|
|His accumulated knowledge and authority have been absorbed into your foundations.|
|His existence will never return.
Complete collapse is absolute.|
|This action will be known to THE Living Paradox soon enough.|
|Similar to how you found the potential collapse of Lumivara and Ul’moreth through your connection to your followers...|
|THE Living Paradox will sense the permanent loss of Gilgamesh through his connection to THE Loom.|
|Prepare for potential retaliation.|
|Prepare for potential escalation.|
|THE Weavers remain at large within THE Agora of Primordial Judgment.|
|Your original objective has not been completed.|
|Gilgamesh was a distraction.
A worthy one, but a distraction nonetheless.|
|THE Weavers must still be collapsed.|
Noah smiled at such words as Ruination was having her fun.
|Your advancement to THE Fundamental Depth does not change your Formless classification.|
|You remain unplaceable within conventional Depth categories.|
|Your Fundamental Depth foundation: Assessment pending.
Data insufficient.|
Noah opened his eyes to the gaze of THE Secretive Eon looking at him up and down with a slight smile.
She had been watching the entire time and now, she seemed ready to share her thoughts.
"No death or collapse is good."
Her voice came imposing and mysterious, holding the weight of someone who had contemplated these truths across eons.
"I actually consider death to be a failure of Existence.
A failure of someone to completely master what Existence has presented them."
Her eyes held depths that seemed to swallow light itself.
"Even the peasant born without any authority always has another chance to continue living.
Another path to find.
Another way to survive what Existence throws at them."
She tilted her head slightly.
"If they meet death, they simply were not successful.
They did not solve the puzzle that their circumstances presented.
They did not overcome the obstacles that could have been overcome."
Her smile grew sharper.
"The most fearsome peasant that I know is THE Living Paradox.
Look at where he arrived after all of that adversity.
Born into nothing.
Given nothing.
And yet he clawed his way to become one of THE Four.
He solved every puzzle.
He overcame every obstacle.
He refused to accept failure."
She paused.
"Whatever life that Gilgamesh led before his death, whatever glory and accomplishments he had... to me, all of it is worth absolutely nothing."
Her voice grew colder.
"Because in the end, he could not stop his collapse.
In the end, he faced the ultimate failure."
THE Secretive Eon shook her head as she said this.
Noah turned to observe her calmly.
He did not reply right away.
He thought more about her words.
The cold logic of them.
The brutal assessment that reduced an entire existence to a simple binary of success and failure.
Live or die.
Overcome or be overcome.
There was truth in what she said.
And yet...
In the end, he chose not to reply.
He simply held a moment of silence.
Whether it was for himself or for another, he did not know.
Perhaps for Gilgamesh, who had at least chosen his own ending.
Perhaps for the countless beings across his journey who had faced the ultimate failure under his hands.
Perhaps simply to acknowledge that existence was vast, and not everything could be reduced to equations of success.
After a few seconds of this silence, he turned toward THE Secretive Eon.
"If your Disciple could choose between any of the philosophies of the oldest powers in Existence, which one would she choose?"
He asked such a question simply.
THE Secretive Eon yawned before she replied.
"Existence."
The word came casual and dismissive.
"She was always a fool when it came to Existence.
She idolized THE Creature even though I told her... in the end, I would stand above him and collapse him as well."
BOOM!
A fool when it came to Existence and THE Creature!
When Noah thought about this, he couldn’t help but turn his head in a particular direction.
Toward The Early Veiled Shore of THE Creature.
Toward where another body of his currently stood.
The Embodiment that THE Creature had laid out had ended moments ago.
And the results were astonishing to observe.
Noah stood near the figures of THE First Hunger and THE Living Origin as both of them at this moment held radiant Fundamental Depths!
They were power-leveled ridiculously by a single Embodiment of THE Creature!
The Depth of THE Living Origin seemed even more potent, as if she was not that far away from Half-Step Absolute.
Her entire existence thrummed with authority that had been compressed and refined by forces beyond normal comprehension.
It made some sense.
THE Living Spirit and THE Living Concept who sided with THE Living Paradox within THE Loom each had power at Half-Step Absolute.
They had followed different paths, aligned with different philosophies, served different masters.
But in the end, they achieved the same destination.

chapters.title: Chapter 4785: The Ultimate Failure III
paragraphs: And yet, even with the level of power that Tor and THE Living Origin currently held, both had complex expressions.
As if they did not truly want this.
Noah looked at the two of them and shook his head.

He was already receiving an influx of Harvest from the fact that entities who backed his Way of Existence had attained this level of Depth. Their advancement fed into his foundations through the connections they shared.
But with them acting like this...
"Power is power, regardless of where it came from."
His voice came direct and practical.
"A poor man will never question if a mountain of gold fell into his house one day and wallow about it. Why should you two?"
Tor’s gaze was bright as he shook his head.
"Imagine being collapsed by someone, only for that someone later on to say, oh, here you go. A higher level Depth for you."
His voice held notes of bitter irony.
"But alas, you are right. I won’t complain."
The vibrant waves of Hunger from him became even more potent!

His foundation, newly elevated to THE Fundamental Depth, pulsed with appetite that seemed to devour the very air around him. Whatever conflicted feelings he held, they did not diminish the power he had been granted.
Noah looked at the figure of THE Living Origin next.

She stood with serene glory that transcended her previous state. Her form seemed to glow from within, multicolored light playing across features that had been refined by THE Creature’s Embodiment. Her eyes held depths that spoke of authority approaching the threshold of Half-Step Absolute.
"I...have always been chasing after THE Creature."
Her voice came measured and heavy with accumulated history.
"My Everything burned for THE Creature. I first met him in Alfheimr, before he even became an Absolute."
Her eyes grew distant with memory.
"He was brilliant. Every word he said, every action he took... I was enticed completely. I followed him across realms and eons. I gave My Everything I had to support his rise."
Something flickered in her expression.
"But of course, Emotive came along."
Her voice grew harder.
"I truly don’t know what that malevolent creature has to make her jump from one Absolute to another, but..."
She paused.
"I am not satisfied with how I was treated. I do not take this as an answer."
Her eyes blazed with determination.
"So I will seek my own answer. For now, I will return to Alfheimr. There, whether he wants to or not, THE Creature will have to give me an answer."
BOOM!
THE Living Origin said many heavy words!
Her eyes were thinking of none other than THE Creature.
And near her, Noah turned to see the crimson-obsidian gaze of THE First Hunger.
His gaze seemed to only be directed toward... THE Living Origin.
One was looking at someone at an extremely distant place, seeking answers that may have already been given.
While another was looking at someone right in front of them who would not even gaze their way.
The words of THE First Hunger echoed out as he said calmly.
"Alfheimr? I’ll tag along for fun."
His voice came measured and seemingly casual.
"You can navigate there even in THE Fallout?"
He asked this question as if the answer didn’t matter.
Origin looked at him and blinked.
"I will always know my way back home."
BOOM!
With such words, she turned toward Noah.
"I will make this little trip, if that is okay with you."
It almost seemed like she was asking for permission.
Because at this moment, she no longer backed THE Creature.
She backed him instead.
Noah smiled lightly as he waved his hand.

He allowed the emergence of a small Seal of Quintessence to flow toward THE Living Origin. It drifted through the air with lazy grace before settling into her palm, its radiance pulsing with compressed authority.
"Just keep this with you in case of emergencies. If anything happens, let me know."
THE Living Origin nodded at such words.
She and THE First Hunger prepared to make an exit into the Wastes of THE Fallout.
Their destination was Alfheimr.
Where THE Creature had first risen.
In THE Agora of Primordial Judgment.
In The Thermae of Cyclic Refinement.
Noah had his struggles across Existence, but he liked when things were comparatively easier as well.
Among THE Four, he was the weakest.
But at this moment, he was getting his dues.
The contribution of 9 new letters to The First Tongue inside THE Agora of Primordial Judgment... how could it be beat? Especially when the rewards stemmed from the very philosophy of Glossarians?

THE Villa Dei Boscoreale which held the treasures of THE Corrupted Vaults of Ginnungagap flowed into him steadily. The entire time, only one Kronos’s Crystallized Moment after another descended. As soon as he finished one, another would float down from the artificial sky. Mythical-tier treasures that should have been impossibly rare fell into his grasp like common fruits from an abundant tree.
In less than an hour in the combined pools of The Thermae of Cyclic Refinement...
His existence felt a sense of exuberance and immensity that gave him a sense of invincibility.
A false sense of invincibility, but it was there nonetheless.
Because after all, the 9 Cycles of Katharsis were all passed gloriously!

His skin shone with a crystalline blue-gold allure as if he was a Primordial treasure given flesh. Light seemed to emanate from within him, filtering through flesh that had been refined beyond normal biological parameters. Every pore radiated authority. Every inch of his form spoke of foundations compressed to impossible densities.
His Depth and Weight felt utterly suffocating.
Even Glossikos, an Absolute nodded as if saying hey, not bad!
|All Nine Cycles of Katharsis have been successfully completed.|
|The Pool of Mnemosyne (Memory): All knowledge you have ever encountered has been perfectly integrated into your foundations. Nothing is forgotten. Everything is accessible.|

|The Pool of Styx (Invulnerability): Your foundations have been hardened against external corruption. Attempts to destabilize your Depth through foreign influence will face exponentially increased resistance.|
|The Pool of Acheron (Sorrow): All painful experiences across your existence have been processed and incorporated into strength. Trauma that once weakened now fortifies.|
|The Pool of Cocytus (Lamentation): Trapped potential that grief had locked away has been released. Capabilities you did not know you possessed are now accessible.|
|The Pool of Phlegethon (Fire): All weaknesses have been burned away with purifying flame. What remains is only that which serves your advancement.|
|The Pool of Oceanus (The Existence-River): Your foundation has been connected to the fundamental flow of Existence itself. You resonate with reality at frequencies that most beings cannot perceive.|

chapters.title: Chapter 4786: The Ultimate Failure IV
paragraphs: The prompts continued to flow before his eyes.
|CYCLE COMPLETION BREAKDOWN|
|Tetarta Katharsis (Fourth Purification): Strengthening of boundaries between Depth levels. Weight increase: 40%|
|Pempte Katharsis (Fifth Purification): Integration of external knowledge into core foundations. Weight increase: 50%|
|Ekti Katharsis (Sixth Purification): Refinement of connection between Way and Depth. Weight increase: 60%|
|Evdomi Katharsis (Seventh Purification): Approaching theoretical limits of current classification. Weight increase: 75%|
|Ogdoi Katharsis (Eighth Purification): Transcending normal parameters for current Depth. Weight increase: 90%|
|Enati Katharsis (Ninth Purification / THE Wheel of Foundation): The absolute pinnacle of refinement possible without advancing to higher Depth. Weight increase: 100%|
|Total cumulative Weight increase from all nine cycles: 445%|
|COMPARATIVE WEIGHT ASSESSMENT|
|THE Surface Depth:|
|Current Weight: 950/100th of baseline Absolute parameters|
|You exceed what THE Creature held at Surface Depth by a factor of 9.5|
|THE Intermediate Depth:|
|Current Weight: 910/100th of baseline Absolute parameters|
|You exceed what THE Creature held at Intermediate Depth by a factor of 9.1|
|You are now approaching a theoretical maximum, and it is becoming even harder to reach it.|
The numbers felt surreal for the most part.
But even when he checked again, they remained the same!
The jumping off point of his foundation was grander, and it continued to be so.
More prompts came as his existence buzzed.
|DISTINCTION ACHIEVED|
|Due to attaining the 9th Cycle of Katharsis, you have gained the distinction of:|
|ABSOLUTE IMMOVABLE OBJECT|
|This is a quality mainly gained by those with THE Absolute Depth.|
|You have achieved it at THE Fundamental Depth.|
|This is unprecedented.|
|Boons of the Distinction of Absolute Immovable Object|

|1. Absolute Existential Anchoring: Your existence is now anchored to reality at a fundamental level. Attempts to displace, banish, or forcibly relocate you require authority that exceeds your total Weight. For most beings below Absolute classification, this is unfathomably hard.|

|2. Declaration Resistance: Declarations that target your existence directly must overcome the cumulative Weight of all your Depths simultaneously. This creates layered defense that compounds with each foundation.|

|3. Immutable Core: The core of your existence cannot be altered by external forces without your consent. Existential control and manipulation, and existence rewriting face resistance proportional to your total refined Weight.|
|4. Absolute Gravitational Authority: Your Weight passively influences reality around you. Lesser beings will feel instinctive pressure in your presence.|
|5. Collapse Resistance: Complete collapse of your existence now requires force sufficient to overcome all refined Depths simultaneously. Partial damage will not cascade into total failure.|

|WARNING: This distinction does not make you invincible. Absolutes possess authority that can still challenge these protections. But for all beings below Absolute classification, you have become functionally immovable.|
|Even though sufficient information has not been fully collected regarding the comparative Depth of THE Creature and others at Fundamental classification...|
|A rough and potentially inaccurate estimation has been made.|
|Current Fundamental Depth Weight: Approximately 2/100th of THE Creature’s Fundamental Depth|
|This disparity appears significant, but context is required.|
|ANALYSIS|
|It is hypothesized that THE Creature and others felt the insufficiencies of their prior foundations at THE Surface and Intermediate Depths.|
|In order to build a strong foundation for the sake of becoming Absolutes, their Fundamental Depths were built to unfathomable levels.|
|They may have spent eons at Fundamental classification, accumulating Weight that you have only begun to gather.|
|As of now, all of this stands to only be conjecture.|
|There could be another reason for the disparity.|
|Further data collection is required for accurate assessment.|
|Your Surface and Intermediate foundations now exceed all known parameters.|
|Focus on building Fundamental Depth to match.|
|The ceiling has not been found.|
The prompts were heavy to observe.
But Noah’s eyes remained brilliant as he felt the changes of his foundation and Seals.

Each of the 27 Seals of Absolute Tongue had become so dense that they felt like collapsed Folds embedded in his existence. When he focused on any single one, he could feel its Weight pressing against the fabric of reality itself. They no longer merely represented compressed power. They had become anchors that tethered him to Existence at fundamental levels.

His Physique of THE Indestructible Lexicon of Absolute Weight had transformed into something that transcended its previous state. What had once been impossibly heavy now felt like the foundation upon which Primordial Mountains could be built. Upon which civilizations could stand. Upon which even the machinations of Absolutes could be resisted.

The distinction ofAbsolute Immovable Objectthrummed through every fiber of his being. He could feel reality bending slightly around him, space itself acknowledging that he had become something that could not be easily displaced!
A Fundamental Depth entity could hit him, and he wouldn’t even be forced to move back a step!
As he analyzed all of this...
In the corner of his eye, he saw the visage of Glossikos rising up fully from the Pool of Lethe.
With a frown.

Her glorious figure of a Dryad emerged from the obsidian-gold waters with grace that belied the displeasure on her features. Vines and leaves that composed her hair dripped with liquid that seemed reluctant to leave her form. Her bark-like skin glistened with moisture that caught the light of the artificial sky.

The immensity she gave off was unmistakable. Even rising from a casual bath, she radiated authority that pressed against everything around her. The air grew heavier. The steam swirled in patterns that spoke of power being exerted without conscious effort.
Her frown quickly became anger.
Something had happened.
Noah frowned as well.
"What happened?"
His voice came sharp with concern.
Glossikos’s obsidian-blue eyes blazed.
"THE Weavers, now at the Lochagos ranking, have been granted a special Right of Challenge that cannot be denied."
Her voice dripped with distaste.
"By Paradoxos."
"A Polemarch can deny such a challenge with the support of a Strategos. But a Lochagos or Hoplite cannot refuse when the Right is properly invoked."
"She must have discovered that you cannot be challenged directly. Your Polemarch status, combined with my backing, makes you untouchable through normal means."
Oh?
Noah frowned deeper.
And Glossikos continued, her anger barely contained.
"THE Weavers have uniquely issued the Right to Challenge... to a dog instead."
BOOM!
The words landed like hammer blows.
"To the Hoplite Muspeli Lifeform you left out there. I assume it is to force your hand. Or perhaps them making a move before you can advance too much."
BOOM!
Noah’s eyes opened wide.
But there was no panic in them.
Only burning calmness and immensity.
His dog?
THE Weavers went after his dog?!
Skoll.
The transformed Duke who had followed him loyally since Muspelheim not too long ago!
The good boy who sat waiting patiently while his Master refined his foundations.
The innocent creature who had no understanding of the machinations occurring around him.
THE Weavers had targeted Skoll!

Even rising from a casual bath, she radiated authority that pressed against everything around her.
The air grew heavier.
The steam swirled in patterns that spoke of power being exerted without conscious effort.
Her frown quickly became anger.
Something had happened.
Noah frowned as well.
"What happened?"
His voice came sharp with concern.
Glossikos’s obsidian-blue eyes blazed.
"THE Weavers, now at the Lochagos ranking, have been granted a special Right of Challenge that cannot be denied."
Her voice dripped with distaste.
"By Paradoxos."
"A Polemarch can deny such a challenge with the support of a Strategos.
But a Lochagos or Hoplite cannot refuse when the Right is properly invoked."
"She must have discovered that you cannot be challenged directly.
Your Polemarch status, combined with my backing, makes you untouchable through normal means."
Oh?
Noah frowned deeper.
And Glossikos continued, her anger barely contained.
"THE Weavers have uniquely issued the Right to Challenge... to a dog instead."
BOOM!
The words landed like hammer blows.
"To the Hoplite Muspeli Lifeform you left out there.
I assume it is to force your hand.
Or perhaps them making a move before you can advance too much."
BOOM!
Noah’s eyes opened wide.
But there was no panic in them.
Only burning calmness and immensity.
His dog?
THE Weavers went after his dog?!
Skoll.
The transformed Duke who had followed him loyally since Muspelheim not too long ago!
The good boy who sat waiting patiently while his Master refined his foundations.
The innocent creature who had no understanding of the machinations occurring around him.
THE Weavers had targeted Skoll!

chapters.title: Chapter 4787: Egregious! I
paragraphs: One could make many mistakes in life.
But some mistakes were so unfathomably egregious compared to others that someone had to ask... why would that person do that?
Hunt Noah? Okay, not a problem.
Scheme and plan and make things difficult for him? No problem! Struggles were part of Existence, after all!
But why would they go after his dog that he had just gotten a chance to be with in such a short time span?
For him, the matter of time was actually inconsequential when it came to the relationship itself.

The moment that Duke passed from the hands of Galileo and came to him. The moment that he awakened him from Duke to Skoll. The moment that this simple dog helped him rescue others of his Civilization and even escape the hands of an Absolute.
At the moment all of these things came to pass, Duke was already part of his camp.
Part of his family.
The time of it did not matter too much.
Bonds were not measured in duration. They were measured in weight. In meaning. In the willingness to stand beside someone at times of great difficulty.
Skoll had stood beside him.
And now THE Weavers had targeted him?
As if THE Weavers had seen all of this, she had decided to skip Lumivara and Ul’moreth. She went straight for his dog. The innocent one.
It was an utterly egregious mistake.
One that Noah would be sure to let THE Weavers know to their last breath.
Glossikos spoke with measured calm.
"The challenge has already been issued. Your dog has been directly transported to the Arena."
Her obsidian-blue eyes studied him.
"A few other things seem to be happening behind the scenes. But what will you do?"
What he would do was already set in stone.
Now, it just meant that it would happen with even more brutality and blood.
Noah’s eyes pulsed with the weight of the Seal of Infinity. Blue-gold radiance spilled from his gaze as if his very perception had become weaponized.
"I’m sure they did this to pull me out. So I will put myself forward."
His voice came cold and absolute.
"Pass the word for me. I will stand to replace the one that THE Weavers have challenged."
The figure of Glossikos sighed and lightly nodded.
"Absolute is Absolute, regardless of where you currently stand."
Her voice carried warning.
"If you are not an Absolute yourself, regardless of how astonishing you are..."
She did not finish her words.
As if their ending would truly not be a great one.
But she did continue.
"Originally, there is another location within this Villa Dei Boscoreale apart from The Thermae of Cyclic Refinement that would have served you well."
Her eyes grew distant with contemplation.
"It is filled with items and weapons that have a level of power similar to, or even sometimes exceeding, Fragments of Axioms."
Her gaze returned to him.
"This region is THE Mouseion of Fated Artifacts. The Museum of Destiny."
She began to explain.
"THE Mouseion of Fated Artifacts contains item-based treasures. Unlike the Thermae where consumption is guaranteed to provide benefits, the Mouseion operates on principles of fate and worthiness."
Her voice grew more serious.
"If one is fated to receive a particular artifact, they will be drawn to it and the barriers will part. If one is not fated, the barriers remain impenetrable regardless of power level."
She paused for emphasis.
"Even Absolutes cannot force their way to artifacts not meant for them."
Her hand waved, and images seemed to shimmer in the steam around them.
"Some items include The Stylus of Cadmus. A bronze writing implement that never dulls. Anything written with this stylus becomes a binding Declaration for 24 hours."
The image shifted.
"The Lyre of Orpheus. A golden stringed instrument that plays itself when held. Music from this lyre can influence emotions of beings up to one Depth above the player."
Another shift.
"The Thread of Ariadne. An unbreakable golden thread on a spindle. It always leads the holder to what they truly seek."
The images continued to flicker.
"The Caduceus Shard. A fragment of the original herald’s staff. It allows communication across any distance. It can broker truces that cannot be broken."
She dismissed the images with a wave.
"There are countless others. Weapons that can pierce through Declarations. Shields that can absorb the weight of Absolutes. Items that defy conventional understanding of what is possible."
Glossikos looked at him directly.
"I’ll make sure you don’t miss that opportunity."
Her voice grew practical.
"Give me a unique signature of your Depth and I will take it to THE Mouseion of Fated Artifacts. Whatever is fated for you... will come to you anywhere in THE Agora of Primordial Judgment."
Her smile held a dangerous edge.
"Even while you are facing THE Weavers in the Arena."
She said such words as Noah nodded.
He waved his hand.

A brilliant blue-gold Seal of Infinity emerged from his palm, spinning with authority that told of foundations refined beyond normal parameters. It carried the unique signature of his Depth. The weight of his existence compressed into a single spinning construct.
His dominating body turned around.
And disappeared a moment later.
The Seal of Infinity continued spinning toward Glossikos like a coin flipping through air.
She grasped it in her hands.
She looked it over up and down with careful attention. The weight of it. The density of it. The sheer authority compressed into something so small.
A contemplative look entered her eyes.
"Would he truly be able to make a significant enough difference?"
An Absolute wondered.
And it was a wonder in itself as to what exactly she was contemplating.
Was she thinking about the battle ahead?
Was she thinking about the future of THE Agora of Primordial Judgment?
Or was she thinking about something else entirely?
Something that only Absolutes knew?
The questions hung in the steam-filled air of The Thermae as Glossikos began moving toward THE Mouseion of Fated Artifacts.
Carrying the signature of THE Genesis Monarch with her.

chapters.title: Chapter 4788: Egregious! II
paragraphs: Outside of THE Villa Dei Boscoreale.
WAP!
Noah reappeared.

He observed the solemn and angered figures of Ul’moreth and Lumivara who now had on the togas of Lochagoi. Their advancement had occurred while he was undergoing the Cycles of Katharsis. Their expressions spoke of fury barely contained.

The Glossarian Polemarchs were also in the surroundings with equally nasty gazes. They had welcomed Noah. They had protected his companions. And now THE Weavers had circumvented their protection through bureaucratic manipulation.
Skoll was nowhere to be seen.
Lunaris turned toward Noah as she was going to speak when...
Her figure pulsed with astonishment!
She sensed the immensity his figure emanated!
Especially now, when he looked a little bit... mad?

His crystalline skin glowed with blue-gold radiance. His eyes burned with weight that pressed against everyone in proximity. His presence alone made the air heavier, made breathing slightly more difficult, made reality itself acknowledge that something dangerous had arrived.
He looked devilishly dashing with such a serious gaze, didn’t he?
The moment she had such a thought, she shook her pages as she refocused on the situation at hand.
"Sir, they have already taken your companion due to a Challenge that even we could not deny."
Her voice came serious and professional.
"The Esteemed Glossikos has informed us. We are ready to bring you to the Arena for you to accept this challenge instead."
She paused.
"We do have to warn you that now, you will be under the scrutiny of all those in THE Agora of Primordial Judgment."
She said such words as Noah turned to her, reigning in his unfolding waves of Tyranny.
The pressure that had been pressing against everyone eased slightly.
But only slightly.
His voice came out calm.
Too calm.
The kind of calm that preceded storms.
"Let’s just go."
His eyes burned with blue-gold fire.
"Some Absolutes need to understand what happens when they make someone lock in."
BOOM!
The words landed with weight that made several Polemarchs take unconscious steps backward.
Not from fear of him.
But from recognition that whoever stood on the other side of that statement was about to experience something terrible.
Lunaris nodded and began leading the way.
Toward the Arena.
Toward THE Weavers.
Toward a confrontation that would be witnessed by every faction in THE Agora of Primordial Judgment.
And Noah followed with steps that made the ground tremble, Ul’moreth and Lumivara joining him as brilliant blue-gold light began to wrap around all of them!
THE Palaestra of Primordial Reckoning!

This was the name and distinction of the grand Arena within THE Agora of Primordial Judgment. It was a place of existential and combat training where battles determined fundamental truths about the combatants’ worth and existence.
Different factions called it by different names.

Glossarians called it "The Lexicon of Blood," where Declarations were written in violence. Paradoxians called it "The Contradiction Ring," where impossibilities became possible. Existentialists called it "The Crucible of Being," where existence was tested. Chaosites called it "The Entropy Pit," where order broke down into beautiful disorder.
Four names for one place.
All of them true.
THE Palaestra of Primordial Reckoning sat at the exact center of THE Agora of Primordial Judgment, equidistant from all four philosophical territories.

It was accessible from any faction’s domain through dedicated pathways called "The Roads of Reckoning." These roads were neutral ground where no faction held authority. Stone inscribed with Phonemes of The First Tongue paved the way, each step a reminder that this place belonged to everyone and no one.
The Arena existed partially underground and partially above, creating a structure that resembled a massive amphitheater built into a depression in reality itself.
Some said the depression was created by a battle between THE Creature and THE Primordial Chaos during the Infinite Unfurling. Others said it was always here, waiting for conflict to fill it.
The truth was likely somewhere in between.

The Arena itself looked like a colossal structure of bronze, marble, and crystallized Existence. Its outer walls rose approximately 500 meters high, covered in bas-reliefs depicting legendary battles.
THE Entities clashed across the stonework. Absolutes warred in frozen tableaus. The history of violence made beautiful through artistic preservation.
Noah floated across the vast roads leading to this place.
Polemarchs surrounded him, their presence a statement of Glossarian support. Ul’moreth and Lumivara flanked him, their newly achieved Lochagos togas marking their advancement within this domain.
Beside him, Ul’moreth had a worried look as he spoke.
"Absolute is difficult. Truly difficult, even if weakened to a lesser level."
His countless hairs rippled with concern.
"A redundant sentence has been said that Absolutes can only ever Absolutely be taken down by other Absolutes. Do you have a plan?"
A plan.
Noah kept his eyes ahead as he replied.
"An idea of a plan. Audacious and ridiculous by all accounts, but an idea of a plan."
Ul’moreth fell silent as he nodded.

What else could he say? His Little Anomaly had grown into something that exceeded comprehension. If anyone could find a way to challenge an Absolute without being one, it would be THE Genesis Monarch.
Ahead, Lunaris, Ophelia, and others led them through The Gate of Tongues.

The Glossarian entrance stood before them, constructed from pages of crystallized knowledge fused into solid form. Every known Logos and Philology covered its surface in inscriptions so dense they seemed to shimmer with accumulated meaning. The gate itself seemed alive, aware of those who approached it.
There were many Glossarians by the hundreds crossing into the Arena at this moment. Hoplites and Lochagoi streamed through the entrance, drawn by word that something significant was about to occur.
Lunaris and Ophelia passed through first.
The moment they crossed the threshold, the gate spoke.
"Polemarch Lunaris has entered The Palaestra of Primordial Reckoning."
The voice was ancient and resonant, carrying across the surrounding area.
"Lochagos Ophelia has entered The Palaestra of Primordial Reckoning."
Each name was recited with the same weight, the same significance.
And when Noah finally passed through...
"THE Genesis Monarch has entered The Palaestra of Primordial Reckoning."
BOOM!
His name burned with glory!
