chapters.title: Chapter 4805: Everything II
paragraphs: With all this knowledge regarding Chaos and Entropy and malformations, it all pointed to signs of Chaos truly being the most powerful.
But...there seemed to be more information he needed to obtain to better grasp this as he moved his thoughts elsewhere.
As THE Weaver of Existenc, he had many names, but he truly was a farmer at heart.

The task Absolutes had of purifying Existence and increasing its continued stability while they benefited from it was an act of cultivation and harvesting he would no doubt enjoy. It was not so different from tending fields or nurturing crops. You removed the weeds. You fed the soil. You reaped the rewards.
The scale was simply different.
Where a farmer might tend to acres, he would tend to portions of Observable Existence itself.
But as he received waves and waves of information, one singular ideology became abundantly clear.

Absolutes were a critical and glorious source of Weavings that Observable Existence very much loved. Otherwise, why would it mourn for the collapse of an Absolute? Why would the fabric of reality itself tremble when one of them ceased to be?
It was because Absolutes gave back.
Their very existence was a net positive for all of Observable Existence.
And now Noah understood why THE Secretive Eon had spoken of replacement rather than mere collapse. Why she had emphasized that when she killed an Absolute, nothing was lost.
Because if you killed an Absolute without replacing them, you robbed Observable Existence of one of its caretakers.
You created a wound that would never heal.
But at this point...
Noah sat upon the Throne of THE Weavers.
No.
The Throne of THE Weaver of Existence.
It was his now.

The three seats fused into one supported his weight with the recognition of legitimate inheritance. The golden threads that extended from it in all directions had turned blue-gold where they connected to his existence. The illusory figures of THE Weavers behind him continued their hymns, but the songs had shifted from mourning to something that sounded almost like welcome.
He tapped his finger on the armrest thoughtfully.

His body was surrounded by countless golden strings that pulsed with the rhythm of fate itself. Through them, he could see the endless waves of Corrupted Growths surrounding the many lines of Principles related to Fate. Green and obsidian parasites clustering around pure concepts, feeding on them, slowly transforming order into chaos.
He could express his Formless Depth upon them and purify them.
It would be simple enough.
But...
"I have claimed The First Tongue."
HUUM!
His voice boomed like a grand king making a command rather than a request.
The Palace trembled in response. The golden threads vibrated with recognition of his authority. The hymns behind him swelled with anticipation.
"I wish to observe and purify Malformed Authorities, Corrupted Growths... that permeate all across The First Tongue."
BOOM!
Blue-gold light erupted from him!

It mixed with the pillar of golden light representing the inheritance of THE Weavers, creating a radiance that was both Fate and Language intertwined. His Immensity. His Formless Depth. His continued absorption of the Depth of an Absolute.
He exerted all of it!

|THE Weaver of Existence seeks to observe the interactions of Observable Existence where all of The First Tongue permeates, and this is a lofty goal. Even THE Weavers, Absolutes who had existed since before THE Fallout, could only barely glimpse and perceive all the Principles relating to Fate among other things for them to cleanse Existence through.|
|But THE Weavers did not lay a Claim over The First Tongue, as they were limited to their domain of Fate, and you are not so limited.|

|Due to your current Depth and Immensity, paired with the access you gained by collapsing an Absolute, an unknown percentage of THE First Tongue and how it interacts with Observable Existence is free for observation and manipulation at the mostbasic degree.|
|The percentage is small compared to the totality, but it is vast compared to what any non-Absolute has ever perceived.|
|Open your eyes, THE Weaver of Existence, and see what you have claimed.|
BOOM!
The moment such a prompt came, Noah’s eyes pulsed with light!
He saw everything become covered in blue-gold brilliance.
Everything!

In THE Agora of Primordial Judgment, The First Tongue permeated through every faction’s territory like an invisible ocean that all beings swam through without knowing. The Glossarians naturally had denser concentrations, but even the Paradoxians and Chaosites and Existentialists utilized language. Even they spoke. Even they wrote. Even they thought in words that were derivatives of The First Tongue.

In THE Corrupted Vault of Ginnungagap, The First Tongue filtered through the ancient Primordial Realm with threads that connected to secrets older than most Absolutes. The Nexus Point between Primordial Realms blazed with concentrated linguistic authority where fundamental truths about Existence had first been spoken into being.

In the nearby Wastes of THE Fallout, even corruption could not erase The First Tongue. It persisted through the chaos, words of power that had survived THE Living Paradox’s attempt to reshape reality. Corrupted, yes. Twisted, certainly. But still present. Still readable to one who had laid claim to their authority.
All of it had The First Tongue permeating across it!
He saw how The First Tongue, how Mana, filtered through the gaps of Weavings of everything like an endless blue-gold sea!
It was not merely present.
It was fundamental.
It wove through the components of the other three Weavings of the Oldest Paradox of Existence in ways that were both complementary and essential.

Where Paradox twisted reality, The First Tongue provided the framework for that twisting. Where Chaos disrupted order, The First Tongue gave names to that disruption. Where Existence simply was, The First Tongue described what that being meant.
The First Tongue touched all of them.

He perceived all lines of Principles nearby, golden threads of Fate and silver threads of other concepts and crimson threads of yet others, all of them surrounded by the blue-gold sea of linguistic authority. He even sensed all of THE Infiniverse, his own Early Veiled Shore where his Civilization grew and flourished.

He felt portions of Muspelheim, the Primordial Realm of fire where Skoll had originated. He touched the edges of the Early Veiled Shore of THE Creature himself, that vast domain where the most powerful of THE Four had built his Belly of Existence.
And moments later, Noah could also perceive the countless Corrupted Growths hugging different areas of this sea like parasites or weeds.
They were everywhere.
But not evenly distributed.
Some areas were fairly empty of them, the blue-gold sea running clean and pure as if they had recently been cleansed. These regions sparkled with stability that spoke of diligent maintenance.

Other areas were more filled with corruption, green-obsidian masses clustering around linguistic concepts and slowly transforming their meanings. These areas had not been cleansed in a while, or corruption was propagating at higher frequencies due to instability in the underlying Weavings.
Noah observed the patterns with the calculating eye of a farmer assessing his fields.
The regions most infected with Corrupted Growths were concentrated primarily in two areas.
Paradox.
And Existence!

You created a wound that would never heal.
But at this point...
Noah sat upon the Throne of THE Weavers.
No.
The Throne of THE Weaver of Existence.
It was his now.
The three seats fused into one supported his weight with the recognition of legitimate inheritance.
The golden threads that extended from it in all directions had turned blue-gold where they connected to his existence.
The illusory figures of THE Weavers behind him continued their hymns, but the songs had shifted from mourning to something that sounded almost like welcome.
He tapped his finger on the armrest thoughtfully.
His body was surrounded by countless golden strings that pulsed with the rhythm of fate itself.
Through them, he could see the endless waves of Corrupted Growths surrounding the many lines of Principles related to Fate.
Green and obsidian parasites clustering around pure concepts, feeding on them, slowly transforming order into chaos.
He could express his Formless Depth upon them and purify them.
It would be simple enough.
But...
"I have claimed The First Tongue."
HUUM!
His voice boomed like a grand king making a command rather than a request.
The Palace trembled in response.
The golden threads vibrated with recognition of his authority.
The hymns behind him swelled with anticipation.
"I wish to observe and purify Malformed Authorities, Corrupted Growths... that permeate all across The First Tongue."
BOOM!
Blue-gold light erupted from him!
It mixed with the pillar of golden light representing the inheritance of THE Weavers, creating a radiance that was both Fate and Language intertwined.
His Immensity.
His Formless Depth.
His continued absorption of the Depth of an Absolute.
He exerted all of it!
|THE Weaver of Existence seeks to observe the interactions of Observable Existence where all of The First Tongue permeates, and this is a lofty goal.

Even THE Weavers, Absolutes who had existed since before THE Fallout, could only barely glimpse and perceive all the Principles relating to Fate among other things for them to cleanse Existence through.|
|But THE Weavers did not lay a Claim over The First Tongue, as they were limited to their domain of Fate, and you are not so limited.|

|Due to your current Depth and Immensity, paired with the access you gained by collapsing an Absolute, an unknown percentage of THE First Tongue and how it interacts with Observable Existence is free for observation and manipulation at the mostbasic degree.|
|The percentage is small compared to the totality, but it is vast compared to what any non-Absolute has ever perceived.|
|Open your eyes, THE Weaver of Existence, and see what you have claimed.|
BOOM!
The moment such a prompt came, Noah’s eyes pulsed with light!
He saw everything become covered in blue-gold brilliance.
Everything!
In THE Agora of Primordial Judgment, The First Tongue permeated through every faction’s territory like an invisible ocean that all beings swam through without knowing.
The Glossarians naturally had denser concentrations, but even the Paradoxians and Chaosites and Existentialists utilized language.
Even they spoke.
Even they wrote.
Even they thought in words that were derivatives of The First Tongue.
In THE Corrupted Vault of Ginnungagap, The First Tongue filtered through the ancient Primordial Realm with threads that connected to secrets older than most Absolutes.
The Nexus Point between Primordial Realms blazed with concentrated linguistic authority where fundamental truths about Existence had first been spoken into being.
In the nearby Wastes of THE Fallout, even corruption could not erase The First Tongue.
It persisted through the chaos, words of power that had survived THE Living Paradox’s attempt to reshape reality.
Corrupted, yes.
Twisted, certainly.
But still present.
Still readable to one who had laid claim to their authority.
All of it had The First Tongue permeating across it!
He saw how The First Tongue, how Mana, filtered through the gaps of Weavings of everything like an endless blue-gold sea!
It was not merely present.
It was fundamental.
It wove through the components of the other three Weavings of the Oldest Paradox of Existence in ways that were both complementary and essential.
Where Paradox twisted reality, The First Tongue provided the framework for that twisting.
Where Chaos disrupted order, The First Tongue gave names to that disruption.
Where Existence simply was, The First Tongue described what that being meant.
The First Tongue touched all of them.

He perceived all lines of Principles nearby, golden threads of Fate and silver threads of other concepts and crimson threads of yet others, all of them surrounded by the blue-gold sea of linguistic authority.
He even sensed all of THE Infiniverse, his own Early Veiled Shore where his Civilization grew and flourished.
He felt portions of Muspelheim, the Primordial Realm of fire where Skoll had originated.
He touched the edges of the Early Veiled Shore of THE Creature himself, that vast domain where the most powerful of THE Four had built his Belly of Existence.
And moments later, Noah could also perceive the countless Corrupted Growths hugging different areas of this sea like parasites or weeds.
They were everywhere.
But not evenly distributed.
Some areas were fairly empty of them, the blue-gold sea running clean and pure as if they had recently been cleansed.
These regions sparkled with stability that spoke of diligent maintenance.
Other areas were more filled with corruption, green-obsidian masses clustering around linguistic concepts and slowly transforming their meanings.
These areas had not been cleansed in a while, or corruption was propagating at higher frequencies due to instability in the underlying Weavings.
Noah observed the patterns with the calculating eye of a farmer assessing his fields.
The regions most infected with Corrupted Growths were concentrated primarily in two areas.
Paradox.
And Existence!

chapters.title: Chapter 4806: Everything III
paragraphs: The Weavings related to THE Living Paradox were absolutely crawling with corruption. It made sense given what Noah now understood.
THE Living Paradox spread instability through his very actions. His changes to reality created byproducts of malformation that naturally accumulated around anything connected to him.
The Weavings related to THE Creature were also surprisingly infected.
But Chaos...
Chaos was actually relatively clean.
It did not make sense!
Was THE Primordial Chaos more diligent than even Paradox and THE Creature?
The being who represented disorder and entropy was somehow maintaining his domain with more care than those who represented existence and contradiction?

Noah filed this information away for later contemplation. There was something there. Some insight into the nature of THE Primordial Chaos that contradicted his apparent philosophy. Some secret hidden in the cleanliness of Chaos that spoke of intentions not yet revealed.
But for now, he had work to do.
Noah perceived all of this before he shook his head and focused.
In the next moment, he began forming a Logos with his Seals of Absolute Tongue.

The Seals that were branded across his skin blazed with incandescent light. They rotated around his form, aligning themselves according to principles that transcended normal linguistic construction. Letters combined. Sounds merged. Meaning crystallized.
A word formed.
A word of power.
A word that carried the authority of THE Weaver of Existence, THE Genesis Monarch of Infinite Lexicons.
CLEANSE!
BOOOM!
He did not need to use it like this.

He could have just utilized his Depth and expressed it to press down on all the Corrupted Growths he saw. It would have been efficient. It would have been effective. It would have accomplished the same goal with less expenditure of authority.
But he did it because he could.
He did it because he wanted to see what would happen when The First Tongue itself commanded corruption to cease.
He did it because he was a farmer, and a farmer took pride in the tools of his trade.
In the next moment, a blinding blue-gold light permeated over everything Noah had the visibility to see!
It spread like dawn breaking across an endless horizon!
It washed over THE Agora of Primordial Judgment, touching every corner of that vast domain where four philosophical factions competed for supremacy.
It spread through THE Corrupted Vault of Ginnungagap.

It spread into the nearby Wastes, pushing back against corruption that had seemed eternal. For just a moment, for just a breath, some regions of the Wastes of THE Fallout became slightly less chaotic. Slightly more stable. Slightly more like what they had been before THE Living Paradox had scarred reality itself.
And as soon as his cleansing light passed over it, all the countless Corrupted Growths across different regions of Observable Existence that he could see and grasp trembled!
They shriveled!

The green-obsidian masses that had been feeding on purity found themselves facing authority that transcended their parasitic existence. They could not resist. They could not flee. They could only transform.
They turned into pure white-gold light!

The corruption that had been feeding on The First Tongue was converted back into Pure Civilizational Authority that then sank and permeated into the surrounding Observable Existence. What had been poison became medicine. What had been degradation became nourishment. What had been entropy became stability.
All the lines representing golden threads of Principles related to Fate became clean.
All the endless blue-gold seas permeating over everything that Noah saw became free of any Corrupted Growths.
And as this cleansing finished, the affected regions seemed to shine even more brightly!

The First Tongue ran cleaner through Weavings that had been partially clogged with corruption. Principles pulsed with renewed vigor now that parasites no longer fed upon them. Nearby Existence itself seemed to breathe easier in the regions that Noah had touched.
And as this action finished...
BOOM!
Noah felt a loud boom in his mind and existence!
A heavy and unfathomable thing emerged within him!
It was not Depth. It was not Weight. It was not any of the conventional measurements of power that he had grown accustomed to tracking.
It was something else entirely.
Something that felt like concentrated wonder from Observable Existence itself.
|Purification Complete|
|You have cleansed a significant portion of Existence and contributed to the net positive stability of Observable Existence, and this contribution has been recognized.|

|Finally, for the first time in your existence, you are a significant contributing member of Civilization, of Observable Existence, as before this moment you only took and harvested and consumed and grew through the collapse of others, which is not wrong since it is how the strong become stronger, but it is not the only way.|

|The grander the contributors of Observable Existence are, the grander Observable Existence is, and vice versa, because Observable Existence is vast and seemingly endless but it does not exist by itself as it is not a passive backdrop against which events unfold, but rather a living musing woven from the contributions of all who exist within it.|
|Those within it decide just how immense they are, and as a result, how immense Observable Existence itself becomes.|
|You have decided to be immense, and Observable Existence has thus become enen more immense.|
The prompts were heavy, but Noah only gave them a glance.
His attention was focused on what was emerging in his existence.

He looked inward, toward THE Organ of Civilization where his Ways and Depths were housed. Where his Civilizations of Mana and Hunger flowed through. Where the newly inherited Derivative Civilization of Undifferentiated Fate had begun flowing.
And there, forming among these foundations, was something new.

It looked like a cluster of mobius strips wrapping around each other endlessly, surfaces that had no true beginning or end, edges that connected to themselves in impossible geometries. It pulsed with light that was simultaneously all colors and no color. It hummed with a frequency that resonated with the very fabric of Observable Existence.
And it was fucking heavy.
Fat and heavy!

chapters.title: Chapter 4807: Everything IV
paragraphs: Even just perceiving it made Noah’s foundations tremble with the effort of containing its weight. It pressed against the boundaries of his existence as if testing whether he was worthy of housing it!
|Absolute Everything Formed|

|You have cleansed a large portion of Existence and formed your first genuine Absolute Everything of your existence, which represents the currency of Absolutes and marks your first step on a path that only Absolutes can walk.|

|An Absolute Everything is condensed potential that can be utilized in ways that normal authority cannot, as where lesser beings accumulate Depth and Weight and Civilizational Authority, Absolutes accumulate Absolute Everythings that are formed through an expression of their own power, or when an Absolute contributes significantly to Observable Existence in ways that lesser beings cannot.|
|Purifying corruption, stabilizing Weavings, and maintaining the fabric of reality itself are all actions that generate Absolute Everythings due to the net positive gained from such actions.|
|Absolute Everything Properties and Utilizations|

|Depth Elevation: Absolute Everythings can be consumed to directly elevate Depth without the need for conventional advancement, as where a normal being must accumulate authority over eons to reach Absolute, one who possesses sufficient Absolute Everythings can simply forge an unquestionable Foundation to act as a stairway to Absolute by converting this currency into pure Depth.|

|Axiom Utilization: Absolute Everythings can serve as fuel for Axioms, and where THE Axiom of Absolute Denial currently resists your usage due to insufficient Depth, feeding it an Absolute Everything would allow temporary activation regardless of your classification, with the more complete the Axiom, the more Absolute Everythings required for full utilization.|

|Artifact Nurturing: Absolute-tier Artifacts like the Golden Scissors of Fate require Absolute Everythings to reach their full potential when wielded by non-Absolutes, as an Absolute Everything fed to such an artifact creates a temporary bond that allows usage and even forging of similar items.|
|Existence Manipulation: Absolute Everythings can be expended to perform actions that would normally require Absolute Depth, allowing for Embodiments and other forms of expressions.|
|Absolutes maintain Observable Existence with such diligence because they are not being altruistic but rather gaining Absolute Everythings through large cleansings of Corrupted Growths.|
|The gap between Absolutes and non-Absolutes is not merely one of Depth but one of access, as Absolutes have access to Absolute Everythings while non-Absolutes do not, at least until now.|

|You, THE Weaver of Existence, have bridged that gap by forming your first Absolute Everything without being an Absolute yourself, accessing the currency that fuels the most powerful beings in Observable Existence while still being below their classification.|
Noah stared at the cluster of mobius strips rotating within his existence.
His first Absolute Everything.

It was something unique to feel as around the same time that he was analyzing the cluster of mobius strips within his existence, another set of prompts came down with information that made his foundations pulse with recognition.
|Absolute Depth Absorption Complete|

|The recoverable Depth of an Absolute has been fully absorbed and distributed across your recovered Fundamental Depth foundation, or really, within your Formless Depth that defies conventional classification.|

|Although it may be inaccurate due to the limited data available on the foundations of THE Four during their earlier stages, it has been estimated that devouring the recoverable Depth of an Absolute like THE Weavers has reinforced your Fundamental Depth weight and immensity to be approximately 25% comparable to that of THE Creature or THE Primordial Chaos when they crossed this stage.|

|Little information is available regarding the foundations of THE Four, but it seems that the foundations built by these beings sought to make up for all the deficiencies of weight in their prior Depths before they took a step to become Absolutes with unquestionable foundations.|
|They spent eons at Fundamental Depth, building weight that would support their eventual ascension.|
|You have achieved 25% of that weight in a fraction of the time through the consumption of an Absolute.|
|Civilizational Status|
|Primary Civilization: THE Primordial Civilization of Mana(THE First Tongue)|
|Classification: Formless Depth (unplaceable within conventional categories)|
|Status: Primary vessel for all authority, containing foundations that exceed THE Creature at Surface and Intermediate classifications while approaching meaningful comparison at Fundamental|
|Derivative Civilization: Hunger|
|Classification: THE Fundamental Depth|
|Status: Fully integrated, contributing to Perpetual Harvest and consumption-based advancement|
|Derivative Civilization: Undifferentiated Fate|
|Classification: THE Fundamental Depth|
|Status: Newly inherited from THE Weavers, provides access to fate perception and manipulation across Observable Existence|
|Derivative Civilization: Elemental|
|Classification: Pre-THE|
|Status: (Will you continue your encroachment on your most hated enemy in existence?)|
The vibrant pressure around him calmed.
He remained on the throne as he was still receiving waves of information from different sources, but at this moment, he raised his hand and clenched his fist as...
BZZT!
A terrifying pressure emanated from him!

It radiated outward from his existence with weight that would have crushed any Fundamental Depth entity into paste. It pressed against the walls of THE Absolute Existential Palace with authority that made even this domain of a dead Absolute tremble slightly.
He could clearly feel that it was as oppressive as, if not a bit more oppressive than, the Half-Step Absolute Depth of THE Living Spirit!
More immense and grand than someone who was Half-Step Absolute!
|Comparative Assessment Confirmed|

|Your current Depth and Weight exceeds the Half-Step Absolute classification as demonstrated by THE Living Spirit and similar entities, and if you were to meet THE Living Spirit again, you could potentially curb stomp him without utilizing any Axioms or special artifacts. It may be time to say hi to THE Living Concept.|
|You have devoured an Absolute, and this simple action alone will make it extremely hard to find any enemy below Absolute Depth capable of going against you.|

|At most, Half-Step Absolutes, depending on who they are and what type of treasures or Axiom fragments they carry, could give you a challenge, but even then, your Formless Depth and the foundations you have built that exceed THE Creature at multiple classifications would provide advantages that most Half-Step Absolutes simply cannot overcome.|
|You are no longer prey for anything below Absolute.|
The affirmation was a grand one as Noah gave a light nod while looking at another distant door.

The Tomb of THE Weavers had many things as he sensed that what remained were her memories locked in the Memory Sanctum, but he would come back for these later as right now, he wanted to do a few things.
So he rose up from the throne as golden strings followed him like loyal pets seeking their master’s attention.
But his eyes flashed with authority.
The strings dimmed and disappeared completely, retreating back into the fabric of the Palace to await his return.

The Tomb of THE Weavers could be considered half cleared with many things still in it, including the Golden Scissors of Fate and THE Axiom of Absolute Denial that still resisted his grasp, but it was still his treasury as he would come back to it when his Depth rose further.
For now...
He took a step and disappeared.
HUUM!
He could sense the fates and Mana of all those connected with him, threads of blue-gold that stretched across distances and told him exactly where his people were and what state they were in.

He appeared in the shattered stands of THE Palaestra, right behind Ul’moreth and Lumivara and Skoll who remained where they were, but at this moment, the heavy and interminable auras of Absolutes shockingly pressed around them!
The situation had changed since he had entered the Tomb.

The visage of Paradoxos shockingly floated a distance away from his followers, their dual form radiating menace that would have crushed any Fundamental Depth entity into submission. Four eyes burned with fury that had not diminished since watching Noah collapse their faction’s Absolute.
And Glossikos, this dazzling Dryad, stood in front of Ul’moreth and Lumivara with an imperious expression, her eyes pulsing.

When Noah appeared beside Ul’moreth and Lumivara, both Absolutes gave glances to him that he completely ignored as he got down on one knee and began to play with an excited Skoll who saw his Master return!
The massive dog’s tail wagged with enthusiasm that seemed entirely out of place given the tension filling the air. His neon flames brightened. His tongue lolled out in pure canine joy.
While Noah rubbed his ears and scratched behind his head...
"I wonder what the great Strategoi of THE Agora of Primordial Judgment would be gracing their presence for little things like us."
His voice came casual and unbothered, as if he was not surrounded by beings who could reshape reality with a thought.
"Is there anything we can help you with?"
HUUM!
He did not even gaze at them.
He spoke while playing with his dog as the Absolutes turned over with shining eyes!
The way they looked at him had changed completely!

He appeared in the shattered stands of THE Palaestra, right behind Ul’moreth and Lumivara and Skoll who remained where they were, but at this moment, the heavy and interminable auras of Absolutes shockingly pressed around them!
The situation had changed since he had entered the Tomb.
The visage of Paradoxos shockingly floated a distance away from his followers, their dual form radiating menace that would have crushed any Fundamental Depth entity into submission.
Four eyes burned with fury that had not diminished since watching Noah collapse their faction’s Absolute.
And Glossikos, this dazzling Dryad, stood in front of Ul’moreth and Lumivara with an imperious expression, her eyes pulsing.

When Noah appeared beside Ul’moreth and Lumivara, both Absolutes gave glances to him that he completely ignored as he got down on one knee and began to play with an excited Skoll who saw his Master return!
The massive dog’s tail wagged with enthusiasm that seemed entirely out of place given the tension filling the air.
His neon flames brightened.
His tongue lolled out in pure canine joy.
While Noah rubbed his ears and scratched behind his head...
"I wonder what the great Strategoi of THE Agora of Primordial Judgment would be gracing their presence for little things like us."
His voice came casual and unbothered, as if he was not surrounded by beings who could reshape reality with a thought.
"Is there anything we can help you with?"
HUUM!
He did not even gaze at them.
He spoke while playing with his dog as the Absolutes turned over with shining eyes!
The way they looked at him had changed completely!

chapters.title: Chapter 4808: Vast and Full of Terrors! I
paragraphs: Noah knew the full scope of his power as he did not delude himself into thinking that just because he killed an Absolute, he held the power to stand against another.
He didn’t have the raw power to do that, no.
But there were always musings of Existence that made things complicated for even Absolutes to move at times.
What he did with THE Weavers was a trick that one could say would be nigh impossible to repeat again, as all Absolutes now knew the result of trying to claim what they could not back.

No Absolute would be foolish enough to grasp his Heart after witnessing what had occurred. No Absolute would attempt to claim The First Tongue without knowing they possessed the Infinities required to bear its weight.
That particular trap had been sprung.
It would not work twice.
And also...
THE Agora of Primordial Judgment was a domain with its own rulings, and its Absolutes could not move against him freely.
There were protocols and challenges and rights that protected those who had earned standing within this place.
So he continued moving with the same Immensity and grandness his entire existence emanated, even though he knew that the Absolutes here may not be as powerless as they appeared!
So he asked how he could help them.
And a voice boomed out.
"You are grand."
The words came from Paradoxos, both faces speaking in rare unison with weight that pressed against everyone present.
"By all accounts you are deserving of the standing among THE Four purely from what you did here today."
A pause that felt like it lasted an eternity.
"But you... are not fully there."
The booming voice of Paradoxos echoed out grandly as Noah finally raised his head to glance at this being.

An ugly and grand fucker he was with his two faces that contradicted each other even while saying the same words. Half obsidian, half gold, the division line between them constantly shifting as if reality itself could not decide which half should dominate.
Noah looked at this being, and then at Glossikos who stood between him and Paradoxos.
Had she finally come to a decision and stuck to it?

Because he had seen her greed for his Heart and Claim when he took it out during the battle. He had seen how she had nearly broken through the Arena’s barriers to reach for what he was offering. He had seen the hunger in those obsidian-blue eyes.
And yet here she stood, positioned between him and Paradoxos as if protecting him.
He looked between the two of them as Paradoxos continued with a voice that carried the weight of someone accustomed to being obeyed.
"THE Weavers took something from me that was not theirs. As the one to have claimed their Tomb, you should have obtained it."
Four eyes fixed on Noah with intensity that would have crushed lesser beings into immediate compliance.
"THE Axiom of Absolute Denial. I wish to have this back."
Noah’s eyes shone brightly as he looked over to Paradoxos!

When he used the Lens of Civilization on this being, it returned absolutely nothing useful as this entity was genuinely at the Absolute Depth, beyond the ability of his current perception to accurately assess!
And yet even against him, Noah tilted his head with casual dismissiveness and said with a voice that held no trace of the deference one might expect when addressing an Absolute.
"Oh? So you gave THE Weavers an Axiom that wasn’t theirs before the battle just to guarantee my collapse? Whatever did I do to you to deserve that treatment?"

He spoke casually as he rose up from where he had been playing with Skoll to meet the gaze of Paradoxos, his posture radiating the confidence of someone who had just collapsed an Absolute and felt no need to bow before another!
Paradoxos looked at him calmly, four eyes unblinking, before speaking simply.
"The Axiom of Absolute Denial. The one asking for it back is not me."
HUUM!
The one asking for it back wasn’t Paradoxos.

As the only one who could have the support of another Absolute like Paradoxos, the only one who could demand such things through intermediaries bound to THE Agora, the only one whose request would make a Strategos act as a messenger...
Had to be a single being.
THE Living Paradox.

Noah smiled at the sheer idea alone that he had stolen something belonging to one of THE Four, something that THE Living Paradox had lent to THE Weavers specifically to guarantee their victory against him, and he smiled even wider as he said with cheerful defiance that bordered on mockery.
"Even if THE Creature stood where you stand and demanded such a thing from me, I would still say no."
His voice moved across the ruined Palaestra with weight that made his words feel like Declarations rather than mere statements.
"And regardless, Existence is so vast and filled with wonders that we should not place importance on items so much. Do not worry about a mere Axiom, O Great Strategos"
He paused, letting the dismissal settle.
He looked toward Glossikos as he said with innocent curiosity that fooled absolutely no one.
"I seem to remember that you all hate THE Four with a passion. Why would you be listening to THE Living Paradox so astutely?"
BOOM!

He said such words with calmness as both Absolutes here silently stared at him, and he could feel the distant gazes of the Strategoi of Existentialists and Chaos observing from their thrones far above.
At this moment, both sides seemed to be only looking at each other with heavy tension that made the air itself grow thick with unspoken threats and calculations!
Paradoxos stood representing the interests of THE Living Paradox, seeking to reclaim what had been lost.
Glossikos stood representing... what exactly? Her own interests? The interests of The First Tongue? Or simply the desire to spite the very beings who had bound her to this place for eons?
The silence stretched.
Until ultimately...
"Hold your existence and connections steadfast."
Paradoxos spoke with a voice that held a warning wrapped in the guise of advice.
"For Existence is vast and full of terrors, and things can always change so... rapidly."
Both faces smiled with expressions that contradicted each other yet somehow conveyed the same menace.
"Just look at THE Weavers as an example."
WAA!

chapters.title: Chapter 4809: Vast and Full of Terrors! II
paragraphs: After he said such words, he looked toward Glossikos as if he was disappointed in her choice to stand where she stood, and he disappeared with a flash of obsidian-gold light that left afterimages burned into the air!
A heavy silence settled in the destroyed Palaestra.
Noah looked toward Glossikos who turned to him with a calm gaze that seemed to be hiding many things beneath its composed surface.
He did not trust this bitch at all.

She was an Absolute who had spent eons failing to claim what he had claimed. She was a being who had shown naked greed for his Heart when he offered it to THE Weavers. She was someone whose motivations remained unclear even after everything that had occurred.
But she was a follower of The First Tongue and wanted everything about it, so until she made her allegiances clear, there were still many things he could do with her.
And at this moment...
"Hey, I need to make a visit to the lands of Existentialists in this place."
He spoke such words calmly as if he didn’t even want to discuss THE Weavers or the Axiom or the implicit threat that Paradoxos had just delivered on behalf of THE Living Paradox!

He wanted to get a move on his objectives as things were moving around far too quickly, and all of it was mainly due to him and his actions across existence since arriving in THE Corrupted Vault of Ginnungagap.
But as he held the Derivative Civilization of Undifferentiated Fate under him, he now sensed many more things across Existence.
Threads of fate that he could perceive and follow.
Connections that had been invisible before but now blazed with clarity.
And the Disciple of THE Secretive Eon was one he could grab right now and complete this objective!
Around the same time.
In Alfheimr.
THE Primordial Chaos walked through the crystalline forests of Alfheimr with the ease of someone who owned everything and nothing simultaneously.
The glory of his form shifting constantly as THE Living Emotive floated beside him and THE Living Elemental trailed behind with the caution of someone who knew he was in dangerous company.
THE Primordial Chaos looked up at the obsidian gold pillar that still had not faded above as if it was reminding him of long forgotten memories.
Emotive blinked as she looked at him and said...
"Scary old man, what are you thinking about right now with such a brutal gaze?"
THE Primordial Chaos did not turn to her as he replied calmly.
"I was remembering an Absolute I collapsed long ago, during the Infinite Unfurling."
BOOM!
Emotive’s emotions had been cycling through boredom and mild interest, but her eyes now shone brighlty as she came closer as if she was ready to listen, and Elemental remained silent.
"His name was THE Solitary Extreme."
Chaos’s shifting features settled into something almost nostalgic.

"He was magnificent in ways that most Absolutes could only dream of being. He burned brighter than any constellation of lesser beings, fueled entirely by his own foundations, beholden to nothing and connected to none. He did not share his authority. He did not receive support from others. He simply burned, alone and magnificent, because burning alone was what THE Solitary Extreme had always done."
The crystalline trees around them seemed to lean in, as if even the realm of Alfheimr wanted to hear this tale.
"And when I came for him, THE Solitary Extreme collapsed into himself as it was not even a grand battle, and I had even gone there to give him a choice."
Chaos’s voice grew heavier with each word.

"No other Absolute felt his death approaching in time to intervene. No other power dimmed itself to come to his aid. The vast expanse of Observable Existence simply watched as I consumed something that had touched nothing beyond itself."
He paused, letting the weight of the memory settle.

"Other Absolutes I have faced over the eons, they had connections. They had threads tying their fates to beings who would cross Existence to stand beside them. They had networks of Ways that supported and elevated each other when crisis arrived. Those Absolutes were harder to collapse. Some remain uncollapsed to this day precisely because I could never catch them truly alone. Osmont, when I met him, had many that wanted to stand by his side in Ginnungagap. He was not isolated, and he moved from the grasp of Temporal and others smoothly."
His smile became something vast and knowing.
"But THE Solitary Extreme believed that isolation was strength. Because solitude felt safer."
Chaos turned to look at both Emotive and Elemental with eyes that held depths of accumulated eons.

"There is a particular pride in standing alone that many mistake for power. The pride of saying that everything one has achieved came from within, that no hand lifted them, that no thread tied their fate to another."
His voice dropped to something that resonated with the very fabric of Alfheimr itself.
"It is the pride of THE Solitary Extreme, burning bright and burning fast and burning toward an ending that no one came to prevent."

"An Absolute who burns in constellation with others may shine less brilliantly in isolation, but they burn longer, reach further, and when enemies come for them, the threads they have woven become shields that solitary brilliance can never provide. And yet THE Weaver, with all her connections, perished alone, while other Absolutes were even observing. So truly...what is The Way? Isolation, or connections?"
Elemental listened silently.
And Emotive yawned as if she had lost interest and was bored.
A moment later, she blinked and turned her head sharply as she looked toward a certain direction with eyes that suddenly blazed with genuine interest.
"No fucking way..."
"Oh, I wasn’t talking about your boring ass story."
She waved her hand dismissively at Chaos while her attention remained locked on whatever she had sensed.
"I seem to have found something unbelievable over there."

THE Primordial Chaos remained calm as he looked at Emotive and what she had sensed, his shifting features betraying nothing of the fact that this was something he had already observed the moment he arrived in Alfheimr.
THE Living Emotive was staring into the far distance, her attention locked onto a grand citadel filled with life and activity that blazed against the serene beauty of the Primordial Realm.
And within that citadel, THE Living Origin and THE First Hunger had just arrived.

chapters.title: Chapter 4810: A Meeting in Alfheimr! I
paragraphs: The Citadel of Yggdrasil’s Echo rose from the heart of Alfheimr like a living testament to the majesty of Existence itself.
The walls were woven from luminescent vines that had been cultivating since before The Infinite Unfurling, their leaves shimmering with colors that existed only in this Primordial Realm.
Bridges of solidified starlight connected the various towers, and waterfalls of liquid Mana cascaded from floating gardens that orbited the central structure like devoted moons around a radiant sun.
The inhabitants of this place were beings of breathtaking beauty and terrible power.
Ljósálfar, natives of Alfheimr, moved through the corridors with grace that transcended physical movement, their forms composed of light given flesh and purpose.

Some had wings of crystalline energy. Others bore antlers that branched into configurations that mapped the very Weavings of Existence. All of them radiated the unmistakable signature of THE Creature’s domain, beings who had been shaped by the authority of Existence itself across countless eons.
This was the realm where THE Creature had first risen.
This was the birthplace of the most powerful of THE Four.
And today, this citadel welcomed home one of its most beloved daughters.
THE Living Origin stood at the center of the Grand Processional Hall, surrounded by lifeforms who looked upon her with reverence that transcended mere respect.
THE First Hunger stood behind her with solemn vigilance, his crimson-obsidian eyes scanning the gathered crowd.

Multiple THE Surface Depth entities floated in the outer rings of the gathering, their presence adding weight to the ceremonial atmosphere. Intermediate Depth beings occupied the middle tiers, their authority contributing to the layered Immensity that filled the hall.
And circling closest to Origin herself, eight Fundamental Depth entities gazed upon her with eyes that held memories stretching back to ages she had nearly forgotten.
"Ljósmóðir returns!"
The cry went up from countless throats.
"The Mother of Light walks among us once more!"
Ljósmóðir.
It was a distinction that Origin had earned in ages past, when she had helped THE Creature learn of the foundations of what Alfheimr would become. She had been his companion then!
The procession swelled around her with joy that felt almost painful after so long in isolation.
Ljósálfar reached out to touch her robes as she passed, seeking connection with one they had mourned as lost.
The eight Fundamental Depth entities began to sing hymns of welcome.
And for just a moment, Origin allowed herself to feel something like peace.
Peace.
And yet...peace never did last long, did it?
BOOM!
The skies above quaked!
The crystalline spires of the citadel trembled!
The hymns of welcome died in throats that suddenly forgot how to produce sound!
Three figures descended from above.

THE Primordial Chaos came first, his form shifting constantly as reality itself seemed unable to decide what shape should contain him. His presence alone was enough to silence everything within the citadel, the sheer weight of his Absolute Depth pressing down on all present like the hand of something that had existed since before differentiation.
His gaze was calm and distant as if all of this had nothing to do with him, as if he was merely passing through on his way to matters of actual importance.

THE Living Emotive floated beside him, her body crackling with emotions that cycled faster than expressions could form, joy and malice and curiosity and hunger all competing for dominance across her features.
THE Living Elemental trailed behind them, his form shrouded by Phonemes of Fire, Air, Earth, and Water.
But moments after arriving, the calm and distant gaze of THE Primordial Chaos changed.
He frowned.
His shifting features settled into something focused as he looked at Origin, sensing something on her being that interested him.
Origin and Hunger looked up with heavy gazes at this moment as they observed the new entrants.
The eyes of Origin actually only glanced at Chaos before they locked onto Emotive.
And in the next moment, Emotive smiled brilliantly toward THE Living Origin with an expression that held joy and menace in equal measure.
Her figure moved forward like a flicker of light!
The power of an Absolute crashed down immensely!

All lifeforms nearby had color draining from their faces as they were all forced to kneel under pressure that transcended anything they had ever experienced. The Ljósálfar collapsed. The Surface Depth entities buckled. The Intermediate Depth beings fell to their knees with expressions of terror. Even the eight Fundamental Depth entities, ancient beings who had existed since before THE Fallout, found themselves pressing against the ground with effort that strained their very foundations.
And shockingly, even THE First Hunger trembled!
His crimson-obsidian flames blazed desperately as he sought to prevent being forced to kneel, his pride as one who had devoured Folds refusing to allow him to bow before anyone.
Emotive came before Origin with an utterly smiling expression.
And in the next moment...
"Haha, Origin! I thought you collapsed and were forgotten, but here you are!"

After she said this, Emotive actually jumped forward and embraced Origin, wrapping her arms around the being she had not seen in eons and giving her a hug as if they were long-time friends reuniting after a brief separation!
She did all of this as in contrast, everything and everyone around her was shaking from her horrific pressure that continued to press down without mercy or restraint.
But in the next moment, with a calm wave from the hand of THE Primordial Chaos above, all of this pressure faded.
Chaos looked toward Emotive and said with a voice that carried absolute authority.
"Behave."
HUUM!
The pressure emerging from her immediately faded as Emotive pouted with an expression that cycled through irritation and amusement.
But she kept her gaze on Origin, who was staring at her coldly and without any emotions warming her white-gold eyes.
Emotive let go of her embrace as she looked over Origin up and down with a smile that evaluated and judged and found entertainment in what she observed.
"Man, so much has changed since I last saw you. A bit more fat here and there, but still so gorgeous..."
Her voice dripped with honeyed venom.
"You seem to be a bit weak as... who knew I would be among those to become an Absolute before the great Living Origin?"
She tilted her head with mock sympathy.
"I mean, I can sense your Depth fluctuating as this is..."
She breathed in deeply as if she smelled something from Origin.
And she smiled even wider after.
"Oh, that’s definitely the smell of THE Creature. Did he give you a little bit of something something after all this time?"
Her emotions cycled through delight and mockery.
"But one can only be given so much, as for Absolute, it ultimately has to be yourself... ah, no worries."
She paused as her prismatic eyes narrowed.
"But why do I also smell a uniqueness of The First Tongue within you?"
Her smile became something sharp.
"Is it... true that you jumped ship? Is it true that you went to... THE Youngest making waves?"
Her voice dropped to something almost intimate.
"Osmont?"
BOOM!

sentences.text: The Citadel of Yggdrasil’s Echo rose from the heart of Alfheimr like a living testament to the majesty of Existence itself.
The walls were woven from luminescent vines that had been cultivating since before The Infinite Unfurling, their leaves shimmering with colors that existed only in this Primordial Realm.
Bridges of solidified starlight connected the various towers, and waterfalls of liquid Mana cascaded from floating gardens that orbited the central structure like devoted moons around a radiant sun.
The inhabitants of this place were beings of breathtaking beauty and terrible power.
Ljósálfar, natives of Alfheimr, moved through the corridors with grace that transcended physical movement, their forms composed of light given flesh and purpose.
Some had wings of crystalline energy.
Others bore antlers that branched into configurations that mapped the very Weavings of Existence.
All of them radiated the unmistakable signature of THE Creature’s domain, beings who had been shaped by the authority of Existence itself across countless eons.
This was the realm where THE Creature had first risen.
This was the birthplace of the most powerful of THE Four.
And today, this citadel welcomed home one of its most beloved daughters.
THE Living Origin stood at the center of the Grand Processional Hall, surrounded by lifeforms who looked upon her with reverence that transcended mere respect.
THE First Hunger stood behind her with solemn vigilance, his crimson-obsidian eyes scanning the gathered crowd.
Multiple THE Surface Depth entities floated in the outer rings of the gathering, their presence adding weight to the ceremonial atmosphere.
Intermediate Depth beings occupied the middle tiers, their authority contributing to the layered Immensity that filled the hall.
And circling closest to Origin herself, eight Fundamental Depth entities gazed upon her with eyes that held memories stretching back to ages she had nearly forgotten.
"Ljósmóðir returns!"
The cry went up from countless throats.
"The Mother of Light walks among us once more!"
Ljósmóðir.
It was a distinction that Origin had earned in ages past, when she had helped THE Creature learn of the foundations of what Alfheimr would become.
She had been his companion then!
The procession swelled around her with joy that felt almost painful after so long in isolation.
Ljósálfar reached out to touch her robes as she passed, seeking connection with one they had mourned as lost.
The eight Fundamental Depth entities began to sing hymns of welcome.
And for just a moment, Origin allowed herself to feel something like peace.
Peace.
And yet...peace never did last long, did it?
BOOM!
The skies above quaked!
The crystalline spires of the citadel trembled!
The hymns of welcome died in throats that suddenly forgot how to produce sound!
Three figures descended from above.
THE Primordial Chaos came first, his form shifting constantly as reality itself seemed unable to decide what shape should contain him.

His presence alone was enough to silence everything within the citadel, the sheer weight of his Absolute Depth pressing down on all present like the hand of something that had existed since before differentiation.
His gaze was calm and distant as if all of this had nothing to do with him, as if he was merely passing through on his way to matters of actual importance.

THE Living Emotive floated beside him, her body crackling with emotions that cycled faster than expressions could form, joy and malice and curiosity and hunger all competing for dominance across her features.
THE Living Elemental trailed behind them, his form shrouded by Phonemes of Fire, Air, Earth, and Water.
But moments after arriving, the calm and distant gaze of THE Primordial Chaos changed.
He frowned.
His shifting features settled into something focused as he looked at Origin, sensing something on her being that interested him.
Origin and Hunger looked up with heavy gazes at this moment as they observed the new entrants.
The eyes of Origin actually only glanced at Chaos before they locked onto Emotive.
And in the next moment, Emotive smiled brilliantly toward THE Living Origin with an expression that held joy and menace in equal measure.
Her figure moved forward like a flicker of light!
The power of an Absolute crashed down immensely!
All lifeforms nearby had color draining from their faces as they were all forced to kneel under pressure that transcended anything they had ever experienced.
The Ljósálfar collapsed.
The Surface Depth entities buckled.
The Intermediate Depth beings fell to their knees with expressions of terror.
Even the eight Fundamental Depth entities, ancient beings who had existed since before THE Fallout, found themselves pressing against the ground with effort that strained their very foundations.
And shockingly, even THE First Hunger trembled!
His crimson-obsidian flames blazed desperately as he sought to prevent being forced to kneel, his pride as one who had devoured Folds refusing to allow him to bow before anyone.
Emotive came before Origin with an utterly smiling expression.
And in the next moment...
"Haha, Origin!
I thought you collapsed and were forgotten, but here you are!"

After she said this, Emotive actually jumped forward and embraced Origin, wrapping her arms around the being she had not seen in eons and giving her a hug as if they were long-time friends reuniting after a brief separation!
She did all of this as in contrast, everything and everyone around her was shaking from her horrific pressure that continued to press down without mercy or restraint.
But in the next moment, with a calm wave from the hand of THE Primordial Chaos above, all of this pressure faded.
Chaos looked toward Emotive and said with a voice that carried absolute authority.
"Behave."
HUUM!
The pressure emerging from her immediately faded as Emotive pouted with an expression that cycled through irritation and amusement.
But she kept her gaze on Origin, who was staring at her coldly and without any emotions warming her white-gold eyes.
Emotive let go of her embrace as she looked over Origin up and down with a smile that evaluated and judged and found entertainment in what she observed.
"Man, so much has changed since I last saw you.
A bit more fat here and there, but still so gorgeous..."
Her voice dripped with honeyed venom.
"You seem to be a bit weak as... who knew I would be among those to become an Absolute before the great Living Origin?"
She tilted her head with mock sympathy.
"I mean, I can sense your Depth fluctuating as this is..."
She breathed in deeply as if she smelled something from Origin.
And she smiled even wider after.
"Oh, that’s definitely the smell of THE Creature.
Did he give you a little bit of something something after all this time?"
Her emotions cycled through delight and mockery.
"But one can only be given so much, as for Absolute, it ultimately has to be yourself... ah, no worries."
She paused as her prismatic eyes narrowed.
"But why do I also smell a uniqueness of The First Tongue within you?"
Her smile became something sharp.
"Is it... true that you jumped ship?
Is it true that you went to...
THE Youngest making waves?"
Her voice dropped to something almost intimate.
"Osmont?"
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 4811: A Meeting in Alfheimr! II
paragraphs: She asked as her eyes burned with a dangerous light, her smile never leaving her features as she was acting as if she was gossiping with a long-term friend about inconsequential matters.
And yet Origin looked at Emotive with clear distaste as she said with a voice that could have frozen the waterfalls of liquid Mana flowing throughout the citadel.
"Who I associate with is none of your concern."
Her words were chilly as Emotive smiled even more brilliantly.
She came ever closer as she wrapped her hands around Origin once more, leaning in to whisper in her ear with a breath that carried the weight of countless chaotic emotions.
"How is Osmont? Is he as... grand as THE Creature? Is that why he made you jump ship?"
Her whisper held manic intensity.
"I’ve been... ecstatic to meet him, you know. Could you introduce us?"
Her grip tightened slightly.
"You always have this way of picking the good ones first, and the rest of us can only meet them later..."
Her words were filled with manic emotions as Origin calmly took Emotive’s hands off her body and distanced herself while moving to stand beside a solemn First Hunger.
Her gaze remained heavy as she looked at Emotive and then at THE Primordial Chaos and THE Living Elemental above.
"What do you want?"
What did they want?
Or in this case, what did Emotive want, because somehow, as always, she was moving things along with her chaotic interference.
"What do I want? Oh, I want many things in Existence. So many. I want...!"
Before she could finish her words, Emotive stopped.
At this moment, THE Primordial Chaos landed down beside them.
A unique air of power radiated from him that cut off everything and everyone.
It even pressed down on Emotive as if to say... enough of your antics, a true power is here.
Emotive’s gaze flickered as her eyes flashed with humiliation, but Chaos seemed serious at this time as even she could not step out of line!
Because as much as she loved to break boundaries and play, THE Primordial Chaos was still one of THE Four!
They were all Absolutes, but THE Primordial Chaos could likely crush her and Elemental with the same thumb he pressed down with.
They were absolutely not in the same category.
At this moment, Chaos walked over and looked at Origin and Hunger with a serene gaze that held depths of calculation behind its apparent calm.
"As if we are back in Ginnungagap again in that pivotal moment."
His voice carried nostalgia that seemed almost genuine.
"How unique."
He paused.
"But when it comes to what I want... it is actually the same as always."
His shifting features settled into something almost kind.
"I want a choice."
He tilted his head as he studied Origin more closely.
"I didn’t expect it until I looked closely at you, but... you can reach out to THE Youngest, can’t you?"
His smile became something that made even Emotive grow still.
"I wish to give you the choice to call him over. I feel like a conversation is long overdue."
BOOM!
The gaze of THE Living Origin and THE First Hunger became heavy.
A conversation?
Nothing with an Absolute was ever just... a conversation!
Noah sat on an enlarged Skoll who now looked like a very good dog of large size as he entered what was known asThe Ousia in the Middle City, Meso Polis, where mainly Lochagoi resided.
The Ousia was a grand domain that Existentialists gathered around, and it looked like an ancient structure fused with Existence itself.

Pillars of living stone rose toward artificial skies that shifted with the breathing of the realm. Gardens of conceptual flowers bloomed in patterns that spoke of truths about being and becoming. Pools of liquid Existence reflected not images but essences, showing those who gazed into them glimpses of what they truly were beneath their surface forms.
At this moment, Noah was looking at a figure of a fairy-like existence who sat atop a small mountain surrounded by multicolored sacred herbs.

There were multiple such mountains like this surrounding The Ousia where many Existentialists cultivated, beings so attuned to nature and Existence that they did not even go to THE Palaestra for the battle that just took place.
They cared nothing for the politics of factions or the drama of challenges. They simply existed, cultivating their understanding of being itself.
But here was... The Disciple of THE Secretive Eon.
Nyx.

She was a bit different from the image he sas before, but she was...serene, her form composed of twilight given flesh and purpose. Her skin held the color of the moment between day and night, that liminal space where neither sun nor stars held dominion.

Her hair flowed like shadows learning to dance, dark and luminous simultaneously. Her wings were currently retracted, folded into her back as if they had never existed, but the spaces where they would emerge shimmered with potential.

Her gaze was solid and unchanging as if she was truly trying to blend in with the surrounding Existence, becoming one with the sacred herbs and conceptual flowers and pools of liquid being that surrounded her cultivation spot.
Her master had said this entity was a fan of THE Creature, someone who idolized Existence itself and had traveled to THE Agora of Primordial Judgment specifically to be closer to his domain.
She was also an entity who could cross levels of power, sitting at THE Intermediate Depth but holding power at THE Fundamental Depth through foundations that defied conventional classification.
Noah looked at her calmly.
This being opened her eyes and blinked as she looked at him before she saw the graceful visage of Glossikos floating nearby.
She quickly grew astonished as she rose up and nodded respectfully with deference that spoke of genuine reverence for the Strategoi.
"To what do I owe the honor of having the great Strategos, Glossikos, come to my humble self?"
She asked such a question toward Glossikos as Noah looked at her calmly and said with directness that cut through any pretense of ceremony.
"An Absolute just fell in THE Palaestra. This didn’t interest you enough to come see?"
This being came to look at Noah calmly with twilight eyes that held depths of philosophical certainty as she said with a voice like the quiet moment before dawn.
"Absolutes rise. Absolutes fall. It has nothing to do with me as it is the nature of Existence."
She said such words with such calm detachment that Noah gazed at her silently for a moment before he said with pragmatic urgency that had no patience for philosophical musings.
"Okay. Your Master sent me to get you. And I actually don’t have the time right now, so let’s do this quickly."
He said such words calmly because his existence perceived the Immensity of an Absolute near his Absolute Seal of Quintessence that he had given to Origin!

The Seal was akin to an extension of himself as it allowed him to know where she and Tor were, and he could theoretically do a few things with it as at this time, he felt the familiar, suffocating aura of none other than...
THE Primordial Chaos.
So within Alfheimr, THE Living Origin and THE First Hunger were for one reason or another coming across Chaos.
Why would THE Primordial Chaos be in the home of THE Creature?
There were many questions, but as always, Existence continued to move however it wished.
The only thing he could do was move alongside it to see how he could navigate it with all the terrifying monsters out there.
Nyx raised her brows at his words as she said with the calm certainty of someone who understood reality.
"Only a Polemarch can exit THE Agora of Primordial Judgment, and with the agreement and permission of two Strategoi at that. And I am finding this place very beneficial as..."
Before she could even finish her words, Noah turned over to Glossikos and said with authority that expected compliance rather than requested it.
"I have an overabundance of contributions. I would like to transfer a sufficient amount to Nyx here, to Ul’moreth, and to my dog here to give them sufficient ranking."

chapters.title: Chapter 4812: Usage of Absolute Everything! I
paragraphs: He said such words gloriously as Glossikos raised her brows with an expression that mixed surprise with calculation.
"Even if rules are bent to make them all Polemarchs, you would need my permission and another. I don’t believe Paradoxos, Khaotikos, or Ontikos would particularly be feeling generous..."
Glossikos paused as her eyes flashed with surprise.
And Noah looked at her as the musings of Undifferentiated Fate burned in his eyes. He had planned to reach out to Ontikos as with his relation to THE Creature, he did not expect any problems there!
But had Ontikos already reached out to Glossikos even before he asked?
He only thought of this as a moment later, Glossikos spoke with a unique expression that held layers of meaning Noah could not fully parse.
"Well, it seems this is an action supported by many moving parts. A Strategos has reached out and stated that they will approve this departure."
BOOM!
Noah’s eyes squinted as in the next moment, Glossikos began to move her hands with authority that reshaped the rules of this domain according to her will.
The numbers on Noah’s toga went down rapidly while on Ul’moreth, Skoll, and Nyx, their numbers rose higher and higher as contributions flowed from his account to theirs.
Until their togas transformed to match Polemarchs!
Lumivara was the only one unchanged as Noah wanted to keep her with him here to elevate her Depth some more through the opportunities this place provided.

As for Noah, his toga still remained that of a Polemarch as he had done far too much in the short period of time in THE Agora of Primordial Judgment, with his latest action being winning a debate and collapsing an Absolute. Even after transferring enough contributions to elevate three beings to Polemarch status, he still had more than enough to maintain his own rank.
As he watched all this happen, Glossikos grandly said in the next moment with finality that carried the weight of law.
"It is done. I can send them out of THE Agora of Primordial Judgment at any time."
Noah nodded at these words as his senses flickered. Undifferentiated Fate told him that he was thinking wrong about something.
So he asked to be sure.
"Who was the other Strategos to give their approval for their departure?"
Glossikos turned to him after this question.
Her immensely deep obsidian-blue eyes bore into his with Immensity and calmness as she said with weight that made Noah’s foundations pulse with recognition.
"Strategos Khaotikos."
BOOM!
It was not Ontikos, related to Existence, but Khaotikos who stepped in without even being asked.
Chaos!
Noah’s eyes squinted as he also recalled the cleanliness of the Weavings of Chaos when it came to Malformations surrounding them.

When he closed his eyes to sense what only Absolutes could sense, he could see those weed-like corruptions already forming silently around all Weavings, especially Paradox and Existence as these two seemed to be holding immense waves of corruption that spread and propagated without adequate cleansing at much faster rates.
But barely any Corrupted Growths formed around Weavings of Chaos, and when they did, Noah saw them disappearing soon after into golden threads that further stabilized Existence.
THE Primordial Chaos was diligent in ways that his philosophy of disorder should have contradicted.
There was a lot to be learned regarding how everything worked out.
At this moment, Noah gave a light nod as he said with command that expected immediate execution.
"Send them out."
Glossikos looked at him silently before a moment later, she clenched her fist with authority that transcended normal space.
A reluctant Nyx, Ul’moreth, and Skoll disappeared!

Only Glossikos and Lumivara remained nearby as Lumivara came closer toward Noah with a happy smile, almost as if she was reminded of when they had been alone and crossing the Infinite Unfurling together before everything had become so complicated.
As for Noah, his gaze was on the Stoa of Dogmata where at this moment, Ul’moreth, Nyx, and Skoll appeared outside THE Agora of Primordial Judgment.
The moment they did, Noah exerted his power across the Stoa of Dogmata through the threads of fate and Mana that connected him to everything he claimed authority over.
He brought them to the region where his other body stood a distance away from THE Secretive Eon!
THE Secretive Eon looked over with raised brows as she saw her Disciple appear with a look of reluctance that instantly changed the moment Nyx recognized who she was seeing.
Nyx took a step to appear beside her master and knelt down with deference that spoke of genuine devotion as she said with a voice filled with regret and submission.
"This unworthy disciple apologizes to Master for any trouble she has caused."
THE Secretive Eon looked at her Disciple with sharp eyes that evaluated and judged, but she didn’t reply.
Instead, she looked over to Noah.
But at this moment, Noah was not looking at her!
He was gazing at Ul’moreth as he evaluated his Teacher’s immense waves of power that were no longer suppressed by THE Agora of Primordial Judgment.
Ul’moreth stood at Half-Step Absolute Depth.

His time in THE Belly of Existence over the eons had been utilized grandly, building foundations that approached the threshold of true Absolute classification. His countless hairs swayed with authority that pressed against the boundaries of what non-Absolutes could achieve.
At this moment, Noah thought of many possibilities as within his existence, an Absolute Everything buzzed with potential utilizations.
He asked Ul’moreth with a voice that held calculation and hope intertwined.
"Old man, how is your foundation after all these eons? What would you need to tip you over from Half-Step Absolute to... Absolute?"
There were many things happening as Existence was full of possibilities.
Right now, he was looking at the possibility of the emergence of an Absolute under his faction.
The choices were Ul’moreth, Origin, or potentially others.
And at this moment, after gaining Undifferentiated Fate and having access to observing where those connected to him were through threads of causality that stretched across Observable Existence...
He had already sent another body across The Wastes toward THE Fisherman who had given up everything for him in Ginnungagap!
And he looked at Ul’moreth as he wondered...of the Usage of his Absolute Everything!
