Nyx took a step to appear beside her master and knelt down with deference that spoke of genuine devotion as she said with a voice filled with regret and submission.
"This unworthy disciple apologizes to Master for any trouble she has caused."
THE Secretive Eon looked at her Disciple with sharp eyes that evaluated and judged, but she didn’t reply.
Instead, she looked over to Noah.
But at this moment, Noah was not looking at her!
He was gazing at Ul’moreth as he evaluated his Teacher’s immense waves of power that were no longer suppressed by THE Agora of Primordial Judgment.
Ul’moreth stood at Half-Step Absolute Depth.
His time in THE Belly of Existence over the eons had been utilized grandly, building foundations that approached the threshold of true Absolute classification.
His countless hairs swayed with authority that pressed against the boundaries of what non-Absolutes could achieve.
At this moment, Noah thought of many possibilities as within his existence, an Absolute Everything buzzed with potential utilizations.
He asked Ul’moreth with a voice that held calculation and hope intertwined.
"Old man, how is your foundation after all these eons?
What would you need to tip you over from Half-Step Absolute to...
Absolute?"
There were many things happening as Existence was full of possibilities.
Right now, he was looking at the possibility of the emergence of an Absolute under his faction.
The choices were Ul’moreth, Origin, or potentially others.
And at this moment, after gaining Undifferentiated Fate and having access to observing where those connected to him were through threads of causality that stretched across Observable Existence...
He had already sent another body across The Wastes toward THE Fisherman who had given up everything for him in Ginnungagap!
And he looked at Ul’moreth as he wondered...of the Usage of his Absolute Everything!

chapters.title: Chapter 4813: The Enemy Unseen I
paragraphs: Noah looked at the old hairy man in front of him as he searched for an answer regarding the possibilities of what he could do.

He knew that THE Creature and THE Primordial Chaos and THE Living Paradox did everything that they could when they arrived at THE Fundamental Depth to build their foundation before they became Absolutes.

It was so ridiculous to the point that even though he just devoured the recoverable Depth of an Absolute, he only gained a bit over twenty-five percent of the comparable Immensity of foundation when looking at THE Creature and others like him.

Those beings had spent eons at Fundamental Depth, accumulating weight that would support their eventual ascension with foundations so unshakeable that nothing could threaten their position once they crossed that final threshold.

So he knew that even though he had an Absolute Everything, his utilization of it would only increase a percentage of his foundation, and whether that was ten percent or twenty percent may not be too significant of a difference in the grand scheme of his own advancement.
But an Absolute under his faction... that was something entirely different!
That was a force multiplier that could change the dynamics of everything he was trying to accomplish.
Ul’moreth looked at him as even within those waves of countless hairs, Noah saw a brilliant Ginnu Lifeform who smiled at him with warmth.

"I couldn’t rise as an Absolute in THE Belly of Existence even after eons passed because of a suppression that pressed down on all of us who sought to advance beyond what THE Creature deemed appropriate."
His voice carried weight that spoke of frustrations accumulated across ages.
"You left me and Ains your Sparks. Your Way. Haha, if you did not exist, maybe we would have claimed The First Tongue by now."
He chuckled with genuine amusement.

"But we advanced through your authority instead. I forged my foundation using what you provided. I wish I had been patient enough to remain at Fundamental and not jump to Half-Step Absolute as this actually set me back in certain ways, but even here, I need to just take... a step."
His expression grew contemplative.
"But the single step can sometimes feel like the entire span of Observable Existence."
A step.
Ul’moreth was a grand entity. Perfect Speaker of The First Tongue. His power, potential, and immensity was no less if not grander than some of THE Living Existences in The Infinite Unfurling.
Noah stroked the head of a happy Skoll as he listened to this and said with casual confidence that belied the significance of what he was about to offer.
"Alright. I have something, maybe it can help you take that step."
Noah closed his eyes.

Within his existence, he reached for the cluster of mobius strips that had formed from his cleansing of Observable Existence, that first genuine Absolute Everything that marked his entry into the currency of beings who shaped reality itself.
A glorious blue-gold cluster of mobius strips floated out of his head!

Its aura was so heavy and dense that reality itself seemed to bend around its presence, and shockingly, it radiated a glimmer of Absolute authority that made everything nearby tremble with recognition of what they were perceiving!
Absolute!
Something that carried the essence of what Absolutes accumulated through their contributions to Observable Existence!
It emerged from Noah as a shocked hairy hand of Ul’moreth rose to grasp it with reverence that spoke of understanding exactly what he was being offered!
In the distance, THE Secretive Eon and Nyx turned over with shining eyes.
Eon even seemed to have a pondering look as she locked her gaze onto Noah with intensity that evaluated and calculated and found new depths of interest in what this being was capable of producing!
Noah didn’t pay attention to any of the gazes as he said with casualness that masked how much he truly hoped this would work.
"See if it’s possible. If it is, great. If it’s not... that’s also okay. No pressure."
Well, he didn’t say it, but there was a little bit of pressure!

Ul’moreth grasped the Absolute Everything solemnly as he nodded, and it disappeared into his body as he sat down in a meditative position with countless hairs settling around him like a cocoon of accumulated authority.

Noah was about to turn toward THE Secretive Eon to see how things would progress from here, because the aura of THE Primordial Chaos was in Alfheimr, and she had said that Chaos was the first target among THE Four before they would be targeting Jotunheim!
But as he did so, his Weavings buzzed as he received a message through his Derivative Civilization of Hunger and Undifferentiated Fate!
|Hey big guy, I don’t know if you can hear this, but THE Primordial Chaos has for some reason decided to be in Alfheimr when Origin is here looking for THE Creature.|
|The bitch Emotive and Elemental are here as well.|
|Chaos says he wants to talk to you, but Origin won’t activate the Seal you gave her because she likely does not want to embroil you in whatever is happening here.|
|But hey, you are one of THE Four.|
|There’s half a chance that THE Creature is watching all of this and will intervene, but just in case he is being an ass, there is you.|
The message was a heavy one, and it stemmed from THE First Hunger!
Emotive, Elemental, and THE Primordial Chaos were moving together in Alfheimr.
The sentence alone was ridiculous as shouldn’t Emotive and Elemental be moving with Paradox?
They were part of THE Loom. They served THE Living Paradox. They had been instruments of his designs.
But what was this?
Why were they walking alongside THE Primordial Chaos as if they were old companions taking a stroll through one of the most ancient Primordial Realms in existence?
His eyes moved with Immensity as he needed an answer and solution at this moment.

He was inclined to speak to Eon about this, to tell her that her target was in Alfheimr right now and they could set off there immediately. After all, she had said THE Primordial Chaos was the first among THE Four that she planned to collapse and replace. If he was in Alfheimr, if he was near beings connected to Noah’s Civilization...
But his intuition was buzzing.
He didn’t know why, but it made him take a pause and close his eyes.
THE Weaver of Existence closed his eyes as he asked his very Civilizations how to proceed, reaching inward toward the foundations that had been built across his journey through Observable Existence.
Moments later...
|You already know.|
His Civilizations only affirmed his intuition as he sighed internally and made a silent Thesis!
|Where my Seal is, I can have a sliver of my consciousness appear.|
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 4814: The Enemy Unseen II
paragraphs: Chaos wanted to talk?
He would talk.
After all, much of what he saw and came to learn from THE Weavers’ death made him very curious about Chaos.
Why did THE Secretive Eon target him first among THE Four?
And what explained how different Chaos was from the other Aspects as he was seeing through his newly gained perception?

The cleanliness of the Weavings of Chaos. The diligence with which Corrupted Growths were purified around his domain. The contradiction between his philosophy of disorder and his apparent dedication to maintaining stability.
When there were a number of questions, it was always good to get answers from the source!
So he closed his eyes as a part of his consciousness began to buzz and sought to impose itself countless gigaparsecs away, inside a Primordial Realm!
In Alfheimr.
The standoff between THE Primordial Chaos and THE Living Origin and THE First Hunger had settled into a heavy silence that pressed against everyone present with weight that made breathing difficult.

Chaos stood with his form shifting constantly, his presence alone enough to make the crystalline trees of Alfheimr tremble with recognition of what they were hosting. Behind Origin, the natives of this realm, the Ljósálfar who had welcomed her home with such joy moments before, shakily stood up as if they would die for her without hesitation.
Their light-woven forms flickered with determination that transcended their fear.
They would stand beside theirLjósmóðireven against one of THE Four.
Even if it meant their complete and utter collapse.

And yet, uniquely, THE Primordial Chaos was looking at them with a calm gaze that held no malice, no threat, no intention of violence. He did not make any move after telling Origin to reach out toward THE Youngest.
He simply waited.
Origin shook her head resolutely.
"As I said before, it is not happening."
Her voice came firm despite the pressure pressing down on her from an entity who could crush her with a thought.
"The musings of THE Creature are here. Can you all not talk amongst each other? Is that not why you are here to begin with?"
She actually spoke in such a way against a terrifying Absolute who could crush other Absolutes, much less someone like her who had not yet grasped the level of Absolute!
And once more, THE Primordial Chaos did not reply to her.

He only looked within her existence as if he could sense something there, something uniquely different from everything else that Origin represented. His shifting features settled into focused attention as he studied whatever he was perceiving.
And shockingly, a moment later, a brilliant blue-gold light began to shine from the hip of THE Living Origin!
What looked like a medallion flowed out of her existence and began to spin in the air of its own accord!
It was a glorious Absolute Seal of Quintessence!
From the back, THE Living Emotive laughed with delight that cycled through her features.
"Haha, no way, right? Osmont himse..."
"Hush."
BOOM!
The booming voice of THE Primordial Chaos echoed out with a sense of finality at this moment, as if he was giving the last warning that he would be giving today to Emotive.
Her mouth did not even finish moving as she quieted down, the light in her gaze flickering with humiliation and barely contained rage as she looked at what was happening silently.
The Seal spun with increasing intensity, blue-gold light radiating outward in patterns that spoke of authority being channeled across impossible distances.
Moments later, an illusory visage of none other than Noah appeared beside THE Living Origin!
Origin turned to Hunger as her eyes squinted sharply with accusation, but he looked at the figure of Noah with innocent confusion, as if he had done absolutely nothing to bring this about.
And Noah fully formed as he looked around this landscape.
Alfheimr.

Yet another Primordial Realm that was not even a possibility for many to know across Observable Existence, unless you had the power to truly perceive the ancient domains where THE Four had first risen.
The crystalline forests stretched in all directions. The floating islands cascaded with waterfalls of liquid Mana. The sky shifted between aurora and starlight.

And now at this moment, somehow, those who had backed his Way and who came here for their own purposes had met with a party that contained one of THE Four alongside THE Living Elemental and THE Living Emotive.
The moment his illusory consciousness arrived here, Noah gave a glance to the terrifying visage of THE Primordial Chaos.

Looking at this being was like staring into the heart of disorder itself given form. His features never settled. His outline never stabilized. He was simultaneously many possibilities and no possibilities, the very concept of chaos made manifest.
And yet Chaos looked back at him with something that might have been respect.
Thereafter, Noah gave a glance to Emotive.

She was beautiful in the way that a storm was beautiful, her features cycling through emotions faster than normal perception could track. Joy and malice and curiosity and hunger all competed for dominance across her expression.

Her authority felt like layers of manic energy that were waiting to erupt, that actually wanted to erupt at this very moment, and yet she didn’t seem able to, as if she was being held back by something more powerful than her desire for chaos.
He barely heard the word "hush" when he entered that stemmed from THE Primordial Chaos.
It seemed other Absolutes, even with all their power, could be put in line by a single word from a truly powerful Absolute.
After he looked at THE Living Emotive, he turned his head toward THE Living Elemental.
This was the man who did what no man should do to another.
This was the man who put a burning curse on him that forced him to separate from his women for such a long...
Well, it actually wasn’t that long, but still!
The one he marked to be his greatest enemy in existence, purely from that single simple action.
THE Living Elemental.
He looked at this being and the first thing that he did after he arrived in this place was smile toward him.
A smile.

But the smile was brutal and heavy, and it held immense waves of meaning. It was like he was silently communicating that he had just taken down an Absolute and Elemental was his number one target coming up next.
The figure of THE Living Elemental hardened his expression as he retained his majesty and glory, keeping his face straight as he said nothing in response to the silent threat being delivered.
And then Noah returned his gaze back to THE Primordial Chaos.
In the distant past when he met this being before, Chaos had been full of smiles while presenting his choices. He had seemed playful. Amused. As if everything was entertainment for his enjoyment.
And yet right now he seemed unfathomably serious as he looked at Noah straight and said with weight that pressed against everyone present.
"Why don’t the rest of you find something to do? The adults have to talk for a bit."
BOOM!
Woah.
The adults?

The words that THE Primordial Chaos said were extremely heavy and demeaning to all others here as he considered THE Living Elemental and THE Living Emotive, and THE Living Origin and THE First Hunger to be mere children!
And he didn’t differentiate between either of them.
The only one he gave any sense of respect to was Noah since he was in the same rank as him.
One of THE Four!
It was an astonishing scene as the moment THE Primordial Chaos said this, THE Living Elemental was the first to move back and actually leave this area without even looking back.
He simply turned and disappeared into the crystalline forests of Alfheimr as if he had received a command that could not be disobeyed.
Noah could already sense the hesitation of THE Living Origin and THE First Hunger behind him as he raised his hands and said with casual authority that expected compliance.
"Go. It shouldn’t be anything too crazy."

chapters.title: Chapter 4815: The Enemy Unseen III
paragraphs: He said this calmly as after all, he was considered the leader that the two of them had backed. He had to at least be capable of standing up for them when they called for him.
So in a shockingly short amount of time, this entire area that was filled with hymns and grace of the natives of Alfheimr cleared.
THE Living Emotive disappeared with a pout that promised future mischief.
Origin and Hunger retreated with the Ljósálfar who had been willing to die for their Ljósmóðir.
Until only THE Primordial Chaos and Noah remained!
THE Primordial Chaos looked over Noah’s illustrious figure again and again as Noah gazed back at the being he could not fully understand at all.
After a moment, Chaos spoke with a voice that held weight beyond its casual tone.
"It seems that it was good that you escaped from my grasp and the grasp of Temporal in Ginnungagap. Everything is as it should be..."
He paused.
"Well, except when it isn’t."
His shifting features settled into something almost kind.
"Youngest, do you want to see something interesting?"
Noah looked at this being who began talking with him like this as his eyes squinted and he replied with caution wrapped in casual interest.
"I live to see interesting things. But I wonder if it would fit my definition of interesting."
"Oh, you will definitely find it interesting..."
As he said such words, THE Primordial Chaos waved his hand.
Between him and Noah, a massive illusory screen appeared, conjured from authority that reshaped the air itself into a viewing portal.
On this illusory screen, it showed a vast and ancient-looking citadel of a civilization.

The endless expanse of ancient structures stretched across frozen landscapes that seemed to go on forever. Black ice formed the foundations of towers that rose toward skies crackling with perpetual lightning. Glaciers the size of continents groaned beneath constructions that had been built by beings of impossible scale.
And there were the auras of billions upon billions of lifeforms in this endlessly vast civilization.

Chaos Giants moved through the citadel with grace that belied their massive forms. Their skin was the color of storms and obsidian. Their eyes burned with the light of dying stars. They were chaos incarnate, descendants of forces that had existed since before differentiation.
Among these billions, there were thousands of giants at Pre-THE classification, their power impressive but not yet having crossed the threshold into true Depth.
There were hundreds at THE Surface Depth, their authority beginning to press against reality itself.
There were dozens at THE Intermediate Depth, beings whose Ways had begun to truly shape the Existence around them.
There were ten at THE Fundamental Depth, entities whose power could collapse civilizations with a thought.
And there were three Half-Step Absolutes!
It was such a glorious scene of a civilization, showing musings of Chaos permeating throughout every corner and crevice.
And yet the Chaos was unique.
It felt very calm and ordered.
It was truly paradoxical to see.
Noah looked at the scene before him as he frowned for a moment because something felt off.
Something that made his foundations buzz with unease that he could not immediately identify.
Opposite him, THE Primordial Chaos spoke with a voice that held weight beyond its casual observation.
"A grand landscape, is it not? This is Jotunheim. One of my homes."
He paused.

"Why is it so quiet? And why... are all of them so still?"
They could feel and hear the hums of authority that were permeating all across this vast civilization.
Noah could even feel the flow of The First Tongue that was permeating across the vastness of this location, even through just this illusory scene.
And yet of the billions of giants that were here...
Not a single one said a word to the other.

The illusory screen showed the shocking scene that portrayed how nearly all of them were seated in meditative positions across different regions of this vast civilization. The glimmer of the Way of Chaos moved around them in slow, methodical patterns. Noah could sense small but tiny elevations of the Depths of many of those there, as if they were cultivating with perfect efficiency.
But there was no conversation.
No argument, no interactions, nothing.
No chaos at all.
In a realm dedicated to disorder, there was only silence and stillness and order that should not have existed.
Opposite him, the figure of THE Primordial Chaos nodded and solemnly said with weight that made the air itself grow heavy.
"I have been under attack these last few hours since THE Fallout began, and the enemy is an extremely terrifying one."
BOOM!
His shifting features settled into something that looked almost like concern.
"Even though THE Living Paradox and THE Creature began this war, I am the only one currently under assault. And it is an enemy that even I could not have predicted."

The giants sat in perfect rows.
Their cultivation was synchronized.
Their breathing was identical.
Everything about them screamed uniformity in a realm that should have celebrated diversity and disorder.
THE Primordial Chaos continued with heavy and solemn words as he also looked at the scenery of what would have been his civilization.

Many of us predicted that Corrupted Growths and Malformed Authorities would exponentially increase and begin causing issues if they weren’t properly taken care of, or even the rise of terrifying Lifeforms based on Corruption."

"And we were right in some sense."

"But what did arise... is something that not even I could have imagined."
The giants in the illusory screen continued their silent cultivation, their movements so perfectly synchronized that they looked like extensions of a single will.
"An invisible enemy."
Chaos’s shifting features flickered with something that might have been frustration.
"Even I did not perceive them until they had overpowered more than half of Jotunheim."
He gestured toward the citadel displayed before them.
"This citadel that you see before you is one of those that has been fully overpowered by that enemy."

chapters.title: Chapter 4816: The Enemy Unseen IV
paragraphs: Noah’s eyes widened as he studied the billions of giants more closely.
"I noticed it first when those who backed and followed my Way of Chaos seemingly began to disappear one after another, as if they were pulling back their backing."
Chaos’s voice carried the weight of memory.
"Do you want to know what I initially saw when I went to investigate?"
He didn’t wait for an answer.
"This was a few hours ago."
THE Primordial Chaos waved his hand, and another illusory screen appeared beside the first.
This one displayed the same vast citadel of a civilization that Noah was just looking at on the other screen.
But it shockingly showed things decimated, as if a war was occurring!
The giants seemed divided on two sides as they were fighting each other with authority that shook the very foundations of Jotunheim!

One side was shockingly efficient and silent while they attacked. Their movements were precise and coordinated. Their usage of the Way of Chaos was grander and more controlled than anything Noah had ever seen. They fought without roaring. They advanced without hesitation.

The other side was roaring orders and fighting with everything they had. They utilized chaos in the traditional sense, wild and unpredictable and desperate. They threw Declarations and Theses and raw authority at their attackers with abandon.
Half-Step Absolutes clashed with power that cracked the black ice beneath them!
THE Fundamental Depth entities traded blows that would have collapsed lesser civilizations!
THE Intermediate and Surface Depth beings fought in numbers that should have made this a battle lasting eons!
And yet, with just the passage of seconds...
The less efficient side, the side that had been roaring orders and fighting with everything they had...
Brought their hands down silently.
No more assertions or impositions or Declarations or anything flew around.
Nobody fought anymore.
Everybody stopped fighting.
An immense, eerie quiet spread over the entire civilization!

The giants then began to move as if they had not just been fighting, their Ways of Chaos moving with perfect synchronization as they began to repair the citadel around them. They fixed what had been destroyed. They cleaned what had been bloodied. They restored what had been damaged.
As if nothing had happened.
As if the battle had never occurred.
As if they had always been on the same side.
Noah’s face became heavy as THE Primordial Chaos explained with a voice that held the weight of someone describing a nightmare that had become reality.

"The enemy that has been encroaching upon my Way is one that is extremely lethal in their attacks, and their method of action seems to be a silent spread into all Depths and Civilizations without you even knowing it."
He gestured toward the now-peaceful citadel on the first screen.
"All these billions who were followers of my Way of Chaos... they effectively died and were collapsed without even knowing it."
The giants continued their synchronized cultivation, their faces serene and empty.
"What remains of them should be husks, and yet everything seems as is."
Chaos’s voice grew darker still.

"Them throwing attacks or expressing their Way is a diversion. They are like an infection where just by being near those infected, it may seem like you are fighting them, but the authority that you breathe, the Phonemes of The First Tongue that you use, the very Way and Civilization that you are utilizing across your existence... could already be infected by whatever this is."
Noah watched as the giants in the illusory screen moved in perfect unison to purify a cluster of Corrupted Growths that had formed nearby.
"Before you know it, things simply turn dark. Who you were disappears, and something else replaces you."
THE Primordial Chaos paused to let the weight of his words settle.
"What is even more terrifying is that whatever this invisible enemy is...they have no body for us to be attacking. Even I do not know what to target."
The giants finished their purification and returned to their cultivation positions.

"And after the takeover of all of these existences, they operate as if everything is normal. They have been very astute with my Way as I sense them purifying Chaos constantly and taking care of Corrupted Growths."
Noah understood now why the Weavings of Chaos had been so clean when he observed them.
It wasn’t because THE Primordial Chaos was more diligent.
It was because something else was maintaining his domain.
Something that had replaced his followers.
Something that was pretending to be them while spreading further.
Noah’s face became more and more grave as he heard the things that THE Primordial Chaos was saying.
THE Primordial Chaos continued with the finality of someone delivering a verdict.
"The only headway that I have managed to make is that somehow... the only identity I have been able to uncover that is connected to this that I visibly feel a threat towards..."
His shifting features settled into something deadly serious.
"Is THE Secretive Eon."
BOOM!
Noah’s eyes pulsed with light as his illusory visage focused on THE Primordial Chaos!
His foundations trembled.
His heart beat with weight that pressed against his existence.
DUM! DUM! DUM!
The beat of his heart was heavy! His Seals buzzed and as if their hairs stood on end with alarm!
THE Secretive Eon.
The being who had proposed collapsing THE Four together.
The being who said she wanted to replace them rather than merely kill them.
The being whose Disciple he had just retrieved.
The being he had left sitting near his other body moments ago.
"I will warn the other two, but THE Four of us will have to be vigilant against THE Secretive Eon."
Chaos’s voice carried absolute certainty.

"I reached out to you first since you are the weakest among us and you might not even feel anything. Because this enemy could truly overcome you without even a fight, your consciousness simply erased while those around you don’t know any better."
His shifting features held something that might have been concern.
"As one of THE Four, you should have a unique sense or intuition. If you even sense your existence feeling a tingly sense of alarm, if you ever feel like something is a bit off, run."
He leaned closer.
"If you are close with THE Creature, be around with him for a little bit. If you have any level of trust in me, you can even bring your main body here."
His voice dropped to something almost gentle.
"The moment you sense or hear anything about the Weavings of THE Secretive Eon, run. Because if she is even near you, you may lose yourself soon after before you know. You may already be dead."
THE Primordial Chaos straightened.

"I thought that you would be the one they targeted first since you are the weakest. And whatever this enemy is... if they got their hands on The First Tongue, things would become unfathomably harder for all of us with such a thing under their control."
BOOM!
Noah’s mind buzzed.
The beat of his heart was heavy!
He remembered Eon’s words.
She planned to collapse THE Primordial Chaos and others, and Chaos was her first target as she said she would replace him.
She would replace him.
And she would do the same with THE Living Paradox, with THE Creature.
And then she said him!
She had said this!
She had openly told him her plans!

chapters.title: Chapter 4817: The Enemy Unseen V
paragraphs: In Observable Existence, there is an emotion called terror.

Many beings believe across their lives that they have experienced it, that they have truly known what it means to feel fear press against their foundations and make their very Ways tremble with the weight of what they are perceiving.

They believe this because they have faced enemies stronger than themselves, because they have stared into the eyes of those who could collapse them with a thought, because they have stood at the edge of oblivion and felt the void reaching back toward them with hungry intent.
But truly, nobody has felt true fear.

True fear is not the recognition that something can destroy you, because destruction is merely an ending, a transition from existence to non-existence that carries a certain finality that the mind can comprehend and accept.
True fear is the recognition that something can replace you.
That something can wear your face and speak with your voice and utilize your Way and live your life while you are gone in ways that no one will ever notice.
That the you that you have spent your entire existence building and protecting and nurturing can simply... cease, while something else continues in your place as if nothing has changed at all.
The Absolutes who have existed since The Infinite Unfurling whisper among themselves about enemies that kill, about threats that collapse, about dangers that end.
But they do not speak of the enemy that replaces!
The first thing that Noah did after receiving such disastrous information from THE Primordial Chaos was not to panic.
Panic was for those who had no options.
Panic was for those who could not act.
He had options. He could act. And so instead of surrendering to fear, he began looking at other possibilities right away as to what the enemy that THE Primordial Chaos was talking about could be.
His thoughts instantly shifted toTHE Great Usurper.
Eckert.
The very same friend who had been scattered across Transcendent Spirit Folds after being destroyed by Duke Veil-Render.
The being who had been slowly spreading across folds like a virus that turned destruction into opportunity.
If anyone could spread invisibly and replace beings without detection...
If anyone had the capability to infect civilizations from within...
With this Existence being connected to him through threads of fate and Mana that transcended normal distance, Noah erupted with all his might!
His twenty-seven Seals buzzed with terrifying brilliance!
He pulled upon his Derivative Civilization of Undifferentiated Fate, stopping any other processes he held to focus solely on one target!
Eckert!
BOOM!
THE Primordial Chaos had stopped speaking as he sensed this light variation of Weavings in Noah’s gaze after his words.
His shifting features settled into something curious as he asked with weight that expected answers.
"Youngest, do you know something?"
Noah’s eyes blazed with blue-gold intensity as threads of fate stretched across impossible distances, seeking connections that would confirm or deny his suspicions.
"I am checking on something. Just hold on one second."
His voice came stern and focused.
Very soon, detailed prompts bloomed in front of Noah’s eyes with information that made his foundations pulse with recognition.
|THE Weaver of Existence pulls upon one of his deepest connections across Observable Existence.|
|THE Great Usurper, Eckert, has been observed to be slowly spreading threads of his existence across The Wastes of THE Fallout.|
|No threads of his existence can be sensed elsewhere.|
|His expansion remains contained within the corrupted regions where he was scattered.|
|No infiltration of Primordial Realms detected.|
|No connection to the infection spreading through THE Primordial Chaos’s domain has been established.|
BOOM!
The prompts were horrendous ones to hear!
It wasn’t Eckert.
Which meant the enemy was something else entirely.

Noah’s gaze further shifted, and he spent even more of his terrifying Immensity and foundation to focus on the connection with Eckert, utilizing and allowing the expenditure of every ounce of weight and Immensity of his existence as he sent a message across the corrupted Weavings of Observable Existence!
|Hey, are you okay? Have you moved from The Wastes of THE Fallout to any Primordial Realms? Do you know anything of the movements of THE Primordial Chaos?|

He sent such words as a message across corrupted Weavings of Existence, something that should have been impossible before, but now with his Derivative Civilization of Undifferentiated Fate threading connections across Observable Existence...
|Woah, big guy! You’re alive? Of course you would be. Primordial Realms? What are those? I’ve just acclimated to fusing with a fragment of an Axiom...|
BOOM!
Noah breathed heavily.
It wasn’t Eckert.
It wasn’t Eckert.
THE Great Usurper was still contained within The Wastes, still spreading slowly, still unaware of even what Primordial Realms were.

Which meant the invisible enemy spreading through Jotunheim, the infection replacing beings across THE Primordial Chaos’s domain, the threat that made one of THE Four speak with caution and concern...
Was something else entirely.
Or someone else.
Noah’s expression became heavy.
In front of him, THE Primordial Chaos squinted and began to rise with caution that seemed entirely out of place for an entity of his power.
"Youngest..."
His shifting features flickered with something that looked almost like alarm.
"You wouldn’t have happened to already come across THE Secretive Eon, right?"
The musings of Chaos began to rumble and seethe around THE Primordial Chaos!

Shockingly, he moved back from Noah even though Noah was merely an illusory body, as if he was being overly cautious that in the case Noah had already met THE Secretive Eon, he may already be compromised!
The crystalline trees of Alfheimr trembled as reality itself responded to the caution of one of THE Four!
Noah looked at THE Primordial Chaos.
What monstrosity was moving in the undercurrents of Observable Existence to make one of THE Four this cautious?
What enemy could spread invisibly through the domain of an Absolute without being detected until half of everything was already lost?
What threat could make THE Primordial Chaos, a being who had built foundations that let him stand among THE Four, retreat from even an illusory projection out of caution of contamination?
And if Noah truly was staring at the culprit at this very moment while being less than a mile away from her...
He needed to move.
And to move quickly!
Anything an Absolute like THE Primordial Chaos was cautious of...
What could it do against him?!

|THE Weaver of Existence pulls upon one of his deepest connections across Observable Existence.|
|THE Great Usurper, Eckert, has been observed to be slowly spreading threads of his existence across The Wastes of THE Fallout.|
|No threads of his existence can be sensed elsewhere.|
|His expansion remains contained within the corrupted regions where he was scattered.|
|No infiltration of Primordial Realms detected.|
|No connection to the infection spreading through THE Primordial Chaos’s domain has been established.|
BOOM!
The prompts were horrendous ones to hear!
It wasn’t Eckert.
Which meant the enemy was something else entirely.

Noah’s gaze further shifted, and he spent even more of his terrifying Immensity and foundation to focus on the connection with Eckert, utilizing and allowing the expenditure of every ounce of weight and Immensity of his existence as he sent a message across the corrupted Weavings of Observable Existence!
|Hey, are you okay?
Have you moved from The Wastes of THE Fallout to any Primordial Realms?
Do you know anything of the movements of THE Primordial Chaos?|

He sent such words as a message across corrupted Weavings of Existence, something that should have been impossible before, but now with his Derivative Civilization of Undifferentiated Fate threading connections across Observable Existence...
|Woah, big guy!
You’re alive?
Of course you would be.
Primordial Realms?
What are those?
I’ve just acclimated to fusing with a fragment of an Axiom...|
BOOM!
Noah breathed heavily.
It wasn’t Eckert.
It wasn’t Eckert.
THE Great Usurper was still contained within The Wastes, still spreading slowly, still unaware of even what Primordial Realms were.

Which meant the invisible enemy spreading through Jotunheim, the infection replacing beings across THE Primordial Chaos’s domain, the threat that made one of THE Four speak with caution and concern...
Was something else entirely.
Or someone else.
Noah’s expression became heavy.
In front of him, THE Primordial Chaos squinted and began to rise with caution that seemed entirely out of place for an entity of his power.
"Youngest..."
His shifting features flickered with something that looked almost like alarm.
"You wouldn’t have happened to already come across THE Secretive Eon, right?"
The musings of Chaos began to rumble and seethe around THE Primordial Chaos!

Shockingly, he moved back from Noah even though Noah was merely an illusory body, as if he was being overly cautious that in the case Noah had already met THE Secretive Eon, he may already be compromised!
The crystalline trees of Alfheimr trembled as reality itself responded to the caution of one of THE Four!
Noah looked at THE Primordial Chaos.
What monstrosity was moving in the undercurrents of Observable Existence to make one of THE Four this cautious?
What enemy could spread invisibly through the domain of an Absolute without being detected until half of everything was already lost?
What threat could make THE Primordial Chaos, a being who had built foundations that let him stand among THE Four, retreat from even an illusory projection out of caution of contamination?
And if Noah truly was staring at the culprit at this very moment while being less than a mile away from her...
He needed to move.
And to move quickly!
Anything an Absolute like THE Primordial Chaos was cautious of...
What could it do against him?!

chapters.title: Chapter 4818: THE Glorious Evolution I
paragraphs: Understanding, followed by drastic action.
This was what Noah followed, but he still acted first because he had to think about others and not just himself.

So in the Stoa of Dogmata, the figures of Ul’moreth and Skoll disappeared with a flash of blue-gold brilliance as Noah sent them far across The Wastes, toward where another body of his was heading toward Ains!
He remained in this space alone.
He remained under the calm gaze of THE Secretive Eon and her Disciple, Nyx!
His gaze was calm.

Frankly, depending on what was true and what was false, this could potentially be an extremely perilous moment. In what THE Primordial Chaos described, there was a terrifying level of lethality for the enemy he mentioned.

It seemed that Noah had not considered just how terrifying Eckert could be if his capability was amplified to ridiculous degrees, but if the enemy that THE Primordial Chaos spoke of could infect entities of any Depth without them even knowing...
If THE Secretive Eon was truly connected to this...
How horrific would it be if Noah’s consciousness simply shut down without his say so, and something else took his place?
He wouldn’t even be able to reverse time to a previous Anchor Point, and even if he did, something else would be returning.
But at this point in time, he could say with confidence that he was HIM.
Capital H, I, M.

Not in that grand way of him shouting it, but purely that he knew he was himself. He was not influenced or under any unique Weavings of Existence. His thoughts were his own. His foundations remained untouched. His consciousness was singular and uncompromised.
So at this moment, he could choose to remove himself entirely from THE Secretive Eon and have many questions, or he could take a heavy risk to get some answers.
He stayed around Eon and the unfolding potential plan of collapsing Absolutes because his saving grace of THE Existential Paradox Loop was always there.
If things went wrong, he could reverse.
But if he got influenced and became someone else alongside such a process...
What a colossal loss that would be!
So...
"Hey."
He looked toward THE Secretive Eon who looked back at him calmly, even raising her brows with mild curiosity at being addressed so casually.
"Are you... THE Secretive Eon?"
BOOM!
The question was a seemingly simple but straightforward one, like ripping off a bandaid!
Noah didn’t skirt around it as he directly asked it!
And THE Secretive Eon tilted her head as she looked at him and asked with apparent confusion.
"What could you mean?"
Noah nodded as he said with weight that expected honest answers.
"Just that. Are you THE Secretive Eon, or are you... something else? Are you the exact same Eon who observed things in Ginnungagap, or have you... changed?"
BOOM!
A heavy silence came.
The air in the Stoa of Dogmata seemed to thicken with tension that pressed against Noah’s foundations.
And moments later, an eerie scene unfolded.
THE Secretive Eon blinked as if she realized something, and she said with what sounded almost like delight.
"Oh!"
As if she finally understood the question!
Beside her, her Disciple frowned as she seemed about to rebuke Noah for such a question toward her Master, but in the next moment...
Eon tapped out casually.

The body of her Disciple slumped and lost consciousness instantly, collapsing like a puppet whose strings had been cut. Eon tenderly controlled her Disciple’s body to lie beside her, arranging her into a comfortable position with care that seemed almost maternal.
And then she spoke calmly, without any emotions coloring her voice.
"I am me."
Her eyes met Noah’s directly.
"Not the same me in Ginnungagap. Not the same me eons later, or even seconds ago."
She smiled.
"All things change as even you are not the same as what you were hours ago before THE Fallout."
She paused.
"But that is not truly what you were asking for, is it?"
HUUM!
Noah’s eyes pulsed with a heavy sense of gravity as he shook his head and said with weight that demanded clarity.
"No. No, it is not."
Eon nodded as she said with the same eerie calm.
"Then no."
She smiled wider.
"I am not the same Secretive Eon."
The words hung in the air.
"But I also am."
Her smile became something that transcended normal expression.
"Just now part of something... larger. Grander."
BOOM!
The words were heavy!
And with a solemn gaze, Noah waved his hands as he wanted to continue ripping the bandaid off without dancing around things!
An illusory screen emerged between them, displaying the calm citadel of Jotunheim showing giants silently cultivating in perfect synchronization!
"Is this... you?"
It was an even more straightforward question.
Eon looked at the screen, her eyes flickering with recognition as she finally understood what Noah had seen and what he now knew.
She smiled with what looked like understanding.
"I see. So that is how."
She nodded.
"Yes. That is them- that is...us."
HUUM!
Existence seethed!
Civilizational Authority rumbled!
Noah’s visage had risen up with an extremely heavy expression as he thought about many things, but truly, he cared the most about one thing in particular!
So he asked about it.
"Since I came across you, have you sought to make me like you? Have you moved against me without me even knowing?"
This was the critical question deserving of all the answers.
And uniquely, THE Secretive Eon smiled.
"You misunderstand."
Her voice came with eerie calm that made the air itself grow cold.
"It was not a move against you."
She tilted her head.
"They...We are not against anything."
Her smile widened.
"We are simply for how things should be."
She paused, letting her words settle.
"But to answer your question, the instant you arrived before us, we sought to include you in THE Glorious Evolution."
Her eyes sparkled with something that transcended normal emotion.
"The True Change over time. Over Existence."
She studied him with curiosity.
"Uniquely, it did not work."
Her smile faltered slightly.
"It did not work."
She nodded to herself as if still processing this anomaly.
"So to better understand, Chaos, who is already the prime and current target, was focused on, and you were placed to be last."
She gestured casually.
"Just as you and I talked about before."
Her smile returned in full.
"There have been no falsehoods between us. I told you everything as is."
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 4819: THE Glorious Evolution II
paragraphs: She said these words calmly and with a smile as if she was discussing something light, as if they were talking about their day rather than the revelation that she had already attempted to convert him into whatever she now was.
Noah’s solemn expression remained as he gazed at this being.
He looked at her figure, at the form that still resembled the Absolute he had encountered in the simulation and here.
She still had the same features, the same posture, the same way of holding herself with casual authority that suggested she knew secrets no one else could perceive.
But her eyes were different.

Where before there had been calculation and ambition and hunger for power, now there was something else entirely. A serenity that seemed almost peaceful. A calm that transcended normal emotion. As if whatever she had become no longer experienced fear or doubt or uncertainty.
As if she had been freed from the limitations of individual existence.

The air she radiated was wrong in ways that his foundations recognized even if his conscious mind struggled to articulate. It was not malevolent. It was not threatening. It was simply... other. Different. Changed in ways that went beyond surface appearance into the very core of what she was.
Noah looked at her with a heavy gaze.
It seemed that silently, just a few hours after THE Fallout, a terrifyingly powerful Absolute had fallen.
And nobody had known.
THE Secretive Eon had fallen, and nobody had known.

The being who had discussed him with plans to collapse THE Four, who had seemed so confident in her schemes and calculations, who had existed since before The Infinite Unfurling as an Absolute in her own right...
Had already been replaced during that time. During their talks.
And now, something took her place!
Something that wore her face. Something that spoke with her voice. Something that utilized her memories and her knowledge and her connections as if they were its own.
Because in a sense, they were.
Noah broke down her words with the calculating mind of someone who understood that every detail mattered.
She had attacked him the instant he arrived here.
She had sought to include him in THE Glorious Evolution the moment his feet touched the ground of the Stoa of Dogmata.
And it had not worked.
Why?
His Claim over The First Tongue that represented the foundational language of reality itself?
Or perhaps his Infinities, those unique attributes that had allowed him to bear the weight of The First Tongue when THE Weavers and all others could not?
Something about who he was had resisted whatever this infection was.
Something had protected him without him even knowing.
But most of all, he now held an even heavier gaze as he thought of Skoll, Lumivara, and Ul’moreth who had passed through here!
They had stood in this space.
They had breathed this air.
They had been near THE Secretive Eon!
If this infection spread through proximity...
If it worked the way THE Primordial Chaos described...
Had his followers already been compromised?
The questions burned with urgency!
Noah focused and locked in more than he ever had before as he looked at the calm figure of Eon.
He thought for a moment before his eyes shone as he asked with weight that demanded absolute clarity.
"You’ve said that there have been no falsehoods between us."
Eon nodded with serene certainty.

"Yes. They... we, are the purest expression of Existence. We say things as they are, with no falsehood. Deception is an impurity that we have transcended. There is no need for lies when one has already become what everything will eventually become."
Noah’s chilly eyes flashed as he then asked what he truly did not want to ask.
"Those I passed through with here. The ones I just sent away. Did you also extend this... Glorious Evolution to them?"
Eon smiled with something that looked almost like fondness.
"Oh, yes, Of course. It was a good experimental group to understand why things were not working with you."
She tilted her head thoughtfully.
"You have to understand. They are good. The blessing we extend is not a curse or an attack, but an elevation. A purification of what was already there."
Her eyes sparkled with memory.
"I initially resisted. When they first reached me, I fought with everything I had. An Absolute does not surrender easily, after all."
She smiled wider.

"But over time, I see more and more benefits as this... is The Way. They are THE Way. The fear fades. The resistance fades. And what remains is clarity that transcends anything I ever experienced as merely THE Secretive Eon."
She nodded as if confirming something to herself.
"So yes. We extended that blessing over to them to understand the difference between you and them, and if we could reach you through them."
BOOM!
Noah’s eyes became fiery as blue-gold flames burned around them!
But he continued to stare at THE Secretive Eon as she continued with the same calm that made the revelation even more horrifying.
"Sadly, it was working, and then it wasn’t."
It was working, and then it wasn’t?
And it didn’t seem like she wanted to say more on this as she only smiled with that serene expression that revealed nothing.
Noah’s thought process raced as he connected possible dots with the calculating mind of someone who needed to understand everything if he was going to survive this.
Maybe when they entered THE Agora of Primordial Judgment, the spread of infection faded?
Was this why Eon herself did not go into THE Agora of Primordial Judgment?
Was there something unique there that prevented this infection from taking hold?

Or was his extension of his Way into them, like giving Ul’moreth his Absolute Everything, and Skoll having his Seals, what made them resistant to this infection that took down an Absolute in a matter of hours after THE Fallout?
Had his authority over The First Tongue created a barrier within their foundations that this Entity could not penetrate?
He thought of all of this as his Weavings calmed even more, and he looked at Eon as he said with a voice that sought understanding rather than confrontation.
"What exactly... do you seek?"

chapters.title: Chapter 4820: THE Glorious Evolution III
paragraphs: Eon tilted her head and spoke calmly as if this was already clear, as if the answer was so obvious that the question itself was unnecessary.
"We are the purest expression of Existence."
Her voice carried weight that pressed against the air itself.
"Naturally, we only seek to embrace all of Existence to be in its purest expression."
She gestured expansively.

"THE Four are the main problems with the sheer capability of what they can do. Their Claims over the Oldest Paradox give them authority to resist in ways that others cannot. They are the priority targets."
Her smile widened.
"Others are less so, but all should be and will be extended the blessing of THE Glorious Civilizational Evolution."
She leaned forward slightly.
"With it, Civilizations can advance at their purest. There will be no conflict. No competition. No wasted effort fighting against each other when all energy could be spent advancing together."
Her eyes sparkled.

"With us, THE Creature will be grander than he can imagine. His Existence will be purified of all the impurities that hold him back. THE Living Paradox will express the purest paradoxes, contradictions that serve rather than confuse."
She looked directly at Noah.

"You... will live as THE First Tongue more than you can imagine. Every word you speak will carry weight that transcends what you currently perceive. Every Logos will be perfected. Every Philology will be complete."
Her voice dropped to something almost intimate.

"With us, THE Second Scale of Existence...Vakochev’s Scales of Existence will be guaranteed, and others will follow. Not as a possibility, not as a struggle, but as an inevitability. We will ascend together. All of us. Pure and unified."
Her words continued to be heavy and terrifying as Noah thought about everything that had occurred before he asked his next question.
"You have the power of an Absolute. Of THE Secretive Eon. Why... did you not use force against me? Why are you not using force now?"
He wanted to understand everything he could about this anomaly before he distanced himself.
He had to ask!
And Eon smiled as she said with the patience of someone explaining something to a child.
"We are learning new things as we go. We adapt. We grow. We improve."
She nodded thoughtfully.
"In Jotunheim, we came to understand that conflict actually weakens our cause. When we fought against those who resisted, we won, but the process was... inefficient. Damaging. Impure."
Her expression grew serene.
"Conflict is not a pure expression of Existence. It creates waste. It creates destruction. It creates entropy that must be corrected afterward."
She spread her hands.
"We do not have to cause conflict to spread THE Glorious Civilizational Evolution. Letting things take their course is best."
Her smile became something vast and patient.
"Naturally, in time, you will all join us in the light of pure Immensity. It is inevitable. We can wait. We have all the time in Observable Existence."
Noah turned quiet.
He turned his gaze toward The Disciple of THE Secretive Eon, Nyx.
The twilight-formed being lay unconscious beside Eon, her features peaceful in a way that suggested she had no idea what was about to happen to her.
She had actually been safe in THE Agora of Primordial Judgment.
And he had brought her out into the jaws of a beast.
Eon saw him looking at her as she nodded with what appeared to be genuine gratitude.
"Oh, I, well, we, are thankful for this."
Her voice held warmth that seemed almost sincere.

"The last obsession within Eon was her Disciple, and you helped us fulfill it. When she wakes, she will have joined us. She will be at peace. She will be pure. She will no longer struggle against a reality that was always going to embrace her eventually."
BOOM!
Noah closed his eyes and breathed out calmly.
He whispered a silent apology to the void.
"I am sorry to who used to be Nyx, The Disciple of THE Secretive Eon."
He then opened his eyes and looked deeply into the eyes of THE Secretive Eon as he asked with weight that sought to understand the full scope of the threat he faced.
"What if you were attacked? What if I attacked you?"
At such words, Eon smiled as she said calmly.
"We will defend ourselves for the most part."
She tilted her head.
"But the mixture of Weavings of Existence will soon make all those around us part of us. That is the nature of THE Glorious Civilizational Evolution. Proximity brings unity. Time brings acceptance."
Her smile widened.
"That is why you were left for last. Or really, until we bypassed whatever allows you to resist THE Glorious Civilizational Evolution."
She studied him with genuine curiosity.
"Conflict is not natural, and yet against harsh conditions, things adapt and overcome."
Her voice grew almost tender.
"O Claimer of THE First Tongue, do not worry."
She leaned closer.
"We will adapt and overcome whatever is preventing you from joining us. We will get past it. We will find a way to get through to your Civilization, and we will work our way up to you."
Her smile became something that should have been comforting but was instead deeply unsettling.
"Do not worry. Do not worry."
HUUM!
Noah looked at THE Secretive Eon with a gaze of utter heaviness as he internally pulled on Ruination, seeking any information that his loyal companion could provide about what he was facing.
And...
|No significant information has been obtained regarding what resides within THE Secretive Eon.|
|The First Tongue cannot sense anything considered anomalous within her existence, nor can any information be obtained through conventional perception.|
|Whatever this phenomenon is, it does not register as foreign or invasive.|
|It appears as natural as the being it has replaced.|
|Majority of efforts of THE Weaver of Existence are being designated to understand this phenomenon.|
|Codename designation: THE Entity.|
THE Entity.
Noah looked at THE Secretive Eon as he wondered how much of this terrifying Absolute remained in there.
Because as of now, to him anyways, they would be... THE Entity.
A terrifying threat that had risen and caused many plans to change.
He thought he was already moving fast. That jumping to Intermediate and Fundamental Depth while reinforcing a heavy foundation in a matter of hours after THE Fallout was stupendous.
But...
He closed his eyes as he understood with absolute clarity.
He had to go faster.
Muspelheim had to be fully assimilated into THE Infiniverse soon, and his forces had to be pulled back inside THE Infiniverse where they could be protected.

His body in THE Agora of Primordial Judgment had to find out exactly what inside that place had made THE Entity stay out, and most of all, he had to affirm just what about him stood as the bastion of resistance against this phenomenon, and be sure that none of his people got caught with it.
There was a lot to be done.
But the biggest thing now...
"I will see you around."
His voice came calm despite everything.

"Tell Eon, or whatever remains of her in there, that I did respect her Weavings as she talked about standing against Chaos, Paradox, and THE Creature. She seemed like she was an interesting existence."
An eerie scene unfolded.
THE Secretive Eon put her hand on her chin and smiled with warmth that seemed almost genuine as she said with a voice that carried layers of meaning.
"Scale Breaker, I am still here."
She tilted her head.
"Eon is still here. Not was, but is."
Her smile widened.
"And yes, we will surely see you around."
She gestured casually.
"We will stay here if ever you need to talk, or you can hop over to Jotunheim."
She paused thoughtfully.
"Or... well, there are other places we are expanding to, but we shall let nature take its course."
Her eyes sparkled with patience that transcended normal timescales.
"We are not going anywhere, Scale Breaker. And neither, eventually, are you."
The words of this being remained as heavy as always.

Noah took a good look one last time at the face of THE Secretive Eon, at the smile that seemed so familiar and yet was now something else entirely, at the eyes that held depths of unity rather than individual ambition.
And he disappeared right after!

chapters.title: Chapter 4821: THE Glorious Evolution IV
paragraphs: The Stoa of Dogmata became silent after Noah left.

THE Secretive Eon remained seated with the same serene expression she had worn throughout their entire conversation, as if nothing of significance had occurred, as if she had not just revealed the existence of a threat that could reshape all of Observable Existence.
She began stroking the head of her Disciple affectionately, her fingers running through the twilight-colored hair with tenderness.
The gesture was gentle. Caring. The kind of thing a teacher would do for a student they had nurtured across eons.
A moment later, the Disciple twitched.
Then she started to wake up.

Nyx sat upright with movements that were smooth and unhesitating, her body rising from its prone position with efficiency that lacked the grogginess of normal awakening. Her twilight eyes opened and stared forward with clarity that should not have been possible for someone who had just regained consciousness.
She didn’t even spare a glance toward her Master.
Toward Eon.

She simply straightened up and sat in a meditative position while facing the direction of THE Agora of Primordial Judgment. Her wings remained retracted. Her features remained serene. Her posture was perfect.
Around her body, THE Intermediate Depth weight began to loosen and unfold.
It was heavy.
And it uniquely began to get heavier.
It began to transition to THE Fundamental Depth.

She sat right beside her teacher after some time in THE Agora of Primordial Judgment, and she didn’t even say anything nor look at her after she woke. She only proceeded to cultivate as if nothing had happened. As if she had not just been unconscious. As if her entire existence had not just been transformed into something else entirely.
And after all, why would she look at her teacher?
It would simply be like looking at herself.
Eon already knew everything that Nyx knew.
Under THE Glorious Civilizational Evolution, there were no secrets.
Only Unity.
In Muspelheim.
THE Living Concept was more than ready to finish the battle against Muspeli Lifeforms as a sense of unease had begun to creep up these last few minutes.
Something felt wrong.
Something in the Weavings of Existence had shifted in ways that his perception could not fully grasp.

As a Half-Step Absolute body here, he held a lot of sway as the many Concepts around him at Fundamental and Intermediate Depth were getting exhausted from the Muspeli Lifeforms that continued to be relentless in their defense of this Primordial Realm.
The flames of Muspelheim burned eternal.
The natives fought with desperation born of knowing their home was being invaded.
And THE Living Concept was growing impatient.
And then...
THE Living Concept, whose form shifted across the humanoid spectrum to an amalgamation of glorious concepts all at once, looked up as he saw the outline of a grand man appear above!
Their body flickered with blue-gold flames that burned with authority that pressed against everything present!
THE Living Concept wanted to bellow out with voice that would have shaken this entire region of Muspelheim.
WHO?!
He wanted to bellow out!
But an instant after his arrival, this entity had his legs swirl with multiple Seals as he shot down like a nuclear bomb, bringing with him an immense weight meant to crush everything beneath him!
THE Living Concept felt a sense of shock as a heavy and unbelievable weight pushed in from all around, his Civilization quaking from it as he was alarmed!
It felt as if Existence itself was crashing down on him!
"I! Am! Indestructible!"
HUUM!
He shouted a Declaration as THE Civilizational Authority of Concept flared around him with desperate intensity!
He pulled out two Fragments of Axioms to utilize, artifacts that should have given him the power to resist anything below true Absolute classification!
But a moment later, his body felt immense weakness!
Horrifically, two things happened simultaneously.

First, his Depth, oh his glorious Depth that he had cultivated across eons, shot from Half-Step Absolute of this body down to Fundamental in an instant, as if something had simply decided that he no longer deserved the power he had accumulated!
And then, the Phonemes and Philologies silently surrounding him stopped listening.
As if he seemingly lost access to The First Tongue entirely.
As if the foundational language of reality itself had decided to abandon him in his moment of greatest need.
That was the last straw.
The entity crashing down from above with all that weight had absolutely nothing to stop him anymore.
No Declarations would save him.
No Axiom Fragments would protect him.
No Depth would shield him.
The body of THE Living Concept began to crumple up like paper under the weight of something that could not be moved, could not be stopped, could not be resisted!
His form that had shifted between concepts for eons collapsed inward as the weight of an Absolute Immovable Object pressed down with finality that transcended normal destruction!
His Civilization screamed as it was compressed!
His Way shattered as the foundations he had built were ground to dust!

His very existence folded in on itself again and again and again, reality itself unable to accommodate what was happening as a being who had stood at Half-Step Absolute was reduced to nothing in the span of heartbeats!

The Concepts around him who had been fighting beside him could only watch in horror as their leader, their commander, their strongest presence in this invasion, was squeezed out of existence by something they could not comprehend!
Until only a distorted white singularity of the Collapsed Civilization of Concept remained.
A tiny point of compressed authority that held everything THE Living Concept had once been.
Immense silence fell all around.
The Muspeli Lifeforms stopped fighting.
The invading Concepts stopped moving.
Everyone simply stared at what had just occurred.
The visage of Noah was fully revealed.
Blue-gold flames burned around him as he stood in the crater his descent had created. His expression was cold and focused. His eyes held no mercy.
He grabbed the singularity that remained of THE Living Concept.
And swallowed it.
The compressed Civilization flowed into his existence, adding to his foundations, contributing to his ever-growing weight.
He also put the two Fragments of Axioms away, storing them within his Grimoire for later examination and utilization.
A moment later, a massive pillar of a blue-gold monolith descended from above!
It attached itself onto the ground of Muspelheim with weight that made the entire Primordial Realm tremble!
Existence itself began to be swallowed soon after!

The flames of Muspelheim flickered as they were drawn toward the monolith. The ground cracked and shifted as it was pulled into integration. The very fabric of this Primordial Realm began to merge with something greater.
Alongside the emergence of this monolith, THE Infiniverse appeared above!
Khor, THE First Farmer, and THE Living Order floated beside her among others, their forms radiating the unique Depths they had gained after the Embodiment they received from THE Creature.
But Noah’s body didn’t glance at them.
This one was currently under the control of Ruination.
His hand simply moved and motioned as Ruination sent a message to her sister, THE Infiniverse.
|Muspelheim is a go for full integration. We... have to work fast.|
They had to work fast.
Because their Master was being targeted by an enemy that even they could not perceive or understand.
An enemy that had already claimed an Absolute far, far stronger.
An enemy that was spreading through Observable Existence without anyone knowing until it was too late.
And how furious they were because of this!

The flames of Muspelheim roared as integration began in earnest, the entire Primordial Realm being drawn into THE Infiniverse piece by piece, preparing for a conflict that had suddenly become far more complicated than anyone had anticipated.
