chapters.title: Chapter 4822: Big Stepper! I
paragraphs: Existence was a wondrous, fantastical thing, and Existence was also a terrifying thing.
Noah always looked forward to Existence and what was unfolding with great interest as it was hard to explain, but he sometimes felt like a participant and other times an observer.

Things happened and continued happening across Observable Existence as he only heard of them or observed them from a distance. Wars broke out. Civilizations rose and fell. Absolutes schemed against each other in games that had been playing out since the Infinite Unfurling.
As for when it came to himself and his path, he actively walked and participated in it.

Regardless of what he came across, he still kept his view that Existence was grand, and he wanted to understand all he could about it. To uncover all its wonders. To perceive what others could not perceive. To grasp what others could not grasp.

So regardless of the enemy that had appeared who had such a terrifying power to be capable of defeating an Absolute on the level of entities like THE Living Temporal or even approaching one of THE Four, he still looked forward to understanding Existence, what this enemy entailed, and how he could overcome it.
Regardless of the cost, and no matter what.
But he did have to make sure that in this battle, his people were not among the cost.
He had to.
He...
"That is a lonely gaze, Little Anomaly. You have changed a lot."
The voice of Ains, THE Fisherman, echoed out as he let go of the hairy shoulder of Ul’moreth and even kneeled down to play with Skoll!
Noah’s gaze shifted to take in the figure of Ains fully.

THE Fisherman looked much the same as he always had. A straw hat sat atop his head, weathered and worn from countless eons of use. A fishing rod rested behind his back, its line extending into dimensions that normal perception could not follow. His clothes were simple, rough-spun fabrics that seemed entirely out of place on someone who stood at Half-Step Absolute Depth.
He looked like a vagrant who had wandered in from some backwater realm.

And yet when Noah looked at him, he felt the weight of someone who had given up everything for the sake of a stranger. Someone who had sacrificed his position, his standing, to ensure that Noah could continue on his path.
That was not something that could be repaid easily.
They were currently in a region of The Wastes of THE Fallout as they had reached Ains and were reunited, but Noah was thinking of too many things that Ains even managed to read his gaze somewhat.

The corruption of The Wastes swirled around them, but it could not touch beings of their caliber. The twisted landscapes stretched in all directions, remnants of what THE Living Paradox had done to Observable Existence.
Noah looked at this being that had sacrificed much for him as Ains now stood at Half-Step Absolute.
And at the same time, the meditative Ul’moreth also opened his eyes as if he could sense the wrongness.
His countless hairs shifted with agitation as he asked with weight that demanded honest answers.
"What made you send us away from that place? From THE Secretive Eon?"
Ul’moreth got to the root of the issue.
Noah looked at this hairy teacher of his and said with heaviness.
"THE Secretive Eon has already been collapsed as something else wears its face."
His voice carried weight that made the air itself grow still.
"Something capable of infecting anything and anyone without them even knowing it."
He paused.
"They tried to infect me, and you all."
His eyes grew darker.
"Our consciousness would likely be wiped out as if it had happened to me, I would be walking and talking with you, and you would think I am me without knowing something else replaced me."
He shook his head.
"It is a difficult enemy, and there are currently no solutions as it cannot even be pinpointed."
BOOM!
His words were heavy as they caused Ul’moreth and Ains to frown while Skoll sat like a good boy and watched them with eyes that held understanding beyond what a normal dog should possess!
"Existence is vast, and there are countless possibilities."
Ains spoke with the calm of someone who had weathered many storms across his long existence.
"THE Living Paradox and THE Creature played so many games, something horrific was bound to happen sooner or later."
He scratched behind Skoll’s ears.
"But being part of a Civilization means that you do not have to go through it alone."
He looked up at Noah.
"You have others."
Ul’moreth rose from his meditative position as he added with weight that carried the authority of a teacher addressing his student.
"And you have your Teacher."
His countless hairs swayed with intensity that spoke of something building within him.
"Teachers should never be helpless before their students."
Ul’moreth said such words as Noah’s eyes focused on him, feeling like this hairy old man was about to do something drastic!
The Weavings around Ul’moreth became heavier and heavier.

At this moment, he rose up fully as countless Philologies swirled around him in patterns that spoke of linguistic authority that had been accumulated across eons of existence within THE Belly of Existence.
The First Tongue loved him.
As a Perfect Speaker, he loved it even more.
And at this moment, he raised his leg as if he were taking a step.
A step!
He had said all he needed was a step, but this step was heavy!
"My student is facing problems he should not face alone."
Ul’moreth’s voice began simply, carrying the warmth of a teacher who had watched his student grow from nothing into something that could challenge THE Four themselves.
"As a backer of The First Tongue, I have spent too many eons to not be an Absolute right now."
His countless hairs blazed with blue-gold light as The First Tongue itself seemed to respond to his words.
"Especially after what I have just been given."
The Absolute Everything that Noah had provided pulsed within his foundations.
"So with this step..."
His voice grew heavier.
"I will either be Absolute..."
The Weavings of Existence around him trembled with anticipation.
"Or I will be nothing."
BOOM!
His words began simply, but toward the end, they shockingly turned into a semblance of a partial Embodiment!
One where Ul’moreth staked his existence on!
He took this step as either he utilized the Absolute Everything as a foothold to throw himself to Absolute Depth, or he ceased to exist!
There was no middle ground.
There was no safety net.
There was only advancement or annihilation.
And he did it all for the sake of his student.

Noah watched with eyes that blazed with blue-gold intensity as his teacher, the being who had guided him through the complexities of The First Tongue, who had introduced the very Phoneme of Fire to him, who had been imprisoned within THE Belly of Existence for eons...
Took the most important step of his entire existence!

sentences.text: Existence was a wondrous, fantastical thing, and Existence was also a terrifying thing.
Noah always looked forward to Existence and what was unfolding with great interest as it was hard to explain, but he sometimes felt like a participant and other times an observer.
Things happened and continued happening across Observable Existence as he only heard of them or observed them from a distance.
Wars broke out.
Civilizations rose and fell.
Absolutes schemed against each other in games that had been playing out since the Infinite Unfurling.
As for when it came to himself and his path, he actively walked and participated in it.
Regardless of what he came across, he still kept his view that Existence was grand, and he wanted to understand all he could about it.
To uncover all its wonders.
To perceive what others could not perceive.
To grasp what others could not grasp.

So regardless of the enemy that had appeared who had such a terrifying power to be capable of defeating an Absolute on the level of entities like THE Living Temporal or even approaching one of THE Four, he still looked forward to understanding Existence, what this enemy entailed, and how he could overcome it.
Regardless of the cost, and no matter what.
But he did have to make sure that in this battle, his people were not among the cost.
He had to.
He...
"That is a lonely gaze, Little Anomaly.
You have changed a lot."
The voice of Ains, THE Fisherman, echoed out as he let go of the hairy shoulder of Ul’moreth and even kneeled down to play with Skoll!
Noah’s gaze shifted to take in the figure of Ains fully.
THE Fisherman looked much the same as he always had.
A straw hat sat atop his head, weathered and worn from countless eons of use.
A fishing rod rested behind his back, its line extending into dimensions that normal perception could not follow.
His clothes were simple, rough-spun fabrics that seemed entirely out of place on someone who stood at Half-Step Absolute Depth.
He looked like a vagrant who had wandered in from some backwater realm.
And yet when Noah looked at him, he felt the weight of someone who had given up everything for the sake of a stranger.
Someone who had sacrificed his position, his standing, to ensure that Noah could continue on his path.
That was not something that could be repaid easily.
They were currently in a region of The Wastes of THE Fallout as they had reached Ains and were reunited, but Noah was thinking of too many things that Ains even managed to read his gaze somewhat.
The corruption of The Wastes swirled around them, but it could not touch beings of their caliber.
The twisted landscapes stretched in all directions, remnants of what THE Living Paradox had done to Observable Existence.
Noah looked at this being that had sacrificed much for him as Ains now stood at Half-Step Absolute.
And at the same time, the meditative Ul’moreth also opened his eyes as if he could sense the wrongness.
His countless hairs shifted with agitation as he asked with weight that demanded honest answers.
"What made you send us away from that place?
From THE Secretive Eon?"
Ul’moreth got to the root of the issue.
Noah looked at this hairy teacher of his and said with heaviness.
"THE Secretive Eon has already been collapsed as something else wears its face."
His voice carried weight that made the air itself grow still.
"Something capable of infecting anything and anyone without them even knowing it."
He paused.
"They tried to infect me, and you all."
His eyes grew darker.
"Our consciousness would likely be wiped out as if it had happened to me, I would be walking and talking with you, and you would think I am me without knowing something else replaced me."
He shook his head.
"It is a difficult enemy, and there are currently no solutions as it cannot even be pinpointed."
BOOM!
His words were heavy as they caused Ul’moreth and Ains to frown while Skoll sat like a good boy and watched them with eyes that held understanding beyond what a normal dog should possess!
"Existence is vast, and there are countless possibilities."
Ains spoke with the calm of someone who had weathered many storms across his long existence.
"THE Living Paradox and THE Creature played so many games, something horrific was bound to happen sooner or later."
He scratched behind Skoll’s ears.
"But being part of a Civilization means that you do not have to go through it alone."
He looked up at Noah.
"You have others."
Ul’moreth rose from his meditative position as he added with weight that carried the authority of a teacher addressing his student.
"And you have your Teacher."
His countless hairs swayed with intensity that spoke of something building within him.
"Teachers should never be helpless before their students."
Ul’moreth said such words as Noah’s eyes focused on him, feeling like this hairy old man was about to do something drastic!
The Weavings around Ul’moreth became heavier and heavier.

At this moment, he rose up fully as countless Philologies swirled around him in patterns that spoke of linguistic authority that had been accumulated across eons of existence within THE Belly of Existence.
The First Tongue loved him.
As a Perfect Speaker, he loved it even more.
And at this moment, he raised his leg as if he were taking a step.
A step!
He had said all he needed was a step, but this step was heavy!
"My student is facing problems he should not face alone."
Ul’moreth’s voice began simply, carrying the warmth of a teacher who had watched his student grow from nothing into something that could challenge THE Four themselves.
"As a backer of The First Tongue, I have spent too many eons to not be an Absolute right now."
His countless hairs blazed with blue-gold light as The First Tongue itself seemed to respond to his words.
"Especially after what I have just been given."
The Absolute Everything that Noah had provided pulsed within his foundations.
"So with this step..."
His voice grew heavier.
"I will either be Absolute..."
The Weavings of Existence around him trembled with anticipation.
"Or I will be nothing."
BOOM!
His words began simply, but toward the end, they shockingly turned into a semblance of a partial Embodiment!
One where Ul’moreth staked his existence on!
He took this step as either he utilized the Absolute Everything as a foothold to throw himself to Absolute Depth, or he ceased to exist!
There was no middle ground.
There was no safety net.
There was only advancement or annihilation.
And he did it all for the sake of his student.

Noah watched with eyes that blazed with blue-gold intensity as his teacher, the being who had guided him through the complexities of The First Tongue, who had introduced the very Phoneme of Fire to him, who had been imprisoned within THE Belly of Existence for eons...
Took the most important step of his entire existence!

chapters.title: Chapter 4823: Big Stepper! II
paragraphs: In Observable Existence, there is a chasm called the Divide of Becoming.

It separates what beings are from what they could be. Many stand at its edge across their entire lives, staring into the vast emptiness between their current selves and their potential. They measure the distance. They calculate the odds. They prepare endlessly for a jump they never intend to make.
And they die at the edge, having never learned what waited on the other side.
The Absolutes whisper among themselves that greatness is not earned through accumulation alone.

You can gather power for eons. You can build foundations until they stretch across Observable Existence itself. You can prepare and plan and perfect every aspect of your Way until nothing seems capable of stopping your advance.
But the final step cannot be walked.
It must be leaped.

There is a moment in every being’s journey where the ground simply ends. Where no amount of preparation can guarantee success. Where the only path forward requires releasing everything safe and familiar and trusting that what you have built will carry you across the void.

Those who hesitate at this moment, who decide they need just a little more time, just a little more power, just a little more certainty before they commit, find that the edge crumbles beneath their feet anyway.
The chasm does not wait for readiness!
Those who cannot find themselves capable of taking that single leap, who cling to safety when Existence demands courage, will always remain in the dredges of nothingness.
And it is because potential means nothing to those unwilling to risk everything for its realization.
A being who dies mid-leap has lived more truly than one who dies having never jumped at all!
A step!
Ul’moreth took a heavy and ridiculous step with all of his existence as the moment he did so, his foundation, his Immensity, his glory erupted!
Noah looked at the scene with heavy eyes.

What he saw was the emergence of an unfathomable Depth that blazed with authority he had not expected to witness so soon. The weight that Ul’moreth carried had been building across eons within THE Belly of Existence, accumulating foundation after foundation while being suppressed from ever reaching this final threshold.
And now, with the Absolute Everything serving as the catalyst, all of that accumulated potential was exploding outward at once.

Noah estimated that what he was witnessing equaled perhaps five to ten percent of the Depth he had currently forged after swallowing the recoverable authority of THE Weavers. It seemed small in comparison to his own foundations, but this was an Absolute being born who was not one of THE Four. This was a being crossing the threshold that separated those who shaped reality from those who merely existed within it.
Five to ten percent of his current foundational weight, concentrated into a single being who would now stand among the most powerful!
That was no small thing.
|THE First Tongue observes its follower take a step toward glory.|
|THE First Tongue, THE Weaver of Existence, blesses this follower and adds a platform of his Foundation to aid in this step toward Absolute.|
|The blessing is given freely.|
|The blessing is given with pride.|
BOOM!
Noah saw the emergence of glory!

His Weavings moved as twenty-seven Seals formed into a platform underneath the foot of Ul’moreth, elevating him ever higher as in that moment, a terrifying aura of Immensity began to shine from Ul’moreth in splendorous obsidian-gold light!
The transformation was magnificent.
Noah watched as the hairs of this being exploded in number!

Where before Ul’moreth had countless hairs that obscured most of his form, now those hairs multiplied exponentially until they seemed to fill the very air around him. His hairy foot that had almost been showing itself became covered even more densely than before!
What!

Noah had thought that with a grand transformation, Ul’moreth might shed his hair and finally be observed without it! He had imagined that reaching Absolute would reveal the true form beneath those countless strands!
But his existence erupted with even more obsidian-gold hair instead!
His outline became hazy as he looked like a round mass of hairs that had achieved sentience and decided to become one of the more powerful beings in Observable Existence!
But apart from this hair...
DUM!
Was a beat.
But it was not a heartbeat.
It was the beat of something far more profound, shining with the splendor of Absolute authority that resonated across dimensions and distances that defied normal comprehension.
Noah could sense it.
He could feel it!
His Mana seethed with recognition!
The First Tongue burned brilliantly in response to what was occurring!
And an obsidian-gold pillar of light shot up from Ul’moreth and stretched out across Observable Existence!
It was a sign.
A sign of the emergence of an Absolute.

Every Absolute across Observable Existence would perceive this pillar. They would know that someone new had joined their ranks. They would wonder who this being was and what their emergence meant for the balance of power that had been shifting so rapidly since THE Fallout began.
|Absolute Emergence Confirmed|
|An Absolute backing your Way has risen, also by your hands.|
|THE Teacher of THE First Tongue has taken a step and staked everything to succeed.|
|He has gained the distinctions of THE Big Stepper, THE Teacher, THE Primeval Titan, THE Aeon-Strand Keeper.|
|The Way of Primordial Continuity under Ul’moreth shall preserve THE First Tongue even if Existence itself collapses.|
|This is his oath.|
|This is his purpose.|
|THE Absolute Depth of Primordial Continuity, a specialization of THE First Tongue, has established itself across Observable Existence as Absolute, and it has been embodied by THE Big Stepper.|
BOOM!
Off to the side, Ains smiled brilliantly with genuine joy for his old companion who had finally achieved what had been denied to him for so long within THE Belly of Existence!
Skoll jumped and did a backflip with enthusiasm that only a very good dog could muster, his neon flames blazing brighter in celebration!
And...
|Harvest Assessment|
|Since the advent of THE Fallout and the hours that have passed, an Absolute has fallen under your hands, and another Absolute has risen with your aid.|
|A Harvest of Quintessential Immensity flows to your existence from this momentous achievement.|
|The Harvest of Infinite Potential from the backing of an Absolute flows to your Existence.|
|It is estimated to elevate your comparative percentage of Foundation at Fundamental Depth by 15-20%.|
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 4824: Just Let Go I
paragraphs: His own existence buzzed as a harvest almost equivalent to when he collapsed THE Weavers began to flood into him!
The authority that came from having an Absolute back your Way was immense. It was a relationship that benefited both parties in ways that transcended normal understanding.
But right now wasn’t about him.
He looked at the one who had taught him the Phonemes of The First Tongue.

The glorious visage of Ul’moreth shone with obsidian and gold light that blazed against the corrupted backdrop of The Wastes of THE Fallout. The abundance of hair that surrounded him seemed to pulse with life of its own, each strand carrying authority that would have crushed Fundamental Depth entities through proximity alone.

The hair looked like it was hiding a mountain of Immensity and wonder beneath its countless strands. Like the true form of Ul’moreth was something so vast and profound that it required this covering to exist within normal space without tearing reality apart.
Even though Noah could barely perceive the humanoid visage of Ul’moreth underneath all that hair, he felt like he could see eyes shining in obsidian-gold that held immense pride and thankfulness.
But there was no need for that between teacher and student.
Noah’s own eyes seemed to convey this understanding as the first words Ul’moreth spoke as his existence radiated the glory of an Absolute were delivered in The First Tongue itself.
|Little Anomaly, how can your teacher be of help? No student should have to bear the weight of Existence alone.|
He spoke with a voice that resonated across dimensions, filled with earnestness and Immensity that made the air itself tremble with the weight of his sincerity.
Noah felt his existence buzzing as he smiled toward Ul’moreth.
"There is much to be done, but first... let’s get you decked out."
As he said this, he closed his eyes and thrust his hand out to empty space as he accessed THE Absolute Existential Palace of THE Weavers!

Inside of it, his hand appeared like a phantom over the treasure vault where the items he could not previously grasp still waited. He reached toward two things that had resisted his collection before.
He looked toward his teacher as he said with a smile that held anticipation.
"Let’s use your power as an Absolute to pull out a few things from a coffin."
The moment he said this, the Weavings of Undifferentiated Fate wrapped around Ul’moreth in obsidian-gold light!
A hairy hand thrust out from the mass of strands that was now THE Big Stepper!
It delved into the pocket of space Noah had opened, quickly burning blue-gold to mimic Noah’s aura as it reached into THE Absolute Existential Palace of THE Weavers!
And then it pulled!
BOOM!
Massive Golden Scissors gushed out of the pocket with authority that made reality itself groan in protest!
THE Axiom of Absolute Denial followed, its crystalline form of impossible geometry blazing with obsidian threaded with gold that spoke of power beyond what most beings could comprehend!
Ul’moreth grasped them both!
Noah looked at his teacher grasping the Golden Scissors, of which there were two more sets remaining in the Tomb of THE Weavers, in one hairy hand, and THE Axiom of Absolute Denial in another.
The aura Ul’moreth radiated was grand beyond description.
And Noah could not help but appreciate how truly nice it was for THE Living Paradox to send THE Weavers and all these gifts his way, only for him to give them to his Teacher instead.
Paradox had armed his enemies.
And those enemies were now arming Noah’s allies.
The irony was delicious.
As he looked at all of this, Noah climbed onto an enlarging Skoll who grew to accommodate his Master with enthusiasm.
"There is much to be done, but let us go toward a friend who has an ability similar to the monstrous enemy that has taken over THE Secretive Eon."
His voice carried determination that spoke of plans already forming.
"We have to see if THE Great Usurper can shed any light on how to at least discover and gain information on this enemy."
A clear step was formed.
After Ul’moreth took one large step toward Absolute, Noah sought to continue others as there was much to be done!
THE Entity had emerged, THE Secretive Eon had fallen, and Half of Jotunheim had been compromised...but Noah was not standing still!
In Alfheimr.

Noah looked out and saw the entire region he was in wrapped around an absolute swirling chaos that looked like stacks of Paradoxical existence and entropy layered upon each other in configurations that defied normal understanding. Even if his main body was here, he wouldn’t be able to break through this barrier that THE Primordial Chaos had erected.
THE Primordial Chaos took no chances.
Ridiculously, he wasn’t even here currently as Noah could barely sense him, as if he had gone to the other side of Alfheimr entirely!
One of THE Four was so cautious of contamination that he had placed an entire Primordial Realm’s worth of distance between himself and someone who had merely been in proximity to THE Entity.
So Noah spoke simply.
"I am immune."
BOOM!
The words were gloriously heavy as in the surroundings, the booming voice of THE Primordial Chaos echoed out from impossibly far away.
"Immune to what? To the spread of that thing? Your consciousness may already be compromised and you do not even know."
Noah was surprised at the shocking level of caution that THE Primordial Chaos showed, with this further cementing just how terrifying this phenomenon they faced was.
"On the Claim that I made on The First Tongue, I swear that I am who I was before THE Fallout, and I am who I was in Ginnungagap."
His voice carried the weight of a Declaration backed by his authority over the foundational language of reality itself.
"Nothing has imposed itself on my will."
BOOM!
After his words, his illusory body here looked over to see the visage of THE Primordial Chaos again as the barrier of swirling entropy thinned slightly.
Noah felt something profound as he looked at the face of Chaos.

This being who had existed since the Infinite Unfurling, who had built foundations that let him stand among THE Four, who could crush other Absolutes with casual effort, was showing visible coldness and apprehension that made his shifting features settle into something almost human.
If THE Primordial Chaos was this cautious, this careful...
Oh!
Chaos then said with calculation returning to his voice.
"Where is THE Secretive Eon now?"

chapters.title: Chapter 4825: Just Let Go II
paragraphs: At this, Noah raised his brows and said with curiosity.
"Oh? What do you plan to do?"
THE Primordial Chaos buzzed with murky obsidian brilliance that radiated outward from his form as he said with weight that spoke of power being gathered.
"I do not want to be anywhere near that thing, but if I know where it is, I could simply attack it from afar."
His shifting features settled into something cold and determined.
"So. What happened between you and it, and what is its last location so I can bombard it with all my weight?"
BOOM!
A glorious situation unfolded as Noah couldn’t help but marvel at the absurdity of existence.
Hours ago, he was talking and planning with Eon about laying an assault on THE Primordial Chaos in Jotunheim.
Now, just hours later, he was with THE Primordial Chaos and listening to plans on collapsing THE Secretive Eon!
How grand and rapid existence could change.
But also...
"Care will have to be taken."
Noah’s voice carried caution that came from understanding more than most about how THE Entity operated.
"THE Secretive Eon is in THE Corrupted Vault of Ginnungagap, outside of THE Agora of Primordial Judgment."
He paused.
"I say care has to be taken because she is outside that Nexus Primordial Realm, and something seems to prevent her from entering, or she herself is choosing not to enter for a reason."
His eyes narrowed.
"And there is still much we don’t know."
Noah saw Chaos’s eyes flash brilliantly after he said these words, with this being seemingly thinking of many things before he ultimately said with weight that pressed against reality itself.
"Youngest, you forget my status and standing."
His shifting features settled into something that looked almost like pride.
"You are the weakest amongst THE Four, but me... I am individually the strongest."
His form blazed with obsidian authority that made the crystalline trees of Alfheimr tremble.
"You may not see it. THE Creature or Paradox may not believe it."
His voice dropped to something that resonated with ancient truth.
"But everything began with Chaos, and all of Existence churns toward Chaos."
He paused.
"Chaos is silent for it does not need to be loud..."
His smile became something vast and terrible.
"But I can be loud. I can be very, very loud."
HUUM!

Such immense words were said as at this moment, THE Primordial Chaos looked at THE First Tongue, and two of THE Four might truly be entering an alliance for the first time since who knew when in the face of a terrible enemy!
And while such a thing happened...
Far from Alfheimr.
In Jotunheim.
In a grand citadel where THE Living Temporal, THE Living Quantum, and THE Living Dimensional were waiting inside a grand structure while they were served by Chaos Giants.
Quantum was looking at Temporal as she said with curiosity that seemed almost casual.
"Why the large focus on Osmont anyways? What from him makes you go to these lengths?"
She asked as if they knew some of the plans of THE Living Temporal, but not everything.
As she said these words, the eyes of THE Living Quantum were filled with a unique sense of serenity and peace that seemed almost out of place for someone discussing strategy.
Uniquely, a similar light twinkled in the eyes of THE Living Dimensional as he also added with the same strange calmness.
"We are closer to THE Creature and THE Living Paradox, even if we steered clear of their conflict. After THE Fallout, what exactly is your aim to be so focused on Osmont?"
The questions came one after another.
Temporal frowned.
He looked toward Quantum and Dimensional as he said with dawning realization creeping into his voice.
"You two are..."
He didn’t finish his words.
He swayed.
The cup in his hand fell down as his body was seemingly about to go limp, his ancient features slackening as if consciousness itself was being pulled away from him.
When in the next moment, his languid expression became heavy and livid as he bellowed out with fury that shook the foundations of Jotunheim itself!
OOOOH!
His eyes radiated purple pillars of time that shot upward and downward simultaneously!
An apocalyptic purple crack instantly bloomed where he stood!
It split the entire citadel in half!
The crack looked like the hand of a clock, and shockingly, it spun and turned with authority that transcended normal power!
For a surrounding gigaparsec, time became inverted and flowed backward!

Buildings that had been standing moments before unbuilt themselves. Chaos Giants who had been walking reversed their steps. Words that had been spoken were unspoken. The cup that had fallen rose back into Temporal’s hand.

The spinning crack moved backward like the hand of a clock, reversing seconds, then minutes, then more as THE Living Temporal forced reality to acknowledge that what had happened should not have happened!
The crack stopped.
It began to heal.
Everything went back to minutes before!
The figure of THE Living Temporal still had a livid expression as his heavy Absolute Depth erupted over everything, and he flew up as he roared with fury that demanded answers!
"WHO?!"
HUUM!
Down below, Quantum and Dimensional were shocked as they also rose up and said with apparent confusion.
"What happened?!"
Temporal had a heavy gaze as he looked toward the two of them, and he began to say with urgency.
"We are attacked in the future, something that may have already affected you two and was going for me as wel..."
He began to sway again.
As if he was losing balance.
As if he was losing himself.
His face became ashen and horrified as he looked at Quantum and Dimensional who had the same gazes they had worn before.
The same serene calmness.
The same peaceful light in their eyes.
Even after turning back time in this local space for them, Quantum and Dimensional were still affected?
The reversal had done nothing.
The infection transcended temporal manipulation.
It existed outside the normal flow of cause and effect.
He looked at them with eyes that held dawning horror as he said with a voice that trembled for the first time in eons.
"What... are you?"
Quantum and Dimensional spoke in synchrony.
Their voices merged into one.
Their expressions matched perfectly.
Their movements mirrored each other with precision that spoke of a single will controlling multiple bodies.
"We are here to help."
Down below, all the Chaos Giants had stopped their moving.
They were all silently looking above.
Thousands of eyes fixed on THE Living Temporal with the same serene expression.
"To make things better."
The synchronized voice continued with warmth that should have been comforting but was instead deeply wrong.
"If we can get a hold of the one keeping hold of time, we can do so much more."
Quantum smiled.
Dimensional smiled.
Every Chaos Giant below smiled.
"We can go to so many places."
The voice dropped to something almost tender.
"Just... let go. Join us."
A pause.
"The process has already begun as you are only prolonging... the inevitable."
HUUM!
THE Living Temporal actually felt a budding sense of fear bloom within foundations that had not known fear since the Infinite Unfurling!
He roared out again with desperation that he had never experienced!
An even larger purple fracture of time bloomed where he was!
A twisted purple hand of a clock covered everything, dividing Jotunheim in half as reality itself screamed in protest at what was being done to it!
The crack expanded and contracted!
It spun backward with force that would have collapsed lesser realms entirely!
And when this crack healed...
THE Living Temporal had disappeared!
Gone.
Fled to somewhere, somewhen!
Down below, the eerie citadel settled into silence.
Quantum and Dimensional floated calmly, looking across the landscape of Jotunheim peacefully as if nothing of significance had occurred.
As if they had not just tried to consume one of the most powerful Absolutes in Observable Existence.
The two of them and all the Chaos Giants down below had the same thoughtful expression.
And they spoke in synchrony.
"Time is inevitable. But...A visit to long-time associates is warranted."
Thousands of voices merged into one.
"Elemental."
"Emotive."
"Law."
"Order."
The sheer oddity and horror of this scene pressed against the fabric of reality itself as multiple beings across an entire Primordial Realm said such words in perfect synchrony!
They had targeted THE Living Temporal as the thought of their success at this alone and what it could cause...was obscene!

chapters.title: Chapter 4826: They Have Fallen! I
paragraphs: In Alfheimr.
The supposed home of THE Creature, even though he seemed fucking nowhere to be seen.
Noah’s illusory consciousness stood opposite to THE Primordial Chaos as he relayed his interactions with THE Secretive Eon and what she, well, what they had said.
Every detail.
Every word.
Every implication.

THE Primordial Chaos was listening intently when moments later, his gaze flickered and he grunted with an expression that shifted through frustration and concern before eventually settling into cold calculation.
He shook his head.
Noah looked at this being with raised brows as THE Primordial Chaos replied with a cold gaze that held weight beyond its apparent calm.
"I didn’t realize Temporal, Quantum, and Dimensional were within Jotunheim since I pulled the vast majority of my Weavings out since your so-called THE Entity began their assault on me."
His shifting features flickered with something that looked almost like irritation.
"But those dumb fuckers actually made their way in as it seemed THE Entity made a move against them."
BOOM!
Noah’s eyes flashed with Immensity!
Holy fuck, THE Entity was not playing! And what the hell were they even doing in Jotunheim?
He listened intently to what Chaos said next.
"Quantum and Dimensional are done for."
The words came flat and final.
"Whatever they were, whatever they stood for, their Civilizations... they are all fucked."
He paused.
"Temporal... he seems to have run away across time, but he is partially infected."
His expression grew darker.
"If he is fully infected, things become much more difficult as THE Entity can run across time."
Another pause.
Horrific words echoed out from Chaos as Noah couldn’t help but become more solemn!
Quantum and Dimensional had fallen!
What was horrid about all of this was it was not even signaled that an Absolute had fallen, since really their Civilization and who they were was still there, just different.
Their pillars of light had not shot across Observable Existence to announce their deaths.
Because they had not died.
They had been replaced.
But now...
"All those infected have to be catalogued, and others have to be informed."
Noah’s voice carried weight that expected action.
"I don’t know how the relationships are with THE Living Existences, but..."
Noah blinked.
He was thinking about THE Living Existences, which got him to think of... the Living Existences.
The Early Creatures and Lesser Living Existences who followed the Civilizations of Quantum and Dimensional.
Would they in any way be affected?

The thought was a heavy one as there were many Lifeforms related to THE Living Quantum and THE Living Dimensional in the Shore of THE Creature, and Noah himself held Quantum and Dimensional that were part of his Stanchions which were now incorporated into his twenty-seven Seals of Absolute Tongue.
|Theoretical Assessment|

|While still a working theory, if it is deemed that The First Tongue or your Infinities is what makes you immune to the infection of THE Entity, you may potentially act as a cut-off point for the concepts of Quantum, Dimensional, Temporal, Spirit, Origin, and all others.|
|And if the leaders of these Civilizations are infected, the possibility of THE Entity spreading itself through the idea of that Civilization would be blocked off by you.|
|By The First Tongue since it permeates across Observable Existence.|
|Of course, this is still just a hypothetical and has not been confirmed.|
|Further observation and experimentation required.|
Ruination proposed something unique that Noah thought about silently.
If he acted as a barrier preventing THE Entity from spreading through Civilizational concepts themselves...
That would make him one of the most important pieces on the board.
And also one of the biggest targets.
In the next moment...
"Come."
The booming voice of THE Primordial Chaos echoed out as the surroundings cleared of chaos, and moments later...
THE Living Emotive burst into the clearing like a storm given human form!

Her entrance was manic and explosive, emotions cycling across her features faster than normal perception could track. Joy and rage and curiosity and hunger all competed for dominance as she twirled through the air with energy that seemed incapable of staying still. Her laughter echoed before her words formed, and her eyes darted everywhere at once as if searching for entertainment in the tension that filled this gathering.
THE Living Elemental followed with subdued steps that contrasted sharply with Emotive’s chaos.

His form was shrouded by Phonemes of Fire, Air, Earth, and Water that rotated around him in slow, deliberate patterns. His expression was guarded. His posture was defensive. He moved like someone who knew he was walking into a situation that could turn hostile at any moment.
And from the distance, Noah waved his hands as THE Living Origin and THE First Hunger also returned!
The two sides looked at each other with tension that crackled through the air of Alfheimr.

Emotive’s gaze landed on Origin first, her smile widening with recognition and mockery intertwined. She bounced on her feet as if preparing to say something cutting, her emotions cycling through delight at seeing her old acquaintance again after what...a few minutes?
Origin met that gaze with cold indifference.
Hunger stood beside her with crimson-obsidian flames that burned low and dangerous.
Elemental’s eyes found Noah’s illusory form, and something flickered there.
At such a moment, THE Primordial Chaos spoke with a voice that commanded absolute attention.
"Hear me well, for I will not repeat myself."
His shifting features settled into something regal and terrible.

"A threat has emerged that transcends the petty conflicts we have engaged in across the eons. A threat that does not discriminate between factions or allegiances. A threat that has already claimed multiple Absolutes and countless lesser beings without any of us perceiving its approach until it was far too late."
He paused to let his words settle.
"This threat has been designated THE Entity by THE Youngest among THE Four, and it is a fitting name for something that defies conventional classification."
His voice grew heavier.

"THE Entity does not kill. It does not collapse. It replaces. It wears the faces of those it claims. It speaks with their voices. It utilizes their Civilizations and their Ways as if they were its own. Because after infection, they are its own."
He gestured broadly.

"Jotunheim is compromised. My domain, my home, my followers, half of everything I built across eons has been claimed by THE Entity without me even perceiving the assault until it was too late to salvage what was lost."

chapters.title: Chapter 4827: They Have Fallen! II
paragraphs: Chaos’ eyes blazed with coldness.
"THE Secretive Eon has fallen. THE Living Quantum has fallen. THE Living Dimensional has fallen. THE Living Temporal has fled across time itself, partially infected and possibly beyond salvation."
He looked at each of them in turn.

"None of you stand a chance of resisting this infection if it reaches you. I do not say this to diminish your power or your pride. I say this because it is truth. I am THE Primordial Chaos, and I could barely sense and resist. I could only flee. If THE Entity claims you, there will be no fighting back. There will be no last stand. There will simply be darkness, and then something else will wear your face while you cease to exist entirely."
His voice dropped to something almost gentle.

"You will steer clear of those infected. You will remain in Alfheimr for now, where THE Creature’s Weavings provide some measure of protection. You will not attempt heroics. You will not attempt reconnaissance. You will survive, because the dead, or in this case the replaced, cannot contribute to finding a solution."
The reactions to Chaos’s words were immediate.

Emotive, who had been bouncing with manic energy moments before, turned silent and contemplative. Her emotions stopped cycling. Her smile faded. She stood perfectly still for perhaps the first time since Noah had seen her, processing the implications of what she had just heard with a seriousness that seemed almost foreign on her features.

Elemental became somber, his Phonemes slowing their rotation as the blood drained from whatever passed for his face. The weight of the threat seemed to press against his foundations with force that made him visibly smaller.
Origin and Hunger looked somber, exchanging glances that spoke of silent communication.
Noah looked at all of these changes with calculating eyes.
Fear was a powerful motivator, even though Absolutes...should not have any sense of fear!
And THE Primordial Chaos had just motivated everyone present to take this threat seriously.
He observed all of this.
But he couldn’t help but turn his gaze to Elemental.
"There is immense danger for everyone."
Noah’s voice cut through the heavy silence with authority that demanded attention.
"But man, the fucker I want to kill is right in front of me."
His illusory eyes locked onto Elemental with intensity that burned.
"You sent me a curse not too long ago, Elemental. You remember that?"
He tilted his head.
"It may not be the time or place, but in the grand scheme of things, you still have to die."
He turned toward THE Primordial Chaos.
"Say, O Primordial Chaos. Do you care if Elemental here goes to an early grave?"
BOOM!
Noah’s words broke off the somber atmosphere as he looked at Chaos!
And he saw Chaos wave his hands nonchalantly as if he couldn’t care less about the fate of THE Living Elemental.
"I don’t give a damn who collapses who, just ensuring the infection isn’t spreading or having others here be carriers."
His shifting features formed something that looked almost like consideration.
"Actually, the less the better."
He nodded to himself.
"If more Absolutes died, that means fewer Absolutes to join the army of THE Entity."
His smile became something cold and calculating.
"Ho, this is actually a decent idea?"
BOOM!
The words of Chaos echoed out in the surroundings as the gazes of Emotive and Elemental flickered with calculations!
Noah looked at all these changes as Elemental looked back at him.
THE Living Elemental stood with the bearing of someone who had existed as an Absolute since long ago, his burly humanoid figure radiating authority that pressed against everything nearby.
And Noah smiled as he looked at this. This guy was using his Tongue, and thinks he can look at him with such a light of defiance?

As if they were having a staredown and Elemental did not want to lose as an Absolute, he spoke with a voice that held the weight of someone defending their pride. "You encroached upon my Civilization. Was I just supposed to sit there and take it? If I came upon you and your people, and I chose one of them and simply took them, would you sit still? As for your threats, they are merely baseless words with no backing. You are not even an Absolute. If not a trick like THE Weavers, you can’t do anything. Will you release your little heart and tell me to grab it if I can? Fuck off."
BOOM!
Elemental’s existence pulsed with a fiery light as he defended himself for the first time in a while! One must not forget who Elemental was as his power was actually grand.

He had existed as an Absolute for many years, built foundations that let him stand among...well, only some of the most powerful beings in Observable Existence, and survived conflicts and schemes that had collapsed others.

But the moment these words echoed out, the skies of Alfheimr flickered! While the pillar of light representing the death of THE Weavers was fading into memory, a radiant new pillar of light representing the birth of another Absolute bloomed with obsidian-gold brilliance, and it even looked a littlehairy.
The rise of a new Absolute was seen here under the gazes of others as they were astonished, with even Chaos having a look of thought before he disappeared.

THE Fallout made it hard for anyone to grasp Absolute as a consequence, and the corruption spreading across Observable Existence created barriers that should have prevented new Absolutes from emerging. So how did this one rise?

Noah smiled lightly as he looked at Elemental. He didn’t have the power of an Absolute? He had a backer of his Way, his Teacher, who just attained Absolute even with the curses of THE Fallout! The curse should make it impossible for any Absolutes to rise, but many things were impossible for others, but not for Absolutes.
And THE Big Stepper had something only Absolutes held access to when he took that step, an Absolute Everything, a currency that transcended the limitations THE Fallout had imposed.

As Noah smiled, Emotive was looking at him deeply with eyes that cycled through curiosity and calculation. "You don’t look the least bit surprised. Osmont, I’ve wanted to meet you dearly, but I have to ask now. You know the Absolute that has just risen? Are they under you? Is that why you torture my little Elemental with words? Because he says you don’t even have power of an Absolute, and bam, there rises an Absolute?"

"THE Secretive Eon has fallen.
THE Living Quantum has fallen.
THE Living Dimensional has fallen.
THE Living Temporal has fled across time itself, partially infected and possibly beyond salvation."
He looked at each of them in turn.
"None of you stand a chance of resisting this infection if it reaches you.
I do not say this to diminish your power or your pride.
I say this because it is truth.
I am THE Primordial Chaos, and I could barely sense and resist.
I could only flee.
If THE Entity claims you, there will be no fighting back.
There will be no last stand.
There will simply be darkness, and then something else will wear your face while you cease to exist entirely."
His voice dropped to something almost gentle.
"You will steer clear of those infected.
You will remain in Alfheimr for now, where THE Creature’s Weavings provide some measure of protection.
You will not attempt heroics.
You will not attempt reconnaissance.

Her emotions stopped cycling.
Her smile faded.
She stood perfectly still for perhaps the first time since Noah had seen her, processing the implications of what she had just heard with a seriousness that seemed almost foreign on her features.
Elemental became somber, his Phonemes slowing their rotation as the blood drained from whatever passed for his face.
The weight of the threat seemed to press against his foundations with force that made him visibly smaller.
Origin and Hunger looked somber, exchanging glances that spoke of silent communication.
Noah looked at all of these changes with calculating eyes.
Fear was a powerful motivator, even though Absolutes...should not have any sense of fear!
And THE Primordial Chaos had just motivated everyone present to take this threat seriously.
He observed all of this.
But he couldn’t help but turn his gaze to Elemental.
"There is immense danger for everyone."
Noah’s voice cut through the heavy silence with authority that demanded attention.
"But man, the fucker I want to kill is right in front of me."
His illusory eyes locked onto Elemental with intensity that burned.
"You sent me a curse not too long ago, Elemental.
You remember that?"
He tilted his head.
"It may not be the time or place, but in the grand scheme of things, you still have to die."

"I don’t give a damn who collapses who, just ensuring the infection isn’t spreading or having others here be carriers."
His shifting features formed something that looked almost like consideration.
"Actually, the less the better."
He nodded to himself.
"If more Absolutes died, that means fewer Absolutes to join the army of THE Entity."
His smile became something cold and calculating.
"Ho, this is actually a decent idea?"

chapters.title: Chapter 4828: You Were Saying Something?
paragraphs: Noah turned to look at this manic woman with coldness as he showed her complete apathy. "You are another that also needs to die. Do you remember Malphas? A butler of yours that you stepped on whenever you had the chance."
Malphas!

Emotive heard these words as she blinked before her eyes opened wide with surprise. "The emotions of all others have been drained and lost from that time. The Weavings of my little butler are still alive and well under you? Haha! You threaten me with death for a mere thing like that? Come on, big guy! I was excited to meet you! One of THE Four! Why are you talking about boring piss shit like a past servant? I thought you more complex than this. Let’s talk big! Focus on things that matter on the scales of Existence, not lesser things with no meaning!"

Her voice rose with intensity as she continued. "We now stand at the precipice of a great enemy where you and Chaos here may just be on the same side, something that has never happened, and you bring up such lame shit? Come on, man! Be like THE Creature. Be like THE Primordial Chaos. Be like THE Living Paradox. You are big. Others are below you. Such matters like the feelings of servants are below you. Anybody that isn’t even an Absolute, why bother with them?"

Her gaze shifted to Origin and Hunger behind Noah. "Even the two behind you. The loser First Hunger who stands beside Origin like a dog, not knowing her heart and Everythings have been taken by THE Creature. And Origin herself. Used and tossed aside by THE Creature like nothing. Look at her now? Nothing to show for it. I fucking gained more from THE Creature than her! Man, all of this just fucking infuriates me! It was supposed to be different!"
BOOM!

Her speech had been long as toward the end of it, she was almost rambling her last words with manic anger! Noah looked at her with unfathomably immense coldness and Immensity as behind him, Origin and Hunger did the same.
Emotive heaved and breathed out after her long-winded speech as she laughed and looked at Noah with eyes that still blazed with chaotic energy.
"What? Cat got your tongue?"

She had gone off with her manic emotions as Noah felt the Weavings of Emotive permeating all around, trying to evoke emotions around all of them. She fed from it. She grew stronger due to it. He would not feed into it at all as he kept his reply short.

"In Existence, there are many misguided little things who think themselves better than others. I’ve collapsed many. You and Elemental will simply be added to the list. Hold your Weavings close, for soon, what remains of them will be included inside Absolute Existential Palaces."
BOOM!

He didn’t speak with manic emotions, nor did he attack their character or Weavings. He simply stated something that felt absolute, and even Emotive was not able to reply as her face pulsed with manic emotions that couldn’t find purchase against his complete indifference!
Between all of them, Chaos looked like he was watching the bickering of children as he began to rise at this moment.

"My words have been clear, and I shall not repeat them. If any of you leave Alfheimr and I do not have track of you, I would rather kill you on sight than wonder if you are infected. The fewer Absolutes that exist to potentially join THE Entity’s army, the better for all of Observable Existence. Youngest, you can reach me at any time through Chaos and Disorder. I will see if I can get in touch with the other Four and potentially act to wipe out THE Secretive Eon and all remnants of THE Entity in one decisive swoop. The rest of you would do well to not fuck things up, or I will kill."
BOOM!
After these words, Chaos disappeared, leaving Emotive and Elemental staring at Noah’s illusory manifestation, THE Living Origin, and THE First Hunger!
Noah looked coldly at Emotive and Elemental as Emotive harrumphed while she looked at him with eyes that still blazed with chaotic energy.
"What? Without the buffer of Chaos, even if I do not target you, if I wanted to fuck up Origin there or that lower Hunger, what can you do? Not even Absolutes. A press of my thumb would be enough."

She continued to poke and poke to elicit a reaction, but Noah never expected or wanted to use Chaos as a shield. He had himself, whose foundational weight was something other entities could not even imagine. And having seen how the situation was unfolding the past few seconds, he had already made another move.
At this moment, between them and Emotive...
HUUM!

The aura of a heavy, dense, and deep Absolute erupted! A hairy obsidian-gold leg descended from above, coming down with weight that made the crystalline forests of Alfheimr tremble as it covered the skies of this portion of the Primordial Realm with authority that spoke of foundations built across eons of dedication to The First Tongue. The leg was massive, covered in countless strands of obsidian-gold hair that pulsed with their own life, and it brought down a glorious visage that made even Emotive’s manic energy falter!
THE Big Stepper!

Ul’moreth descended with the majesty of a newly risen Absolute who had taken the most important step of his existence just moments before. His form was even more hairy than it had been, a mountain of obsidian-gold strands that hid whatever was beneath with density that defied normal perception.

Golden Scissors gleamed in one hairy hand. THE Axiom of Absolute Denial pulsed in the other. And somewhere within that mass of hair, eyes that burned with obsidian-gold authority looked toward Emotive and Elemental with coldness that matched his student’s.
Noah remained right where he was as he looked at Emotive with an expression that held quiet tyranny. "You were saying something?"
The silence that followed was deafening. Emotive’s manic energy stuttered and stopped. Elemental’s Phonemes slowed their rotation.

And THE Big Stepper stood between Noah’s people and those who would threaten them, his Absolute Depth pressing against everything present with weight that made it clear exactly what the consequences of hostile action would be.
No student should have to bear the weight of Existence alone.
It was said!

chapters.title: Chapter 4829: Who Said?!
paragraphs: A heavy air radiated across the crystalline forests of Alfheimr as even THE Living Origin and THE First Hunger looked toward THE Big Stepper in astonishment.
Ul’moreth.

The ancient Ginnu Lifeform who had dedicated eons to mastering The First Tongue had finally taken that impossible step. His form was mountainous, covered in countless strands of obsidian-gold hair that pulsed with their own life and authority.

Far above, the gaze of THE Primordial Chaos seemed to return just briefly, those shifting features settling into something that might have been curiosity as he evaluated this new entrant to the ranks of Absolutes.
His assessment lasted only a moment before his attention moved away.
Noah looked at the cold figures of THE Living Elemental and THE Living Emotive as he evaluated them with calculating eyes.
Frankly, he knew that right now, against both of them and just him and Ul’moreth alone, it would not be a battle that could be won.

If Ul’moreth targeted Elemental alone, that fucker stood a good chance of being collapsed. The ancient Ginnu Lifeform’s foundations were built across eons of dedicated study, and Elemental’s power, while Absolute, did not seem to match that depth of accumulated understanding.
But Emotive was a different matter entirely.

As manic and as horrendous as she was, her power as an Absolute felt much grander than Elemental’s. The emotions cycling through her features held weight that pressed against reality itself, and Noah could sense that whatever Civilization she had built, it was not something to be taken lightly. She was decent in ways that Elemental simply was not.
So while a battle now would lead to nothing productive, while engaging them directly would be foolish when THE Entity threatened all of Observable Existence, he could still teach a lesson.
Some lessons needed to be delivered regardless of circumstance.
"You will be collapsed in due time."
Noah’s voice carried across the crystalline clearing with authority that made the very air tremble.
"But for now, I want you to understand something."
His illusory eyes locked onto THE Living Elemental with intensity that burned.
"I want you to understand that the vast majority of power you have is not yours."
He paused, letting those words settle.
"Because who told you that you could use MY First Tongue?"
HUUM!
The words landed like hammers forged from concentrated authority.
And then something extraordinary happened.

The Phonemes of Fire, Air, Water, and Earth that had been rotating around THE Living Elemental in slow, deliberate patterns began to flicker. The brilliant displays that had surrounded his form stuttered and dimmed, the four fundamental concepts that defined his very existence responding to an authority that superseded their connection to him.
Fire guttered like a candle in a hurricane.
Air stilled as if it had forgotten how to move.
Water froze mid-flow, suspended in patterns that defied its nature.
Earth trembled and cracked, its solidarity questioned by something deeper than its own foundations.

The Phonemes didn’t disappear entirely, but they flickered in and out of stability as if they were being turned off and on by an unseen hand. THE Living Elemental’s expression shifted from cold composure to something that looked almost like shock as the fundamental building blocks of his Civilization, the very concepts that had defined him since The Earliest Folds, began to question their allegiance.
This was not an attack.
This was a reminder.
A reminder of who held true authority over the linguistic foundation of reality itself.

THE Living Emotive sensed the shift in Elemental’s power, and her cycling emotions stuttered to a stop as genuine astonishment crossed her features. She looked at Elemental, then at Noah, then back at Elemental again as understanding dawned.
And then she smiled.
It was a devilish expression, wide and manic and filled with something that looked almost like delight.
"Right! Right!"
Her laughter echoed across the crystalline clearing with energy that made nearby trees vibrate.
"You still are one of THE Four!"
She bounced on her feet, emotions cycling through excitement and hunger and something darker that lurked beneath the surface.
"Haha, this was part of what I was looking forward to meeting you. Say, do you want to talk in private? Show me a bit more things relating to THE Four?"
Her voice dropped to something almost intimate.
"They always fascinate me so much."

But as she finished those last words, her entire demeanor shifted. The manic energy remained, but beneath it emerged a sense of coldness and sombreness that seemed utterly at odds with her previous behavior.

Her entire figure became surrounded by manic light that pulsed with colors that shouldn’t exist together, emotions made manifest in ways that pressed against the sanity of any who observed too closely.

At this moment, the figure of Ul’moreth turned toward Noah as his existence burned with waves of Absolute authority that made the crystalline forests around them tremble. His countless hairs stood on end, each strand pulsing with obsidian-gold light that spoke of power newly claimed but already deeply rooted.
"Little Anomaly."
His voice carried the weight of ages, of dedication, of a being who had spent eons pursuing mastery and had finally achieved what he sought.
"I have seen a lot of crazy in my existence. This particular type of crazy is one that simply needs to be eradicated."
The words were not spoken with heat or anger.
They were spoken with the cold certainty of someone who had evaluated a threat and determined the only appropriate response.
Noah looked at Emotive while listening to the words of Ul’moreth. His illusory eyes met her manic gaze without flinching, without showing any of the calculation that was occurring behind them.
Then, without turning around, he addressed THE Living Origin and THE First Hunger who stood behind him with expressions that mixed concern with readiness.
"You two go and do what you came here to do."
Origin and Hunger exchanged a glance.
They began to move, to turn away from the confrontation and toward their objective that had brought them to Alfheimr in the first place.
"And the two of you."
Noah’s last words were directed toward THE Living Elemental and THE Living Emotive.

Elemental was still fuming, his expression a mask of barely contained fury as he continued to try and express his Absolute authority to pull the Phonemes he had always been so familiar with. Fire, Air, Water, and Earth still flickered around him, responding to his commands only intermittently, their connection to him disrupted by an authority that superseded his claim.
Emotive watched with that manic smile still plastered across her features, her emotions cycling through amusement and interest and something darker that lurked beneath the surface.
"You two can get the fuck off."
The words were delivered with casual contempt.
"When I am ready to start butchering, I will come for you."
WAA!

Even though only an illusory visage stood here, even though his main body was across Observable Existence dealing with matters far removed from this confrontation, Noah was grand and imposing as he delivered this dismissal.
He had shockingly denied access to The First Tongue to two Absolutes!

To this hour, his Thesis had not been refuted. The proposition he had laid down in Muspelheim, the claim that only those to whom he granted permission could draw power from The First Tongue, remained unchallenged. It had actualized into local truth, and now he was applying that same principle on a broader scale.
With his tremendous weight, with the foundation that many could not match, he could afford to do this even against Absolutes!

Her entire figure became surrounded by manic light that pulsed with colors that shouldn’t exist together, emotions made manifest in ways that pressed against the sanity of any who observed too closely.
At this moment, the figure of Ul’moreth turned toward Noah as his existence burned with waves of Absolute authority that made the crystalline forests around them tremble.
His countless hairs stood on end, each strand pulsing with obsidian-gold light that spoke of power newly claimed but already deeply rooted.
"Little Anomaly."
His voice carried the weight of ages, of dedication, of a being who had spent eons pursuing mastery and had finally achieved what he sought.
"I have seen a lot of crazy in my existence.
This particular type of crazy is one that simply needs to be eradicated."
The words were not spoken with heat or anger.
They were spoken with the cold certainty of someone who had evaluated a threat and determined the only appropriate response.
Noah looked at Emotive while listening to the words of Ul’moreth.
His illusory eyes met her manic gaze without flinching, without showing any of the calculation that was occurring behind them.
Then, without turning around, he addressed THE Living Origin and THE First Hunger who stood behind him with expressions that mixed concern with readiness.
"You two go and do what you came here to do."
Origin and Hunger exchanged a glance.
They began to move, to turn away from the confrontation and toward their objective that had brought them to Alfheimr in the first place.
"And the two of you."
Noah’s last words were directed toward THE Living Elemental and THE Living Emotive.
Elemental was still fuming, his expression a mask of barely contained fury as he continued to try and express his Absolute authority to pull the Phonemes he had always been so familiar with.
Fire, Air, Water, and Earth still flickered around him, responding to his commands only intermittently, their connection to him disrupted by an authority that superseded his claim.
Emotive watched with that manic smile still plastered across her features, her emotions cycling through amusement and interest and something darker that lurked beneath the surface.
"You two can get the fuck off."
The words were delivered with casual contempt.
"When I am ready to start butchering, I will come for you."
WAA!

Even though only an illusory visage stood here, even though his main body was across Observable Existence dealing with matters far removed from this confrontation, Noah was grand and imposing as he delivered this dismissal.
He had shockingly denied access to The First Tongue to two Absolutes!
To this hour, his Thesis had not been refuted.
The proposition he had laid down in Muspelheim, the claim that only those to whom he granted permission could draw power from The First Tongue, remained unchallenged.
It had actualized into local truth, and now he was applying that same principle on a broader scale.
With his tremendous weight, with the foundation that many could not match, he could afford to do this even against Absolutes!
